chapters.title: Chapter 807: Drawing the Line
paragraphs: According to the social norms accepted by Ling Ran, he must reciprocate when he received benefits from others.
As a result of Zhang Anmin’s promotion, Ling Ran got an Intermediate Treasure Chest, so Ling Ran gave Zhang Anmin a gentle smile and nodded before and saying, “I’ll let you perform laparotomy later.”
Compared to abdominal closure, laparotomy was a far greater treatment.
It was just like picking a pound of meat in the morning or evening market. They were too completely different concepts.
When Zhang Anmin followed Ling Ran to perform surgery, it was rare for him to get the treatment of performing a laparotomy, and he instantly became excited.
When he entered the operating theater, Zhang Anmin was still excited, but he hesitated the moment he grasped the surgical skin marker pen.

“Which technique are we using?” Zhang Anmin glanced at Ling Ran. Among the various surgical techniques, the existence of choledochoduodenostomy was considered inferior to other surgical techniques. It was only proposed by Ried in the 1990s. However, the development of this type of surgery was very fast. Up to now, there were more than five main surgical methods and countless variations.

As a professional doctor in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, Zhang Anmin had also studied choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct. However, considering his learning history, Zhang Anmin was more worried about Ling Ran’s lack of skill.

After all, Ling Ran used to learn from him when he was doing cholecystectomy. Choledochojejunostomy and choledochoduodenostomy were a little more complicated. Even if Ling Ran were a genius and might have learned some things when he was doing freelance surgeries outside the hospital, it would be impossible for him to learn all five kinds of techniques.

Laparotomy and cutting the skin was easy, but what should they do if the position of the mark did not conform to the chief surgeon’s habit? What if the chief surgeon was not familiar with the technique?
If he did not perform seppuku in time, he would be scolded to the point that he would not be able to provide for his own life anymore, right?
Zhang Anmin looked tentatively at Ling Ran.
Ling Ran looked at Zhang Anmin strangely. “For laparotomy, you have the right to choose and make the judgment for yourself.”
Zhang Anmin panicked a little for some reason. It was the epitome of how being in a king’s company was the same as being with a tiger.
Zhang Anmin looked up and glanced around.
Wang Jia, the young nurse held Scalpel Handle 7 in her hand. Its blade was sharp. She still looked like an enthusiastic and unreasonable fangirl.

Nurse Niu was the circulating nurse that day. She was a forty-year-old woman with the body figure of a tank. Her rough big hands could easily crush casts and bend steel panels. In her circle of friends, the pictures she uploaded would always attract a lot of noise, and those who dared expose the truth about her photos would all be suppressed.

The anesthetist was still Su Jiafu. He sat on a round stool lifelessly. He looked like a good kid with high scores and low life skills, excelled in moral as well as academic performance, but was bullied by others, but Zhang Anmin knew that ordinary hallucinogens would not even be able to allow a person to imagine just how Su Jiafu looked like when he flattered someone who obviously did not like him.
“Is... Is it really okay for me to perform the laparotomy?” Zhang Anmin struggled softly, he was so scared of being scolded to death.
Ling Ran said indifferently, “You can use whichever way you’re familiar with.”
He mastered Perfect Level Choledochoduodenostomy of the Common Bile Duct. Regardless of which technique Zhang Anmin chose, Ling Ran could carry on with it and give Zhang Anmin guidance.
From Ling Ran’s point of view, since he was guiding him, it was only natural for Zhang Anmin to choose a surgical method he was familiar with since that could better improve his skills.
However, how could Zhang Anmin read Ling Ran’s mind?
He looked at Ling Ran with confused eyes, hoping to get some instruction again.
There was none.

Zhang Anmin could not help but feel a burst of despair. The operating theater had always been a place where a chief surgeon pretended to be someone amazing. But if the assistant did not cooperate well, thus causing the chief surgeon to be unable to flaunt his awesomeness, what kind of experience would that be?
That was what Zhang Anmin experienced in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
Zhang Anmin was silent for a long time, and finally, he said with a shaky voice, “Then... shall we use Roux-en-Y anastomosis?”

This was the most common surgery under cholecystojejunostomy, and it was also the basic surgical method of many variants of the surgery. There was not much room for the surgeon to show off, but it was the safest surgical method.
Nevertheless, in simple terms, Roux-en-Y anastomosis was definitely not as simple as choledochoduodenostomy.
Zhang Anmin did not know which one to choose either. Instinctively, he thought choosing the simplest surgical method might not fit into Doctor Ling’s disposition.
Ling Ran nonchalantly nodded.
Zhang Anmin could not help but breathe a sigh of relief and hurriedly marked a line on the patient’s belly. Due to his feeling of excitement, the line he marked was slightly crooked.

“I’ll redraw it.” Zhang Anmin did not dare say that he was making a change during the incision. If the line he drew was not even straight, there was no way his senior doctor would agree to him switching things when he performed the incision.
Zhang Anmin erased it in a flurry of motion with alcohol, then held the black pen and drew a line gently again.
The patient’s stomach was a little fat. At the end of the line, Zhang Anmin’s hand slipped, and the line was crooked again.
“I’ll... redraw it?” Zhang Anmin tentatively asked Ling Ran.
Ling Ran cordially nodded and said, “Change the pen to another color.”
Zhang Anmin agreed and extended his hand for another pen.
He drew the white line very carefully... and when it reached the end...
It became crooked!
“Can I change the pen to another color?” Zhang Anmin felt so guilty that his hand shook.
Nurse Niu was a little too lazy to get the pen and said, “Many patients’ incisions are not straight, so it doesn’t matter. When it’s bandaged, no one will notice it.”
Zhang Anmin glanced at Ling Ran discreetly and said, “I’m sorry, I’ll redraw another line.”
Wang Jia also said, “Doctor Ling would prefer straight lines, right?”
Ling Ran went along the flow and nodded.
Nurse Niu sighed and said, “Wait a second, I’ll look for some more colored pens.”
Zhang Anmin took a deep breath, wished himself luck, and continued to work hard in silence.
“It’s crooked.”
“Let’s try again later.”
“I’m sorry...”
Soon, the patient on the bed had a multi-colored, curved image of a fried dough stick, which had been formed by multiple lines, drawn on his abdomen.
“Let’s wipe it,” Zhang Anmin progressively moved from feeling guilty to getting used to it, and then, he no longer cared.

Ling Ran just held his hands vertically over his chest and did not urge Zhang Anmin to hurry up. After all, he was bothered by the crooked lines too. Compared to that, being exhausted from waiting was nothing.
“I’ll draw it again,” Zhang Anmin said, took the black pen, and drew a line seriously.
A straight line.
Zhang Anmin was stunned. He then doubted himself and asked, “I’m done?”
“I suppose so.” Doctor Niu yawned and glared at Zhang Anmin without bothering to hide her displeasure.
At the same time, a prompt of the completion of a mission appeared in front of Ling Ran.
[Mission Completed: Train a rookie.]
[Mission Aim: Increase the skill level of a doctor.]
[Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]
Ling Ran thought for three seconds before he asked, ‘System, what skill level has been increased? Zhang Anmin’s line drawing skills?’
“Yes,” the system answered very positively.
Ling Ran cast Zhang Anmin a profound gaze. In a day, he gave Ling Ran two Treasure Chests, and he could already be considered really amazing.
Zhang Anmin felt diffident again when he saw Ling Ran staring at him. He asked in a low voice, “Is that okay?”

“Yes, you can begin to make the incision now,” Ling Ran said. He looked at the two Intermediate Treasure Chests in the interface and decided to wait a little longer. He could get another Treasure Chest.

“It’s crooked.”
“Let’s try again later.”
“I’m sorry...”
Soon, the patient on the bed had a multi-colored, curved image of a fried dough stick, which had been formed by multiple lines, drawn on his abdomen.
“Let’s wipe it,” Zhang Anmin progressively moved from feeling guilty to getting used to it, and then, he no longer cared.
Ling Ran just held his hands vertically over his chest and did not urge Zhang Anmin to hurry up.
After all, he was bothered by the crooked lines too.
Compared to that, being exhausted from waiting was nothing.
“I’ll draw it again,” Zhang Anmin said, took the black pen, and drew a line seriously.
A straight line.
Zhang Anmin was stunned.
He then doubted himself and asked, “I’m done?”
“I suppose so.” Doctor Niu yawned and glared at Zhang Anmin without bothering to hide her displeasure.
At the same time, a prompt of the completion of a mission appeared in front of Ling Ran.
[Mission Completed: Train a rookie.]
[Mission Aim: Increase the skill level of a doctor.]
[Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]
Ling Ran thought for three seconds before he asked, ‘System, what skill level has been increased?
Zhang Anmin’s line drawing skills?’
“Yes,” the system answered very positively.
Ling Ran cast Zhang Anmin a profound gaze.
In a day, he gave Ling Ran two Treasure Chests, and he could already be considered really amazing.
Zhang Anmin felt diffident again when he saw Ling Ran staring at him.
He asked in a low voice, “Is that okay?”
“Yes, you can begin to make the incision now,” Ling Ran said.
He looked at the two Intermediate Treasure Chests in the interface and decided to wait a little longer.
He could get another Treasure Chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 808: Newcomer
paragraphs: Zhang Anmin slit open the patient’s abdomen and quietly gave his place up to Ling Ran.
Ling Ran took over. He used an endotherm knife to perform simple bleeding control while stripping the organ.

Choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct was a process in the midst of taking out the gallstones and opening up the passage in the organ. Due to the large amount of gallstones in the patient’s bile duct, the patient must undergo cholelithotomy using a choledochoscope. Most importantly, the fluid in the bile duct needed to flow out smoothly, and that was known as smooth drainage.
Although this step seemed simple and was not usually hard to perform, the prognosis was often a mess.

The most commonly seen and troublesome occurrence was postoperative reflux that caused cholangitis. It always caused the patient suffering. Some of the patients’ cholangitis cannot be controlled, and even had chances of cancerization.
Moreover, it would be troublesome. With the reduction of peristalsis, sedimentation, malfunction of the liver function, and so on were all problematic issues that may occur.

For attending physicians or assistant lecturers like Zhang Anmin, choledochoduodenostomy might be easy to perform, but it was practically metaphysics for them to increase the prognosis and control the complications. Usually, a large amount of surgical experience was needed to slowly get an idea on performing the surgery.
Ling Ran did not need that.
He followed the standard surgical method and performed it step by step. Every step was done in an extraordinarily relaxed manner.
Zhang Anmin soon understood the contents of the surgery and set aside his anxiety and diffidence when he drew the line. Then, he started to cooperate and learn with earnest.

Compared to the usual, where he was the assistant and just learned the surgery through Ling Ran, Zhang Anmin was the one who performed the incision. Although he had considered Ling Ran’s demands and habits, at the end of the day, Zhang Anmin still decided the location for the incision, the size of the incision, and other factors based on his knowledge.
At this moment, Ling Ran performed the surgery in the surgical field Zhang Anmin opened for him. All his maneuvers can be seen by Zhang Anmin.
This gave Zhang Anmin a completely different feeling.
Compared to Ling Ran’s maneuvers in laparotomy, the surgical field Zhang Anmin currently saw fit more into his own expectations. He was also more familiar with the anatomy in this surgical field.
Zhang Anmin gradually became at ease after seeing Ling Ran’s operation. He also assisted him step by step according to Ling Ran’s order in the operation.
Blood vessels, bile ducts, and the intestine were like a normal passageway, and they were organized, accumulated, and sutured by Ling Ran...
“Completed.” Ling Ran performed the surgery without any obstacles. Throughout the process, he did not introduce or explain anything to Zhang Anmin.
Zhang Anmin also did not have the desire to talk. He could not stop his mind from thinking about Ling Ran’s operation, and he acted just like a soccer fan who had watched a good match.

“Remember to close the abdomen up.” Ling Ran did not care what his junior doctors thought about him. Since it was way too hard to control other peoples’ minds, Ling Ran was not interested at all in understanding in trying to control them. If it were necessary, he was more than willing to open the brain of the junior doctors to help them to solve their problems directly. Of course, that was if they even had any problems in their brains.
*Shick*

Ling Ran stepped open the door of the operating theater, looked back at Zhang Anmin, and stared at the ceiling. The system did not show any notification, which meant that there were no new missions to be completed.
Ling Ran shook his head. It seemed that he could only squeeze out two Intermediate Treasure Chests from Zhang Anmin on this day.

“Ah...” A young nurse carrying a huge stack of consumables lowered her head and walked quickly, which was why she did not see Ling Ran. She only thought about avoiding him when she almost knocked into him, but it was already too late.
Ling Ran immediately laid a palm on her head before he turned around and avoided her in a familiar motion.
For Ling Ran, regardless of whether he was in school or any other place, he always encountered such matters, so it was not something new and hard for him to avoid someone bumping into him.
“Do-Doctor Ling...” The young nurse looked bashful, and tears could be seen in her eyes.
Ling Ran smiled warmly, nodded, and he said, “Hello.”
Then, Ling Ran just walked forward.

The young nurse stared at Ling Ran’s back with a dumb look on her face. She could not help but take out her phone with the intention of showing off, but she held back. She just secretly took a photo and hugged her phone, no longer wanting to say anything.
Ling Ran walked through the corridor and went directly to the Operating Area to change. Then, he headed to his office.

Today’s surgeries were all minor surgeries, and they were all quite successful. With Ling Ran’s understanding, these were surgeries where he did not need to visit the patients’ family. It was too monotonous for Ling Ran to attend a meeting to only tell the family members that the surgery was successful, and it was still monotonous even if he added the word “very”.
“Doctor Ling.”
When Ling Ran sat in his office, someone came in and greeted him.
This was not something strange too. The pharmaceutical sales representatives always found opportunities to come in.
“Huh? Department Director Hong?” Ling Ran was surprised to see Department Director Hong from the Respiratory Medicine Department.
Department Director Hong smiled and showed the yellow teeth all smokers were proud of having before he said, “Doctor Ling, I’ll introduce someone to you.”
As he spoke, he pulled out the man who was dressed in a suit and stood tall.
“Why don’t you introduce yourself?” Department Director Hong showed an attitude that made it clear he was very familiar with the person.
The man in the suit smiled and nodded at Ling Ran. He said, “I’m the chairman of Hui Hong Company, Chou Hong, spelled H-O-N-G. Speaking of which, I’m schoolmates with you, Doctor Ling.”
Ling Ran looked at him and asked doubtfully, “Lower Groove Elementary School or Yun Hua University?”

Chou Hong was stunned a little before he smiled. “They do always say that you’re rather unique. Of course I was talking about Yun Hua University. I’m an alumni of the third batch, and I was a major in architecture at Yun Hua University. Then, I set up my company after I graduated. We specialize in professional home demolition to professional estate development.”
Ling Ran nodded. “I was just thinking that it’s quite rare for people at your age to be able to study up to tertiary education.”
“I’ll take that as a compliment.” Chou Hong laughed and said, “I’m quite surprised that I could graduate from the university as well.”
“What business do you have with me?” Ling Ran did not continue with the conversation.

“Actually...” Chou Hong remained silent for a few seconds before he said, “My son Chou Hui will be graduating from university soon. He had his internship in Yun Hua Hospital. Now, it’s time for his housemanship, and he wishes to work under you for it. I might be his father, but I know nothing about medicine. Even so, I hope to achieve my son’s wish...”
Ling Ran looked at Chou Hong, then at Department Director Hong.

“He wants to put a houseman under you. He graduated from Yun Hua University and is your junior,” Department Director Hong interpreted. Then, he could no longer hold back his urges, took out a cigarette, and smoked under a sign that read “No Smoking”.

Ling Ran looked at Chou Hong, and Chou Hong immediately showed a smile while he said, “My son’s results are not too bad, and he wants to become a doctor. When he heard that your skills are at the top of the field, he begged me to try and ask you to take him in. I have no choice as well, so I came to beg you personally.”
“Can he work overtime?” Ling Ran asked.
“Yes.” Chou Hong kept nodding. He knew that Ling Ran was already considering it.
“Even overtime until ten o’clock at night?”

“Of course. There’s no problem with it. Don’t they say that working for twelve hours a day and six days a week will eventually repay you with good results? My son is hardworking. After all, all the hard work is to accumulate experience for himself, right?”
Ling Ran nodded and asked, “Can he come and work earlier?”
“Yes. Now he wakes up at around six in the morning.” Chou Hong smiled proudly.
Ling Ran stared at him. “Housemen do not need to come too early, but it’s still within reason that they reach the hospital at around four in the morning.”

Chairman Chou Hong, who used to work in the field of demolition, owed the farmers their salaries, and set up a real estate development company, frowned and looked at Old Hong before he looked at Ling Ran, and he said in a low voice, “Doctor Ling, I’m not sure whether you realize that the labor laws in our country still has strict regulations...”

chapters.title: Chapter 809: Cornerstone
paragraphs: “We’re at the yearly graduation season again, huh?” Zuo Cidian held up his tea cup, drank half, and sighed deeply. When he was under Ling Ran, he was only forty-two years old. However, he now felt as if he was forty-five years old.
If a person was over forty-five years old, that person was no longer considered young.

Next, he could not apply for the Thousand Talent Program, Ten Thousand Talent Program, Chang Jiang Scholars Program, the National Science Fund for Excellent Young Scholars, or the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars, anymore. People who were no longer young and who were forty-five years of age can only compete with in the Innovative 1000 Talents plan, Yangtze River scholars, and other titles, which would be much more difficult.

When he thought about how he might not be able to become a national talent in his whole life, Zuo Cidian could not help but sigh again. As he watched Qiu Hui, Qu Xiaoyu, and other housemen standing in the office, he said, “How nice it is to be young. You have limitless possibilities.”
“Mister Zuo, you’re still young.” Qiu Hui suddenly bent over and filled Zuo Cidian’s tea cup with tea.
Zuo Cidian was stunned for a moment. He could not help but re-examine the young man in front of him. He grinned. “Young man, you’re good. You’re pretty street-wise.”

Zuo Cidian did feel mentally exhausted in Ling Ran’s treatment group. Without counting in Ling Ran, if he ranked the people from the top to the bottom of Ling Ran’s treatment group in terms of flattery, Yu Yuan, Lu Wenbin, Ma Yanlin, and Zhang Anmin cannot be regarded as qualified flatterers. Their day-to-day flattering was already bad, and they could not even be expected to pour tea or anything else.

The housemen and interns who rotated to their group often had the heart to flatter their superiors, but did not have the skills to do so, let alone pour tea. Sometimes, they even flattered the person to the point of embarrassment ...
By Zuo Cidian’s judgment, the newcomer Qu Xiaoxuan was a young flatterer, but all he had was skill, his movements were still like that of a newborn baby.

Zuo Cidian was, however, quite fond of Qiu Hui’s posture while he poured tea. It was not feigned and was very natural. It did not reek of helplessness as if he was forced by society to do so, neither did it have the stiffness of someone who was trying to force his way to blend into society. What was even rarer was that it was not unnatural. It was refreshing and charming, and it gave others the feeling that his actions were very smooth, but yet not fake and empty...
Zuo Cidian raised the tea cup which Qiu Hui poured and took a sip.
Qiu Hui was also a little reassured and smiled, “I used to go to the company with my dad, and I poured tea for my dad’s employees in each office, so I have a bit of experience in pouring tea.”

“Well, it’s good to be young. Young people are not afraid of shame when they do this kind of thing, and they’re able to be shameless.” Zuo Cidian threw his head back and laughed, “Why can’t newcomers with high education survive in the workplace? Actually, it’s not because he or she has a high education, but it’s because he’s too old, but still new to the workforce.”
The forty-four-year-old new resident doctor, Zuo Cidian, felt tearful when he said these words.

Zhang Anmin also felt emotional as he listened. Looking at Qiu Hui’s clean white coat, and his pair of fashionable Yeezies that were very valuable at a glance and were unlikely to be fake, he lamented. “How nice it is to have a family company. When I was a kid, I wanted to pour tea to my uncles. Unfortunately, my uncles didn’t have tea leaves at home, and they didn’t dare to let me use the kettle. If it broke, my family couldn’t afford it.”
Several of the people present laughed out loud.
Lu Wenbin laughed the loudest. “Old Zhang, after you became an assistant lecturer, you turned into someone with a richer life experience.”
Zhang Anmin looked at Lu Wenbin with the dignity of an assistant lecturer.
Lu Wenbin gradually felt diffident and asked, “Is it true?”
“It’s true.” Zhang Anmin nodded his head solemnly.
Lu Wenbin gasped emotionlessly.
The doctors smiled emotionlessly.
Qiu Hui silently retreated back to the other two housemen. It was very dangerous to join in the conversation of the experts.
Suddenly, Zuo Cidian sat upright, faced the computer, and acted as if he was working hard.
After a few seconds, the office turned quiet, for some unknown reason.
Several housemen looked at each other. As soon as they had an idea of what was going on, they heard the sound of footsteps, and someone stepped in.
Zuo Cidian stood up and said, “Doctor Ling, is the surgery completed?”
“Yep.” Ling Ran nodded.
“Doctor Ling, I have filled up the cases.” Lu Wenbin also put away his pride of having a BMW 525.
Zhang Anming smiled slightly. “Today, the rounds at the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery are all done. There are not many problems.”
Ling Ran nodded slightly and gave an approving smile.
There was instantly a happy atmosphere in the office.
Then, Ling Ran returned to his office, and the atmosphere in the room became normal again.
The three housemen looked at each other and felt like they had gained an understanding of the world.
“Let’s go, I’ll take you guys around.” Zuo Cidian stood up.
Qiu Hui followed behind him as he said, “Sorry for the trouble, Doctor Zuo.”

“Don’t mention it, it’s no trouble. The Emergency Department has now upgraded to an Emergency Medical Center. There are too many people and many things. If I don’t bring you guys around, others would be too lazy to.”
Qiu Hui and the others looked around, and it turned out that all the other doctors looked busy.
Even their clinical tutor Lu Wenbin seemed to have ignored them as if he had sold them off.
Zuo Cidian placed his hands behind his back and took the three housemen with him as he slowly walked toward the emergency area.
When they stepped out of the elevator, the chaotic noises of people shouting and crashing into stuff could be heard.

There was a doctor in a white coat standing proudly in the crowd that moved hurriedly back and forth while they were covered in sweat. He was like a pillar, like a beacon in a river, and he gave people an infinite sense of peace.
All three housemen look at the doctor with admiration. He was only of average height, but he gave off a sense of security.

All the doctors’ goal when they joined the Emergency Department was to become a doctor who can withstand the pressure and make decisions to give people a sense of reliability while also being able to save lives.
“Doctor Zhou, you’re busy, I see.” Zuo Cidian started.
The person in the white coat standing in the middle of the crowd turned around slowly and smiled slowly. “Oh, Old Zuo.”
“Hey, don’t tell me you just fell asleep standing again?” Zuo Cidian looked at Doctor Zhou with envy. No matter what, things will be different once someone becomes an attending physician.
Doctor Zhou waved his hand. “Just for a moment.”
“I brought a few people to help you.” Zuo Cidian then gave Doctor Zhou a smile that said, “You should know what I’m talking about.”
“Oh,” Doctor Zhou and woke up instantly. The smile on his face was sincere, “Where are they from?”
“They’re our team’s housemen, Doctor Ling has few operations today, so we’re lending them to you for a day.”
“Housemen are good, they are much more useful than interns.” Doctor Zhou cheerfully waved them over, “You over there! Come over here quick! Didn’t you just say that you’re lacking manpower?”
“Oh, okay, I’m going to use them for a while later.” An ordinary and ugly resident doctor stepped forward and nodded at the three housemen, signaling that the transfer was done.
“What’s happening in a while?” Doctor Zhou asked offhandedly.

“Two police officers were injured on duty, and it will take about forty minutes to get them from the suburbs.” The ordinary and ugly resident doctor glanced at the clock on the wall and corrected himself. “Thirty-five minutes.”
“Oh, then I’ll wait for them to come, we’re not doing other operations.” Doctor Zhou nodded solemnly.
The three housemen immediately showed idolizing expressions.
The ordinary and ugly resident doctor sighed heavily and did not dare to expose the true nature behind why Doctor Zhou decided to stay.

“Do your best, and if you have any questions, find a senior doctor.” Doctor Zhou was very satisfied with the young doctors’ admiration as he smiled and informed them. The new housemen boisterously responded, Qiu Hui even proactively asked, “Teacher, where are the injured two policemen? Can we help?”
“It’s a blunt force trauma. We don’t know the specifics yet.” After the resident doctor finished speaking, he suddenly asked, “Do you have a dog?”
The two housemen shook their heads. Qiu Hui said, “I have a Siberian Husky, Alaskan Malamute, Samoyed, and German Shepherd in my family, and one Border Collie.”
The resident doctor gave Qiu Hui a strange look, and said, “Then you stay. There is a policewoman with a police dog. The dog that follows her seems very fierce.”

Unfortunately, my uncles didn’t have tea leaves at home, and they didn’t dare to let me use the kettle.
If it broke, my family couldn’t afford it.”
Several of the people present laughed out loud.
Lu Wenbin laughed the loudest.
“Old Zhang, after you became an assistant lecturer, you turned into someone with a richer life experience.”
Zhang Anmin looked at Lu Wenbin with the dignity of an assistant lecturer.
Lu Wenbin gradually felt diffident and asked, “Is it true?”
“It’s true.” Zhang Anmin nodded his head solemnly.
Lu Wenbin gasped emotionlessly.
The doctors smiled emotionlessly.
Qiu Hui silently retreated back to the other two housemen.
It was very dangerous to join in the conversation of the experts.
Suddenly, Zuo Cidian sat upright, faced the computer, and acted as if he was working hard.
After a few seconds, the office turned quiet, for some unknown reason.
Several housemen looked at each other.
As soon as they had an idea of what was going on, they heard the sound of footsteps, and someone stepped in.
Zuo Cidian stood up and said, “Doctor Ling, is the surgery completed?”
“Yep.” Ling Ran nodded.
“Doctor Ling, I have filled up the cases.” Lu Wenbin also put away his pride of having a BMW 525.
Zhang Anming smiled slightly.
“Today, the rounds at the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery are all done.
There are not many problems.”
Ling Ran nodded slightly and gave an approving smile.
There was instantly a happy atmosphere in the office.
Then, Ling Ran returned to his office, and the atmosphere in the room became normal again.
The three housemen looked at each other and felt like they had gained an understanding of the world.
“Let’s go, I’ll take you guys around.” Zuo Cidian stood up.
Qiu Hui followed behind him as he said, “Sorry for the trouble, Doctor Zuo.”
“Don’t mention it, it’s no trouble.
The Emergency Department has now upgraded to an Emergency Medical Center.
There are too many people and many things.
If I don’t bring you guys around, others would be too lazy to.”
Qiu Hui and the others looked around, and it turned out that all the other doctors looked busy.
Even their clinical tutor Lu Wenbin seemed to have ignored them as if he had sold them off.
Zuo Cidian placed his hands behind his back and took the three housemen with him as he slowly walked toward the emergency area.
When they stepped out of the elevator, the chaotic noises of people shouting and crashing into stuff could be heard.
There was a doctor in a white coat standing proudly in the crowd that moved hurriedly back and forth while they were covered in sweat.
He was like a pillar, like a beacon in a river, and he gave people an infinite sense of peace.
All three housemen look at the doctor with admiration.
He was only of average height, but he gave off a sense of security.

All the doctors’ goal when they joined the Emergency Department was to become a doctor who can withstand the pressure and make decisions to give people a sense of reliability while also being able to save lives.
“Doctor Zhou, you’re busy, I see.” Zuo Cidian started.
The person in the white coat standing in the middle of the crowd turned around slowly and smiled slowly.
“Oh, Old Zuo.”
“Hey, don’t tell me you just fell asleep standing again?” Zuo Cidian looked at Doctor Zhou with envy.
No matter what, things will be different once someone becomes an attending physician.
Doctor Zhou waved his hand.
“Just for a moment.”
“I brought a few people to help you.” Zuo Cidian then gave Doctor Zhou a smile that said, “You should know what I’m talking about.”
“Oh,” Doctor Zhou and woke up instantly.
The smile on his face was sincere, “Where are they from?”
“They’re our team’s housemen, Doctor Ling has few operations today, so we’re lending them to you for a day.”
“Housemen are good, they are much more useful than interns.” Doctor Zhou cheerfully waved them over, “You over there!
Come over here quick!
Didn’t you just say that you’re lacking manpower?”
“Oh, okay, I’m going to use them for a while later.” An ordinary and ugly resident doctor stepped forward and nodded at the three housemen, signaling that the transfer was done.
“What’s happening in a while?” Doctor Zhou asked offhandedly.

“Two police officers were injured on duty, and it will take about forty minutes to get them from the suburbs.” The ordinary and ugly resident doctor glanced at the clock on the wall and corrected himself.
“Thirty-five minutes.”
“Oh, then I’ll wait for them to come, we’re not doing other operations.” Doctor Zhou nodded solemnly.
The three housemen immediately showed idolizing expressions.
The ordinary and ugly resident doctor sighed heavily and did not dare to expose the true nature behind why Doctor Zhou decided to stay.
“Do your best, and if you have any questions, find a senior doctor.” Doctor Zhou was very satisfied with the young doctors’ admiration as he smiled and informed them.
The new housemen boisterously responded, Qiu Hui even proactively asked, “Teacher, where are the injured two policemen?
Can we help?”
“It’s a blunt force trauma.
We don’t know the specifics yet.” After the resident doctor finished speaking, he suddenly asked, “Do you have a dog?”
The two housemen shook their heads.
Qiu Hui said, “I have a Siberian Husky, Alaskan Malamute, Samoyed, and German Shepherd in my family, and one Border Collie.”
The resident doctor gave Qiu Hui a strange look, and said, “Then you stay.
There is a policewoman with a police dog.
The dog that follows her seems very fierce.”

chapters.title: Chapter 810: Cradling the Heart
paragraphs: The ambulance arrived at Yun Hua Hospital with its sirens blaring like a cat meowing, and a few doctors as well as nurses rushed forward with shouts that made them sound like dogs barking.
“Woof! Woof!”
A real dog barked in the ambulance.
“Chestnut, stop barking.” This time, the one who shouted was the resident doctor whose face was so plain that nobody could remember his name.
When the door of the ambulance was opened, the fierce police dog Chestnut looked at the young doctor doubtfully and bared its teeth a little.
“Chestnut, it’s me, do you remember me? We met a few times before.” The plain and ugly resident doctor greeted the police dog while he looked at the stretcher.
“It’s my squadmate. He was hit on the waist with a fishing rod by the drug dealers.” The police woman Qin Min jumped down from the ambulance.
“Hey, hey, don’t move. You should lay on the gurney too.” The plain and ugly resident doctor felt his heart clench when he saw her actions.

“I’m alright, just take a look at my squadmate. All the elderly are like this. They’re no longer in shape, so he was grabbed by four people and even hit by a fishing rod.” Qin Min stretched her body before she continued, “I merely tripped and had some lacerations. I’m fine.”

The plain and ugly resident doctor said domineeringly, “Nope, you need to listen to me when you’re here in the hospital. Now, get onto the gurney, and we will send you for examination. If nothing abnormal appears in the results, you’ll be considered fine.”
Qin Min cast a puzzled glance at him, but she did not insist that she was fine. Instead, she lied on the gurney. When she was pushed in by the nurse, she shouted again, “Chestnut, follow me.”
Police Dog Chestnut pushed its legs and ran like a dog that was freed from its cage and followed the nurse.
“Chestnut, why don’t you follow me?” the plain and ugly resident doctor shouted.
Chestnut glanced at him and looked confused. It then turned around and continued to run.
The plain and ugly resident doctor frowned and walked a few steps forward. He suddenly trembled and realized something. Then, he asked, “Has Chestnut forgotten me?”
The atmosphere in the emergency channel was serious and silent.

“Don’t they say dogs can remember people through smell? The dog can’t even remember me?” He walked a few steps forward and could not help but looked at Qin Min. He asked, “Officer Qin, do you remember me?”
Qin Min covered her mouth and looked at him seriously. She hesitated and said seriously, “Excuse me, have we met before?”
“I was the one who received you during the first few times you came for emergency treatment.” The plain and ugly resident doctor lowered his voice and felt sad.
“I’m sorry. I thought I meet different doctors each time.” Qin Min apologized again, but she did not try to comfort him any further.
The plain and ugly doctor was so disappointed that he stopped moving.
The two gurneys were pushed after one another into the Debridement Room.
Doctor Zhou had washed his hands and looked in the direction of the windows before he looked at his hands, which had not been used for three hours. He smiled proudly and shouted loudly, “Gloves.”
A nurse stretched the rubber gloves and put it on for Doctor Zhou.
“What’s the situation now?” Doctor Zhou stood in front of the first gurney.

Qin Min sat up from the gurney and said, “While catching the criminals, one criminal used a fishing rod and hit us. Old Xu did not manage to avoid it, and his waist was hit. Then, we had one squadmate down immediately.”

“It’s not because I couldn’t avoid it. If I avoided it, won’t the people behind me get hit?” Old Xu’s waist was slightly in pain. He laid on the gurney without moving, but because of it, when he argued on his back, the force in his voice was not great enough for him to sound intimidating.
Qin Min chuckled. “The one behind you was a police dog.”

“Police dog... So, should the police dog get hit by the fishing rod? Let me tell you this, getting hit by a fishing rod is really painful. Oh my god, it’s so painful...” Old Xu groaned, but no one knew whether he was really in pain.
Qin Min waited for him to finish and slowly said, “The dog was in battle mode, and it’s not as high as your waist.”
Old Xu was stunned for a few seconds and used his hands to touch his waist before he shouted, “Argh, it’s so painful...”

“Let me take a look.” Doctor Zhou pulled off the patient’s clothes seriously. An injury from a dull weapon could be serious, but could also be simple. Although the patient shouted so loudly and seemed very energetic, since he was here...
Doctor Zhou still carried out a physical examination for Old Xu.
“You’re fine.” When Doctor Zhou finished speaking, he raised his head and asked, “You are covered by medical insurance, right?”
“Of course,” Old Xu replied from the hospital bed.
“Go and take a CT scan and blood tests. We’ll observe you for one more day.” Doctor Zhou made some casual arrangements.
Old Xu asked, “I’m not injured badly, right?”
“No. Just some superficial wounds.”
“I’m in rather considerable pain, though.”
“It’s just superficial pain.”
When Doctor Zhou said this, he raised his head to look at Qin Min and asked, “Where did you hurt yourself?”
“Calf.” Qin Min stopped for a few seconds and whispered, “Can you get Doctor Ling to treat me? Doctor Ling Ran. I know him, I would like to...”
“Let me check on your injury first.” Doctor Zhou did not agree immediately, and he did not feel surprised with Qin Min’s request.
This beautiful female police officer was not new to the doctors at Yun Hua Hospital.
She would come to the hospital occasionally, particularly the Emergency Room. Most of the time, she would come with injured criminals and very rarely would she come with her colleagues.
It was quite rare for her to get injured, though.
Qin Min carefully pulled up her trousers.
On her calf was a medium sized bruise. It was the size where a mother would feel her heart clench when her child had it, but the father would find it to be nothing to be worried about.
Doctor Zhou hummed and asked, “How did you get injured?”
“I was hit by the fish thrown over.” Qin Min recalled and said, “The fish used all its strength. I saw it move its tail.”
“Okay.” Doctor Zhou complained in his heart and asked, “Any other injury?”

“No. I just need to instruct Chestnut. By the way, when Chestnut was injured, it was treated by Doctor Ling. He even anesthetized the dog. He’s so thoughtful...” Qin Min was engrossed in her memories.
“You are talking about Dog Anesthesia’s story?” Doctor Zhou suddenly remembered.
“Dog... Anesthesia?”
“The doctor who anesthetized your dog is known as Dog Anesthesia. Once many people called him that, he couldn’t get rid of the nickname.”
Qin Min smiled when she heard that. “I still want Doctor Ling to examine me, is it okay?”
“No problem.” Doctor Zhou immediately took off his gloves and asked someone to call Ling Ran.
Qin Min sat up straight and adjusted her lying position on the gurney.
In a short while, footsteps were heard outside.
Old Xu, who laid beside her, was waiting. He stared at the door, smiled, and said, “So, that’s the reason for me to take an extra ten minutes to Yun Hua Hospital?”
“The Emergency Department of Yun Hua Hospital is indeed the best.” When Qin Min said that, the door of the Debridement Room was pushed open.
Ling Ran and two other resident doctors appeared outside the door.
Qin Min cradled her heart with her hands. “Doctor Ling...”
“Hello.” Ling Ran showed a smile that was socially appropriate.
Chestnut whimpered and wanted to rub Ling Ran’s trousers.
Old Xu was also stunned. “The rascals in the team are not blind indeed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 811: Old Xu
paragraphs: “Doctor Ling, sorry for troubling you again.” Qin Min smiled.
Ling Ran also gave a smile and said, “It’s fine. It’s my duty.”
Qin Min gave a huge smile without hesitation. “Doctor Ling, you’re the best.”
Old Xu turned his head around while he remained beside Qin Min, looking flabbergasted.

He was truly surprised, as Qin Min did not usually appear friendly to other men. Old Xu used to think that Qin Min did not want to go into a relationship just yet and just wanted to focus on her career first...
Old Xu could not help but look at the mirror before he looked at Ling Ran. His jealousy slowly disappeared and was replaced with inexplicable desolation...

He was already old. Since his vagrant youth had been given to dogs, he no longer had any desires in his life. If it were not because of bad luck sending a fishing rod into his back, he would not have needed to come to the hospital.
Before Old Xu came to the hospital, he did not know that a man’s good looks could reach such a level.
Old Xu could not help but ask, “So... Why did you want to become a doctor, Doctor Ling?”
“Because I want to become a doctor.” Ling Ran glanced at Old Xu and asked, “Where’s his medical record?”

The plain and ugly doctor immediately turned on the electronic medical records and turned to Ling Ran’s direction. Since Old Xu was just recently admitted, his medical records would be largely scarce. However, the drugs prescribed to him, the examinations he received, and the examination results would be shown in the medical record.
Although the plain and ugly doctor was shocked just now, he would still need to work for Ling Ran.
“Go and ask them to hurry up on the examination report.” Ling Ran scanned through the medical record and gave a reminder.
The plain and ugly doctor replied, “Okay.”

Old Xu watched Ling Ran ask a series of questions and perform a series of examinations before he asked, “Doctor Ling, you should have many career choices available to you, right? You just became a doctor because you wanted to?”
“Yes.” Ling Ran looked at Old Xu and answered.
Old Xu was curious and said, “But you must have better options, right? You should have career options that will give you more money and power.”
“Doing what I want to do is even better,” Ling Ran replied directly. This was something he had thought about a long time ago.
Old Xu was stunned and turned his head around. He saw Qin Ming look at Ling Ran with an admiring gaze, and he could not help but feel resigned.
“I also became a policeman because I wanted to.” Old Xu sighed and said to Qin Min.

Qin Min’s empathy for her colleague who only had a superficial wound was reduced by a large degree, and she easily retorted, “You even said you wanted to become part of the Public Security Police Force previously.”

“I worked in the Public Security Police Force for my wife and children. Our Police Dog Squad always worked with the Criminal Investigation Department and Drug Unit, won’t our family worry about us? I’ve been admitted to the hospital a few times.” Old Xu opposed directly. Although he did not prioritize his work, he did not want to be regarded as a person who did not love his work.
Qin Min gave a faint smile, but her eyes were on Ling Ran. Then, she asked, “Doctor Ling, will there be any scars on my calf?”

Qin Min’s calves were slim and beautiful, and it was a rather beautiful part of her, among the unmentionables below her neck. Ling Ran put on gloves and pressed on it for a while before he asked a few more questions. Then, he said with certainty, “No scars will be formed over there.”
“Thank you, Doctor Ling.” Qin Min was a bit shy but happy.
Old Xu could finally feel the misery from the young doctors beside him. He sighed heavily, “I’m talking about my job and my life.”

“Chestnut’s life was saved by Doctor Ling,” Qin Min said seriously, “If you think your body is not feeling well, you may go to Doctor Ling for surgery. Every time I come to Yun Hua Hospital, everyone would say that Doctor Ling does his surgeries well. If Doctor Ling is willing to receive you as his patient, your illness has already recovered by 70% to 80%.”
Old Xu smiled. “Is it that ridiculous?”

“Really. I have asked many patients’ family members. Some doctors have a good reputation, but after they perform surgery, some patients recover faster, while some don’t. When it comes to Doctor Ling, that’s not the case. All the patients will recover...” Qin Min said even more seriously. Treatment and going to the doctors was a matter concerning life and death, and that was definitely not something to be joked about.
Old Xu looked at Ling Ran seriously and smiled. “You praised the person right in front of him.
“How do you feel, Doctor Ling?”
“Oh, I always receive compliments.” Ling Ran remained calm and looked at Old Xu.
Old Xu was stunned and wanted to tease him. When he looked at Ling Ran’s expression, his skillset as a policeman finally came into play. “What you said is real.”
Ma Yanlin could not bear listening to the conversation anymore. “Of course. Look at his face. Your dog is handsome too, and it’s often praised, right?”
Old Xu finally became quiet and sighed for the last time today. “Sigh, praises are not all that it ever received...”
Ling Ran changed to another pair of gloves, turned around, and said to Old Xu, “Let me do a physical examination for you.”
“The doctor just now already examined me...”

Ling Ran only hummed without giving further explanation. Surgeons would never believe in other doctors. There was nothing much to be explained about this. Even Doctor Zhou was far away from being omniscient.
“Does your stomach usually give you trouble?” Ling Ran asked.

Old Xu laid down and smiled when he saw that the curtains around him were drawn. Then, he said, “How healthy can a policeman’s stomach be? It’s especially so for us, who have already worked in a few departments. They’re just thinking of new ways to torture you all the time. You can just perform a few CT scans on me, if you want.”
“Wait a minute. Let me examine you for a while.”

Old Xu was worried that Ling Ran would come under the notion that Old Xu just refused his offer for a physical examination because he thought that Ling Ran was young. He showed an embarrassed smile and said, “It’s not that I want to take advantage of the medical insurance covering my examination fees, but it’s just that I have no time. I came to the hospital because of a work injury. And since I need an examination, I decided to have it all done...”
“Does any part of your stomach bring you discomfort?” Ling Ran did not reply immediately.

“It’s not really a discomfort, just occasional bloating.” Old Xu chuckled. “I’m much better than others. Our captain is far worse. He already went through gastrointestinal bleeding twice. He already stopped drinking, but whenever there’s a martial arts tournament in the police force, he’ll be so nervous that he can’t eat...”
“Do you feel any tension in your muscles?” Ling Ran pressed on the Old Xu’s upper abdomen.
“A little bit.” Old Xu frowned. “This is normal, right?”
Ling Ran did not reply and asked, “Did you recently lose weight?”
Enquiry was part of physical examinations, and it could not be neglected.
Old Xu felt proud and laughed. “I did not have much of an appetite recently. So, I took the opportunity to lose weight. I lost almost 22 pounds. It’s pretty effective, right?”

Ling Ran still did not reply and palpated the entire upper abdomen before he looked at Old Xu’s left collarbone and said to Ma Yanlin, who waited at his side. “Send him directly for a CT scan of the abdomen. Call Doctor Zuo over.”
Ma Yanlin could not help but look at Old Xu with pity and pushed him away.
Qin Min found the situation off the more she listened to the conversation, and she asked, “What’s going on?”
“Ask the patient’s family members to come over.” Nurse Niu, who was beside Ling Ran, was worried that Ling Ran would say something wrong, so she took the chance to speak first.
Qin Min shook her head. “Old Xu’s wife is still their children, studying elsewhere. It will take some time for her to come over.”
“Does he have no other immediate family members?”

Qin Min sensed that something was wrong. She hesitated for a few seconds and said, “Old Xu is an orphan of someone who died for the country, and he has been taken care of by the organization. After he finished studying, he no longer had any immediate family members. He was... raised up at the Public Security Compound since he was young...”

Nurse Niu was already in her middle age, and she had grown far more kind hearted, which was why she was shocked when she heard that. Then, she said to Ling Ran, “Doctor Ling, you should directly tell Officer Qin in this situation.”

Ling Ran looked stern and pondered about this for a few seconds, before he said directly, “The physical examination indicated that he might have stomach cancer. We’ll have to look at the CT-scan for the specifics.”

“Impossible. You’ve just checked for a few minutes and pressed on his stomach, How can it be...?” Qin Min immediately said before she stopped and gulped, “I’m not questioning you, but... could it be a wrong diagnosis?”
Ling Ran remained silent and repeated what he said previously, “We’ll wait for the CT-scan.”

He now had Master Level Physical Examination. The error rate in his judgment was very low. However, Ling Ran did not confirm it straight away. After all, the CT-scan would not cause any unnecessary delays for his treatment.

“Go and ask them to hurry up on the examination report.” Ling Ran scanned through the medical record and gave a reminder.
The plain and ugly doctor replied, “Okay.”
Old Xu watched Ling Ran ask a series of questions and perform a series of examinations before he asked, “Doctor Ling, you should have many career choices available to you, right?
You just became a doctor because you wanted to?”
“Yes.” Ling Ran looked at Old Xu and answered.
Old Xu was curious and said, “But you must have better options, right?
You should have career options that will give you more money and power.”
“Doing what I want to do is even better,” Ling Ran replied directly.
This was something he had thought about a long time ago.
Old Xu was stunned and turned his head around.
He saw Qin Ming look at Ling Ran with an admiring gaze, and he could not help but feel resigned.
“I also became a policeman because I wanted to.” Old Xu sighed and said to Qin Min.

Qin Min’s empathy for her colleague who only had a superficial wound was reduced by a large degree, and she easily retorted, “You even said you wanted to become part of the Public Security Police Force previously.”
“I worked in the Public Security Police Force for my wife and children.
Our Police Dog Squad always worked with the Criminal Investigation Department and Drug Unit, won’t our family worry about us?
I’ve been admitted to the hospital a few times.” Old Xu opposed directly.
Although he did not prioritize his work, he did not want to be regarded as a person who did not love his work.
Qin Min gave a faint smile, but her eyes were on Ling Ran.
Then, she asked, “Doctor Ling, will there be any scars on my calf?”
Qin Min’s calves were slim and beautiful, and it was a rather beautiful part of her, among the unmentionables below her neck.
Ling Ran put on gloves and pressed on it for a while before he asked a few more questions.
Then, he said with certainty, “No scars will be formed over there.”
“Thank you, Doctor Ling.” Qin Min was a bit shy but happy.
Old Xu could finally feel the misery from the young doctors beside him.
He sighed heavily, “I’m talking about my job and my life.”
“Chestnut’s life was saved by Doctor Ling,” Qin Min said seriously, “If you think your body is not feeling well, you may go to Doctor Ling for surgery.
Every time I come to Yun Hua Hospital, everyone would say that Doctor Ling does his surgeries well.
If Doctor Ling is willing to receive you as his patient, your illness has already recovered by 70% to 80%.”
Old Xu smiled.
“Is it that ridiculous?”
“Really.
I have asked many patients’ family members.
Some doctors have a good reputation, but after they perform surgery, some patients recover faster, while some don’t.
When it comes to Doctor Ling, that’s not the case.
All the patients will recover...” Qin Min said even more seriously.
Treatment and going to the doctors was a matter concerning life and death, and that was definitely not something to be joked about.
Old Xu looked at Ling Ran seriously and smiled.
“You praised the person right in front of him.
“How do you feel, Doctor Ling?”
“Oh, I always receive compliments.” Ling Ran remained calm and looked at Old Xu.
Old Xu was stunned and wanted to tease him.
When he looked at Ling Ran’s expression, his skillset as a policeman finally came into play.
“What you said is real.”
Ma Yanlin could not bear listening to the conversation anymore.
“Of course.
Look at his face.
Your dog is handsome too, and it’s often praised, right?”
Old Xu finally became quiet and sighed for the last time today.
“Sigh, praises are not all that it ever received...”
Ling Ran changed to another pair of gloves, turned around, and said to Old Xu, “Let me do a physical examination for you.”
“The doctor just now already examined me...”
Ling Ran only hummed without giving further explanation.
Surgeons would never believe in other doctors.
There was nothing much to be explained about this.
Even Doctor Zhou was far away from being omniscient.
“Does your stomach usually give you trouble?” Ling Ran asked.
Old Xu laid down and smiled when he saw that the curtains around him were drawn.
Then, he said, “How healthy can a policeman’s stomach be?
It’s especially so for us, who have already worked in a few departments.
They’re just thinking of new ways to torture you all the time.
You can just perform a few CT scans on me, if you want.”
“Wait a minute.
Let me examine you for a while.”
Old Xu was worried that Ling Ran would come under the notion that Old Xu just refused his offer for a physical examination because he thought that Ling Ran was young.
He showed an embarrassed smile and said, “It’s not that I want to take advantage of the medical insurance covering my examination fees, but it’s just that I have no time.
I came to the hospital because of a work injury.
And since I need an examination, I decided to have it all done...”
“Does any part of your stomach bring you discomfort?” Ling Ran did not reply immediately.
“It’s not really a discomfort, just occasional bloating.” Old Xu chuckled.
“I’m much better than others.
Our captain is far worse.
He already went through gastrointestinal bleeding twice.
He already stopped drinking, but whenever there’s a martial arts tournament in the police force, he’ll be so nervous that he can’t eat...”
“Do you feel any tension in your muscles?” Ling Ran pressed on the Old Xu’s upper abdomen.
“A little bit.” Old Xu frowned.
“This is normal, right?”
Ling Ran did not reply and asked, “Did you recently lose weight?”
Enquiry was part of physical examinations, and it could not be neglected.
Old Xu felt proud and laughed.
“I did not have much of an appetite recently.
So, I took the opportunity to lose weight.
I lost almost 22 pounds.
It’s pretty effective, right?”
Ling Ran still did not reply and palpated the entire upper abdomen before he looked at Old Xu’s left collarbone and said to Ma Yanlin, who waited at his side.
“Send him directly for a CT scan of the abdomen.
Call Doctor Zuo over.”
Ma Yanlin could not help but look at Old Xu with pity and pushed him away.
Qin Min found the situation off the more she listened to the conversation, and she asked, “What’s going on?”
“Ask the patient’s family members to come over.” Nurse Niu, who was beside Ling Ran, was worried that Ling Ran would say something wrong, so she took the chance to speak first.
Qin Min shook her head.
“Old Xu’s wife is still their children, studying elsewhere.
It will take some time for her to come over.”
“Does he have no other immediate family members?”
Qin Min sensed that something was wrong.
She hesitated for a few seconds and said, “Old Xu is an orphan of someone who died for the country, and he has been taken care of by the organization.
After he finished studying, he no longer had any immediate family members.
He was... raised up at the Public Security Compound since he was young...”
Nurse Niu was already in her middle age, and she had grown far more kind hearted, which was why she was shocked when she heard that.
Then, she said to Ling Ran, “Doctor Ling, you should directly tell Officer Qin in this situation.”
Ling Ran looked stern and pondered about this for a few seconds, before he said directly, “The physical examination indicated that he might have stomach cancer.
We’ll have to look at the CT-scan for the specifics.”
“Impossible.

You’ve just checked for a few minutes and pressed on his stomach, How can it be...?” Qin Min immediately said before she stopped and gulped, “I’m not questioning you, but... could it be a wrong diagnosis?”
Ling Ran remained silent and repeated what he said previously, “We’ll wait for the CT-scan.”
He now had Master Level Physical Examination.
The error rate in his judgment was very low.
However, Ling Ran did not confirm it straight away.
After all, the CT-scan would not cause any unnecessary delays for his treatment.

chapters.title: Chapter 812: Stomach Cancer
paragraphs: Old Xu looked at the report and said nothing for a long time.
The captain and Qin Min stood next to each other. At that moment, their carefully rehearsed statements were caught in their throats.
Only the police dog Chestnut whimpered as it went near Old Xu. It rubbed his leg with its head.
Old Xu looked a little happy as he touched Chestnut’s head, and he said, “You’re such a superficial dog. How long haven’t you rubbed against my leg? And you’re finally coming to me today?”
Chestnut did not appear to understand as it looked at Old Xu. After rubbing against him for a bit, it left.

Old Xu felt melancholy as he looked at Chestnut’s thin waist, and he said, “This superficial dog is actually pretty good-looking, but it’s not friendly enough. That’s why it has become our police team’s dog. If it’s sold at a pet shop, buyers might eliminate him from their choice.”
The squadron officer looked at Old Xu and said, “Are you trying to express your feelings through the dog? What’s with that? Are you afraid we don’t want you anymore?”

“I’ve sweated and bled before. I’ve suffered before, yet have never enjoyed my life. Why would I be afraid about getting thrown out? If you guys don’t want me, I can always find someplace I’m wanted,” Old Xu said a little loudly. He seemed proud, but his eyes were seemingly afraid.
Qin Min sighed secretly and whispered, “you can treat this as a work injury. After you’re healed from your injury, you can go back to work.”
“Why should I continue working? I could just keep a dog.” Lao Xu pouted and said, “Dogs nowadays only look at faces. Rather than feeding them, it’s better to just have a good-looking face.”
Zhang Anmin, who was listening, thought to himself. ‘The problem is that you don’t have a good face.’
Of course, this statement cannot be said to cancer patients. It was too cruel, so Zhang Anmin kept those words to himself, and at the same time, distracted himself from the uneasiness.

As a doctor, there was nothing Zhang Anmin could do about the patient’s illness, and this left him rather helpless. To add on to the misery, this patient was actually the descendant of someone who died for the country. It almost sent Zhang Anmin reeling.

Aside from studying for more than ten years, Zhang Anmin had also been a doctor for more than ten years. It could be said that Zhang Anmin had spent most of his life studying. After studying for so many years and struggling for so long on the nights where he recalled his past, Zhang Anmin always came back to the same happy moment—when his potential took to the stage.

If he had six dreams in a night, three of them were about standing in the operating theater, or outside the operating theater, or in the ward. After curing the patient in any of these three places, he would smugly and righteously reject the red envelopes.

Of the remaining three, only two were scenarios in which he earned enough money and fled poverty, and one would be a scenario that resolved hair loss problems or him falling into the fear of hair loss...
Unfortunately, stomach surgery had never been in Zhang Anmin’s strike zone.

Zhang Anmin shook his head secretly and said to Old Xu, “Mister Xu, don’t dwell on it. Our General Surgery Department in Yun Hua Hospital is first-class in the country. Our skill level and accumulated experience are very great. Associate Department Director Ouyang is a doctor who specializes in studying stomach surgery. Later, we will ask him to give you a detailed consultation. At present, cancer is no longer a terminal illness, and many patients can survive even with cancer. ”
“You mean it can be cured?” Old Xu looked up and asked.

“There are many people who can be cured.” Zuo Cidian moved Zhang Anmin away so that he can take over the conversation, and he calmly said, “The malignancy of stomach cancer is usually relatively low, and the difficulty of the operation is not very large, as long as it has not developed to the stage where it’s too late. Just like what Doctor Zhang said just now, Associate Department Director Ouyang of the General Surgery Department is very good...”
“Can you ask Doctor Ling to perform the surgery on me?” Old Xu suddenly interrupted Zuo Cidian’s words.

“Doctor Ling is not a doctor in the field of general surgery. He does not perform stomach cancer surgery.” Zuo Cidian paused and instead questioned him, “Why do you want Doctor Ling to perform stomach cancer surgery for you?”

“Isn’t it said that Doctor Ling’s surgeries are done well? And the prognosis is consistently good. The daily amount of exercise of the Police Dog Squad is still quite extensive, and what I’m thinking is that we must have a good body to be able to get through it. I can’t just kick the bucket after receiving one operation,” Old Xu said with a smile. “Kicking the bucket has always been my second choice. But it’s better that I only kick the bucket when I’m older. I’ll be able to tolerate loneliness better by then.”

Zuo Cidian nodded subconsciously. If it were a surgery that Ling Ran was good at, he would have no qualms suggesting Old Xu to be operated by Ling Ran. However, stomach cancer surgery was really not Ling Ran’s forte. At least, he had not seen Ling Ran perform a stomach surgery before.

In comparison, Associate Department Director Ouyang of the General Surgery Department might just be an associate chief physician, but he had more than ten years of experience as a surgeon. The rarest thing about him was that he had performed stomach surgery all year round. He had accumulated experience of thousands of cases of stomach cancer surgery alone. This was his capital as to why he was able to settle down in Yun Hua Hospital, and even if he was placed at a province which had a stronger General Surgery Department, he would still be able to remain as a unique and powerful existence.
A smile appeared on Old Xu’s face. “Can Doctor Ling perform the surgery on me...?”

“That’s not what I mean.” Zuo Cidian wanted badly to slap himself and said quickly, “I mean, originally, looking for Doctor Ling is a correct choice, and it shows that you still have a clear head. But the classification of this disease is very wide. There are many types of stomach cancer surgery. Doctor Ling has never performed stomach cancer surgery before, and hence, he cannot do it for you. ”
“If that’s the case ...” Old Xu smiled and did not force the issue anymore.
The captain and Qin Min also comforted him in whispers.
Old Xu’s condition was not bad. After his initial discomfort, his voice became louder.
Not long after, Associate Department Director Ouyang of the General Surgery Department brought a resident doctor to the ward in the Emergency Medical Center.
Zuo Cidian hurried to drag Ling Ran, who was performing a ward round, over.

Several people gathered around Old Xu to perform another physical examination on him, and he read the examination report again. Of course, this time, the report was much more comprehensive, and the results of the spiral CT scan definitely confirmed the existence of stomach cancer.

“Let’s have the surgery as soon as possible. The location is okay, but we’ll have to think further about how we’re going to perform the surgery...” Director Ouyang was about fifty years old, his hair was half white, and he looked like he was about to retire. If it were not for him being in the General Surgery Department and he was in a less competitive department, he would have become a chief physician much earlier than he did.
Associate Department Director Ouyang had seen similar CT scans like the one in front of him countless times, so he made his decision very quickly.
Old Xu just nodded. If he were forced to speak about the four symptoms when a dog was sick, he could talk about it with clarity and great fluency, but he could not diagnose his own condition.
Qin Min looked helpless and thought for a while. She quietly moved to Ling Ran, and said quietly, “Doctor Ling, if you can, can you perform the operation for Old Xu?”
Ling Ran looked at Qin Min.

Qin Min boldly looked at Ling Ran and said, “I have been to the ward, and the patients and family members say that your surgery is effective. I know you don’t like to perform cancer surgeries, but if you can do it ...”
Ling Ran remained silent.

Qin Min seemingly mumbled to herself beside Ling Ran’s ears, “Old Xu is particularly afraid of death because he was an orphan in his youth, so he kept saying that he must not make his son an orphan. When he was in the criminal police force, he had a great future ahead of him, but as soon as his son was born, he immediately applied to be in the police dog unit. Who knew that...”
Ling Ran quietly opened the system interface, and his gaze went to the remaining two Intermediate Treasure Chests.
If he were required to perform stomach cancer surgery, he could acquire the relevant skills in those two treasure chests.
