chapters.title: Chapter 813: Become Your Helper
paragraphs: “Shall we move him to the General Surgery Department’s ward?” Associate Department Director Ouyang offered. As sincere as he was, some part of him hoped to have Ling Ran indebted to him, one way or another.

In a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital, the rooms in the wards were never enough. Even the weakling He Yuanzheng from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery would still need extra beds most of the time, and it was even more so for the General Surgery Department.
Of course, compared with other small diseases, cancer patients were regarded with more importance by the departments, and Associate Department Director Ouyang himself was willing to receive them.
Ling Ran did not immediately answer.

If the operation was to be performed by the General Surgery Department, it was natural that Officer Xu should be handed over to the General Surgery Department. This was not only a problem regarding hospital beds, but also a problem of specialization in the medical field. In a stomach cancer operation, three surgeons, an anesthetist, and two nurses were just the bare minimal lineup needed. If the surgery were to be a little more complicated, it would be common to add one person in each category, which would then mean that six to nine people were required to perform the operation. With so many people, one could not expect everyone to know everything, hence it would be better for the patient if placed in the department which was more familiar with the kind of operation and surgical method needed.

Even a senior associate department director such as Associate Department Director Ouyang focused mainly on the field of stomach and intestines. He was not even involved with surgeries on the esophagus and pancreas.
The follow-up care and recovery process of the patient will be even more reliant on nurses who were familiar with the situation.
This made Ling Ran a little hesitant to open the Intermediate Treasure Chest.
However, his hesitation was only momentary. In the next second, Ling Ran gave an order to the system, “Open!”

If Ling Ran were still a newcomer, he may not have made such a decision. After all, even if a Master Level related skill came out of the treasure chest, he may not be necessarily better than Associate Department Director Ouyang’s skill.

Ling Ran was not too familiar with Associate Department Director Ouyang as of now, but from the information he gathered here and there about him, in terms of stomach cancer surgery alone, Associate Department Director Ouyang was at most at Master Level, and he might even be at High Master Level. Since stomach surgery was relatively simple, it was not on the same order of magnitude with surgeries like hepatectomy. In addition, Associate Department Director Ouyang had performed a large enough number of surgeries, and Yun Hua Hospital’s General Surgery Department was also a strong department. If Ling Ran only evaluated him based on his level when it came to stomach cancer surgery, Associate Department Director Ouyang was definitely at national level.
However, if Ling Ran can obtain the corresponding techniques and pair with supporting skills, Associate Department Director Ouyang would not have that advantage.
First of all, hundreds of years of abdominal anatomical dissection experience could rival the accumulation of experience a Master Level surgeon had.

Take car repair as an example, Associate Department Director Ouyang would at most have repaired the cylinder hundreds or thousands of times. Ling Ran’s anatomical experience was equivalent to playing with the engine from head to tail by disassembling them hundreds of times, and since different people had different physiological structures, the gap in this experience will only be greater when it was transferred to the human body.
In addition, the existence of Virtual Humans was an extreme bug in the medical world.

Although Ling Ran was now left with only around three hours for his Virtual Human, the time could compare to the value of an Intermediate Treasure Chest, and it could be considered an incredibly rare consumable, and it was really very useful. It would only take a few minutes to eliminate a lot of mistakes.
In contrast, the ability to read various scans was more ordinary and more suitable for providing information to Associate Department Director Ouyang ...
In front of Ling Ran, a bright light emerged.
Two Intermediate Treasure Chests and 312 Basic Treasure Chests paved a golden avenue.
Ling Ran immediately saw a skill book in the middle.
There were 314 treasure chests, and only one skill book was found.
Ling Ran frowned slightly and thought, ‘With such a low skill book to everything else ratio, if the skill that came out is not useful for the moment, then this ratio simply can’t be justified.’
The golden wave of light in front of Ling Ran trembled slightly.
‘I’ll look at the skill book first.’ Ling Ran raised his chin as he watched the blue shining skill book open, and a line of words appeared on the title page.
[Comprehensive Skill Book: Gastrectomy (Master Level): Comprehensive techniques include “subtotal gastrectomy”, “total gastrectomy”, “partial gastrectomy”, “gastric antrum removal” and other skills.]
Ling Ran nodded when he saw the comprehensive technique. He now needed more than just a gastrectomy. Now that he had a comprehensive skill book, the system could only be described as very thoughtful.
“Doctor Ling?” Associate Department Director Ouyang waited for a long time before Ling Ran responded and was slightly unhappy, since he was the one called Associate Department Director Ouyang over.

“Associate Department Director Ouyang.” After Ling Ran collected the skill book and put away a whole land of pure Energy Serum and a four-hour Virtual Human into his pocket, he said, “I think we should have the Emergency Medical Center as the place to perform this operation.”

“The Emergency Medical Center as the main operating place?” Associate Department Director Ouyang frowned and was even more unhappy as he asked, “Who do you want to invite to be the freelance surgeon?”

As a gastrointestinal expert, especially a person with high experience in stomach cancer resection, Associate Department Director Ouyang could debate with any expert in the related field in the country.

Under these circumstances, he did not feel that Ling Ran should look for foreign aid. If the patient’s family was the one who requested it, Associate Department Director Ouyang would usually not be too opposed to it, since he also often went to big cities to perform freelance surgery. However, if the request was raised by a doctor, Associate Department Director Ouyang felt that he had the right to be unhappy about it.
“I’ll do it myself,” Ling Ran answered.
Qin Min and Old Xu’s eyes lit up.
Almost instantly, a system prompt appeared in front of Ling Ran.
[Achievement: A patient’s sincere gratitude.]
[Achievement Description: A patient’s sincere gratitude is the biggest reward to a doctor.]
[Reward: Basic Treasure Chest]
Ling Ran could not help but look at Old Xu again. He had not expected this person to be Treasure Chest’s spamming trigger.
Associate Department Director Ouyang’s eyes narrowed.
If they were not in front of the patient, Associate Department Director Ouyang would have questioned Ling Ran. ‘Have you ever performed a stomach cancer surgery before?’

However, after being a doctor for so many years, Associate Department Director Ouyang would never be so stupid to stir up conflict with other doctors in front of the patient. If Ling Ran were a young doctor, he would just pick on him for fun, but a doctor like Ling Ran could not be humiliated.

No matter how incredible Ouyang was, he was still just an associate chief physician of the General Surgery Department and the leader of a treatment group. He was not even as great in status compared to the General Surgery Department’s He Yuanzheng...
When he thought of He Yuanzheng, Ouyang Kan shuddered again.

Everyone knew how the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery was being abused by Ling Ran right now. If it were not for Old Huo and Ling Ran’s tremendous influence, everyone would speak up for justice.
Of course, when the people who cannot speak up for justice and could not win against Ling Ran and Director Huo looked at Ling Ran and Huo Congjun, they could feel just how awe-inspiring they were.
Ouyang Kan changed his mind and asked, “Doctor Ling, are you going to perform the stomach cancer surgery alone yourself? Are you confident?”

“If you’re willing to help, Associate Department Director Ouyang, I’ll be more confident.” It was rare for Ling Ran to extend an invitation. After all, although he obtained suitable skills, the success rate would be higher if he had the associate director of the General Surgery Department helping him.
Ouyang Kan’s first thought was to refuse and ridicule Ling Ran. ‘What a joke, I am one of the best stomach cancer experts in Changxi Province, and you want me to be your assistant?’
But when he looked into Ling Ran’s eyes, especially when thinking about Ling Ran’s record, and then realizing Ling Ran’s age, Ouyang Kan unexpectedly said, “If you insist, I can be your assistant.”

sentences.text: “Shall we move him to the General Surgery Department’s ward?” Associate Department Director Ouyang offered.
As sincere as he was, some part of him hoped to have Ling Ran indebted to him, one way or another.
In a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital, the rooms in the wards were never enough.
Even the weakling He Yuanzheng from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery would still need extra beds most of the time, and it was even more so for the General Surgery Department.
Of course, compared with other small diseases, cancer patients were regarded with more importance by the departments, and Associate Department Director Ouyang himself was willing to receive them.
Ling Ran did not immediately answer.
If the operation was to be performed by the General Surgery Department, it was natural that Officer Xu should be handed over to the General Surgery Department.
This was not only a problem regarding hospital beds, but also a problem of specialization in the medical field.
In a stomach cancer operation, three surgeons, an anesthetist, and two nurses were just the bare minimal lineup needed.
If the surgery were to be a little more complicated, it would be common to add one person in each category, which would then mean that six to nine people were required to perform the operation.

With so many people, one could not expect everyone to know everything, hence it would be better for the patient if placed in the department which was more familiar with the kind of operation and surgical method needed.
Even a senior associate department director such as Associate Department Director Ouyang focused mainly on the field of stomach and intestines.
He was not even involved with surgeries on the esophagus and pancreas.
The follow-up care and recovery process of the patient will be even more reliant on nurses who were familiar with the situation.
This made Ling Ran a little hesitant to open the Intermediate Treasure Chest.
However, his hesitation was only momentary.
In the next second, Ling Ran gave an order to the system, “Open!”
If Ling Ran were still a newcomer, he may not have made such a decision.
After all, even if a Master Level related skill came out of the treasure chest, he may not be necessarily better than Associate Department Director Ouyang’s skill.

Ling Ran was not too familiar with Associate Department Director Ouyang as of now, but from the information he gathered here and there about him, in terms of stomach cancer surgery alone, Associate Department Director Ouyang was at most at Master Level, and he might even be at High Master Level.
Since stomach surgery was relatively simple, it was not on the same order of magnitude with surgeries like hepatectomy.
In addition, Associate Department Director Ouyang had performed a large enough number of surgeries, and Yun Hua Hospital’s General Surgery Department was also a strong department.
If Ling Ran only evaluated him based on his level when it came to stomach cancer surgery, Associate Department Director Ouyang was definitely at national level.
However, if Ling Ran can obtain the corresponding techniques and pair with supporting skills, Associate Department Director Ouyang would not have that advantage.
First of all, hundreds of years of abdominal anatomical dissection experience could rival the accumulation of experience a Master Level surgeon had.
Take car repair as an example, Associate Department Director Ouyang would at most have repaired the cylinder hundreds or thousands of times.

Ling Ran’s anatomical experience was equivalent to playing with the engine from head to tail by disassembling them hundreds of times, and since different people had different physiological structures, the gap in this experience will only be greater when it was transferred to the human body.
In addition, the existence of Virtual Humans was an extreme bug in the medical world.

Although Ling Ran was now left with only around three hours for his Virtual Human, the time could compare to the value of an Intermediate Treasure Chest, and it could be considered an incredibly rare consumable, and it was really very useful.
It would only take a few minutes to eliminate a lot of mistakes.
In contrast, the ability to read various scans was more ordinary and more suitable for providing information to Associate Department Director Ouyang ...
In front of Ling Ran, a bright light emerged.
Two Intermediate Treasure Chests and 312 Basic Treasure Chests paved a golden avenue.
Ling Ran immediately saw a skill book in the middle.
There were 314 treasure chests, and only one skill book was found.
Ling Ran frowned slightly and thought, ‘With such a low skill book to everything else ratio, if the skill that came out is not useful for the moment, then this ratio simply can’t be justified.’
The golden wave of light in front of Ling Ran trembled slightly.
‘I’ll look at the skill book first.’ Ling Ran raised his chin as he watched the blue shining skill book open, and a line of words appeared on the title page.
[Comprehensive Skill Book: Gastrectomy (Master Level): Comprehensive techniques include “subtotal gastrectomy”, “total gastrectomy”, “partial gastrectomy”, “gastric antrum removal” and other skills.]
Ling Ran nodded when he saw the comprehensive technique.
He now needed more than just a gastrectomy.
Now that he had a comprehensive skill book, the system could only be described as very thoughtful.
“Doctor Ling?” Associate Department Director Ouyang waited for a long time before Ling Ran responded and was slightly unhappy, since he was the one called Associate Department Director Ouyang over.

“Associate Department Director Ouyang.” After Ling Ran collected the skill book and put away a whole land of pure Energy Serum and a four-hour Virtual Human into his pocket, he said, “I think we should have the Emergency Medical Center as the place to perform this operation.”

“The Emergency Medical Center as the main operating place?” Associate Department Director Ouyang frowned and was even more unhappy as he asked, “Who do you want to invite to be the freelance surgeon?”

As a gastrointestinal expert, especially a person with high experience in stomach cancer resection, Associate Department Director Ouyang could debate with any expert in the related field in the country.
Under these circumstances, he did not feel that Ling Ran should look for foreign aid.
If the patient’s family was the one who requested it, Associate Department Director Ouyang would usually not be too opposed to it, since he also often went to big cities to perform freelance surgery.
However, if the request was raised by a doctor, Associate Department Director Ouyang felt that he had the right to be unhappy about it.
“I’ll do it myself,” Ling Ran answered.
Qin Min and Old Xu’s eyes lit up.
Almost instantly, a system prompt appeared in front of Ling Ran.
[Achievement: A patient’s sincere gratitude.]
[Achievement Description: A patient’s sincere gratitude is the biggest reward to a doctor.]
[Reward: Basic Treasure Chest]
Ling Ran could not help but look at Old Xu again.
He had not expected this person to be Treasure Chest’s spamming trigger.
Associate Department Director Ouyang’s eyes narrowed.
If they were not in front of the patient, Associate Department Director Ouyang would have questioned Ling Ran.
‘Have you ever performed a stomach cancer surgery before?’
However, after being a doctor for so many years, Associate Department Director Ouyang would never be so stupid to stir up conflict with other doctors in front of the patient.
If Ling Ran were a young doctor, he would just pick on him for fun, but a doctor like Ling Ran could not be humiliated.
No matter how incredible Ouyang was, he was still just an associate chief physician of the General Surgery Department and the leader of a treatment group.
He was not even as great in status compared to the General Surgery Department’s He Yuanzheng...
When he thought of He Yuanzheng, Ouyang Kan shuddered again.
Everyone knew how the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery was being abused by Ling Ran right now.
If it were not for Old Huo and Ling Ran’s tremendous influence, everyone would speak up for justice.
Of course, when the people who cannot speak up for justice and could not win against Ling Ran and Director Huo looked at Ling Ran and Huo Congjun, they could feel just how awe-inspiring they were.
Ouyang Kan changed his mind and asked, “Doctor Ling, are you going to perform the stomach cancer surgery alone yourself?
Are you confident?”
“If you’re willing to help, Associate Department Director Ouyang, I’ll be more confident.” It was rare for Ling Ran to extend an invitation.
After all, although he obtained suitable skills, the success rate would be higher if he had the associate director of the General Surgery Department helping him.
Ouyang Kan’s first thought was to refuse and ridicule Ling Ran.
‘What a joke, I am one of the best stomach cancer experts in Changxi Province, and you want me to be your assistant?’
But when he looked into Ling Ran’s eyes, especially when thinking about Ling Ran’s record, and then realizing Ling Ran’s age, Ouyang Kan unexpectedly said, “If you insist, I can be your assistant.”

chapters.title: Chapter 814: Chief Surgeon Ling Ran
paragraphs: After Old Xu was placed in the Emergency Medical Center’s ward, the entire department started moving into action.

It was partly due to surprise and curiosity, but it was mostly for the sake of efficiency. The Emergency Department had never performed stomach cancer surgery before. The assistants in Ling Ran’s treatment group had never done it. The nurses in the department had never nursed such patients before. So at the moment, it was obvious if those who needed to learn would try to learn what they could, and those who needed assistants will immediately go and ask for one.

No one would say that it was unreasonable for Ling Ran to perform a stomach cancer surgery. Most people were not qualified to say this. Furthermore, everyone had seen how Ling Ran performed various surgeries from appendectomy to hepatectomy in a little over two years. They all knew that he was someone who would delve into a new field soon, but never did they expect it to be related to cancer.

Moreover, for other people in the department, it was also surgery on the stomach. Operating on stomach cancer had higher benefits than on a stomach ulcer, just like how operating on liver cancer will have higher bonuses than just operating on the liver alone. At present, more than one-third of the bonuses in Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center depended on Ling Ran’s treatment group. When Ling Ran wanted to start operating on a surgery that provided higher benefits, everyone would naturally be more inclined to cooperate.

Huo Congjun was attending a meeting and only managed to scold half of the people there when he received the news. He hurried back to Yun Hua Hospital. After he found Ling Ran, his first thing was to ask, “You’re going to perform a stomach cancer surgery?”
“Yes, Department Director Ouyang also promised to be my assistant,” Ling Ran answered very comprehensively.
“Is it Ouyang Kan?”
“Yes.”

“Oh, Ouyang Kan is that easy to talk to?” Huo Congjun’s nervousness was relieved instantly. For senior surgeons, learning a new surgical method was not as complicated as it would be to a young doctor. This was like how a senior repairman who focused on repairing cars would encounter countless problems when he was sent to repair a tank, but the speed at which he entered Novice Level and Specialist Level will be much shorter than a young newcomer.

If an analogy was needed, a doctor who could do hepatectomy was at least equivalent to a senior engineer who could repair a ship. Forget about changing to another type of ship, even if he was to change to a completely different vehicle and needed to repair an aircraft, as long as someone was guiding him, his learning progress would also be blazing.
The most important thing was that if Ouyang Kan was present, even if Ling Ran did not do it well, at least there would be someone else to cover for him, and Huo Congjun would not panic.
“What are you thinking of? Why did you suddenly want to perform stomach cancer surgery?” Huo Congjun asked again, “You can’t even finish all the surgeries as it is now.”

“We don’t have enough hospital beds now.” Ling Ran’s expression was calm, and he had so many remaining Energy Serums that they were becoming moldy, but the Emergency Medical Center hospital beds were becoming more scarce.
Huo Congjun froze, he chuckled after a moment, changed the topic quickly, and said, “What’s the situation with the patient?”

He has been the department director for many years, and knew for a fact that the management of a department needed to place a high importance on surgeries, but the operation was ultimately the patient’s business.
Ling Ran naturally would not hide the facts, and he described the situation thoroughly as it was and said, “It was the patient’s request. I am also willing to perform a gastrectomy on him...”
“You haven’t performed a stomach cancer operation before, does the patient know?”
“He knows.”

“Let Ouyang Kan perform the surgery and you can become his assistant. Will the effect be better if that’s the way?” When Huo Congjun heard that Officer Xu was the only son of someone who died for the country, his words and his perception changed slightly. He was originally a military doctor and still had a lot of affection for the disciplined services.
Ling Ran shook his head without hesitation. “I can do it better.”

The chief surgeon was the doctor who would decide the overall idea of ?? the surgery and would also have absolute authority over a surgery. Ling Ran would not have bothered if he had not mastered gastrectomy, but now that he had the relevant skills, then, when it came to the surgical approach, the operation, the choice of the resection range, the control of the surgical process, and lymphadenectomy, Ling Ran’s skills surpassed Ouyang Kan’s in all these areas.

In terms of surgical experience, Ling Ran, who had performed nearly a thousand cases of hepatectomy, can look down on Ouyang Kan, who had done nearly a thousand cases of gastrectomy, no matter what situation they were in.

In the surgical chain of contempt, operating on the stomach was a bit more advanced than removing feces, but the range of the advancement was only about as much as the distance from the stomach to the intestine. If you used the contents in the stomach to describe the surgery, it can be said to be a semi-feces removal surgery, and when listening to that term alone, it might actually sound rather high end.

The only place where Ouyang Kan had an advantage was that he had performed more stomach cancer surgeries and understood the operation better. But this advantage, compared to the skills mastered by Ling Ran, was just a small weight on the scales. This was just like the surgeons in the American system. After the end of their resident doctor career, once they have become attending physicians, they will be focused on achieving hegemony in departments with different focuses. They will do hepatectomy today and gastrectomy tomorrow, and this was very common. Powerful doctors can even operate from the brain all the way to the urinary tract.

Of course, this was also because the number of surgeons in the United States was scarce, and the number of surgeons that they can afford in a hospital was not high. But since the surgeons in the United States can perform operations in multiple departments and maintain a certain standard, Ling Ran was confident that the variety of skills he currently possessed will definitely bring better medical results than Ouyang Kan.
Ouyang Kan was never a talented surgeon, he was just an excellent doctor who followed the rules.

This kind of excellence can make him stand out during medical school when he was studying and be assigned to the best hospital in Changxi Province, became the fastest to rise to power as an attending physician and then an associate chief physician in his batch. But that was about it. In terms of being a genius, at the national level, even saying He Yuanzheng was a genius because he managed to become a department director in his forties was a bit of a stretch, because he only managed to get to his position because of coincidence.

A strong genius doctor would be someone who can publish seven papers in The New England Journal of Medicine in five years, develop a new technique in three years, and re-create new standards in the related disciplines every fifteen years.
Ling Ran was not familiar with Ouyang Kan, but when he was sure that his skills were better than his, he did not hesitate to say, “There would be a higher success rate if I’m the chief surgeon.”
“Let’s not joke around.” Huo Congjun seriously sought for a confirmation again.
Ling Ran stared at Huo Congjun’s expression without answering.
Department Director Huo laughed out loud. “I’m just kidding, I know you’re not joking.”
Ling Ran still just silently looked at Department Director Huo.
Huo Congjun laughed and sighed again. “In this case, you have to speak to Ouyang Kan nicely. Does he have any requirements?”
“No,” Ling Ran answered.
Huo Congjun laughed, picked up his phone, and called Zuo Cidian.
A few minutes later, Huo Congjun put down his phone and said in surprise, “Associate Department Director Ouyang really doesn’t have any requirements and is willing to be an assistant?”
Ling Ran did not answer.

Huo Congjun still said to himself, “If he is going to participate in the preoperative consultation, then he would be able to give some advice on techniques, and then act as your assistant while also serving as backup? Is this person so easy to be bullied?”
Ling Ran raised an eyebrow.
Huo Congjun’s expression gradually lit up, “It’s not easy to find such a doctor who is so easy to bully now. Ling Ran, you did well, you did well!”
“I only plan to perform an operation on Officer Xu.” Ling Ran felt that Huo Congjun was straying from the topic.
Huo Congjun just gave a hearty laugh, like an emerald Pixiu rolling about in an elderly tour group.

chapters.title: Chapter 815: Using a Laparoscope
paragraphs: “Radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope? No way, it’s way too risky!” Even though Ouyang Kan was an amicable person, he stopped acting so five minutes into the preoperative consultation.
As expected, the department director of the General Surgery Department, two attending physicians, and a resident doctor who were sitting beside him sat still without saying a thing.

Huo Congjun merely froze for a moment before he smiled in relief. No matter how amicable certain surgeons were, there was definitely a limit to it, and Ouyang Kan had reached his limit. Huo Congjun felt that Ouyang Kan was already considered a pushover for being able to withhold his temper to this extent.

Of course, associate chief physicians or even chief physicians of small departments might not really be capable of bullying him. But Huo Congjun was capable of doing so, and from his perspective, he was very satisfied with how soft Ouyang Kan was as a person.

Ling Ran, who was sitting beside Huo Congjun, though, did not seem like he was the slightest bit affected by Ouyang Kan’s attitude. He continued pointing at the Powerpoint slide with a laser pointer and said, “There are two main reasons why I’m choosing to carry out the radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope. First of all, the patient is still in the early stages of stomach cancer, so the boundaries of the malignant growth are clear enough. With a laparoscope, we will inflict less damage to the patient’s body. Secondly, I am very good at lymphadenectomy.”

Ouyang Kan was about to raise the issue of lymphadenectomy anyway, and after he heard Ling Ran’s reply, he got so exasperated that he laughed. “This means that you know about the issues that we will face if we were to carry out the radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope too. But lymphadenectomy is a world-class problem. To ensure a good survival rate and reduce the chances of recurrence, you have to make sure that all the lymph nodes around the malignant tumor are removed, and this is very difficult. You also have to remove all the cancerous cells that are scattered around the abdominal cavity, and this is even more difficult...”

“However, I’m very good at lymphadenectomy too.” Even though Ling Ran’s reply made it sound to outsiders like he was trying to start an argument with Ouyang Kan, he was indeed confident in his abilities. After all, he possessed Perfect Level Lymphadenectomy, and this skill could be utilized regardless of whether he was using a laparoscope or carrying out open surgery.

Ouyang Kan did not believe in Ling Ran’s abilities. He shook his head and said, “I agreed to play second fiddle to you because I was worried that something like this would happen. Doctor Ling, I know that you have operated on patients with liver cancer before. But operating on patients with liver cancer and operating on patients with stomach cancer are different, after all. If you insist on operating on the patient using a laparoscope, I would like to ask you to transfer the patient under my care. This way, we can talk properly to the patient too...”

“Ouyang.” The department director of the General Surgery Department had made up his mind earlier not to say anything. However, right now, he had no other choice except to speak, “Since Doctor Ling said that he will not have a problem when it comes to lymphadenectomy, why don’t we decide on this first and see where the discussion takes us...”

“There wouldn’t be any point in that. It’s very troublesome to perform lymphadenectomy when a laparoscope is used for the surgery. Now that we can’t even decide on whether to use a laparoscope or carry out an open surgery, there wouldn’t be any point in continuing the discussion...”
“You’ve never seen Doctor Ling carry out a hepatectomy before, have you?” The department director of the General Surgery Department cut Ouyang Kan off again.
Ouyang Kan hesitated for a few seconds and said, “I’ve watched him carry out a hepatectomy as well as an Achilles tendon repair surgery...”

“Please find a video of Doctor Ling performing lymphadenectomy during a hepatectomy and play it. Doctor Ouyang is quite a stubborn man, and it would help to show him a video,” the director of the General Surgery Department requested. The doctors from the Emergency Department glanced at Huo Congjun and started searching for a video.

The director of the General Surgery Department shook his head, a little resigned. The main reason doctors like Ouyang Kan were becoming slower and slower when it came to improving their skills was because they were always busy working instead of learning. Ouyang Kan was always busy carrying out surgeries to accumulate experience, but he never bothered becoming a spectator to other surgeons’ surgeries.
That may be why Ouyang Kan became a pretty good doctor, but it was also why he had hit a brick wall in terms of getting further ahead on his path as a doctor.

It only took Yu Yuan a very short time to find a video of Ling Ran performing a hepatectomy. She introduced the video, “Doctor Ling carried out this hepatectomy in Beijing, and he is using the Ling Hepatectomy Technique that he established. This technique involves carrying out pathological examination during the duration of the hepatectomy, and it is used in many hospitals in Beijing including the Second Affiliated Hospital of Beijing Medical University right now. At the moment, this technique is also being tried out in other countries including the United Kingdom.
After Yu Yuan finished her introduction, everyone in the room immediately became silent.

Yu Yuan raised her head when she saw this, pleased with herself. She then looked around and said slowly, “Due to time constraints, I will fast forward to the part where Doctor Ling performs lymphadenectomy.”
As she spoke, she slid the circle icon on the timeline and fast-forwarded the video.
The meeting room was silent.

On the screen, the surgical field could be seen clearly. It almost looked clean. The lymph nodes, which were about the size of a grain of rice were removed one after another. Even though Ling Ran did not clear large areas at once, the surgery was going very smoothly, and it was obvious that he was extremely familiar with the anatomical structures in the abdominal cavity.
Ouyang Kan immediately went into a daze when he saw that.

Ouyang Kan proclaimed himself as one of the top experts in Changxi Province when it came to stomach cancer, and he had performed lymphadenectomy countless times. He had also watched countless doctors carry out lymphadenectomy. Hence, he was utterly shocked the moment he saw Ling Ran’s maneuvers.
A surgeon who could achieve this excellence was definitely extremely familiar with the anatomical structures in the abdominal cavity. He definitely understood the patient’s condition very well too.
Ouyang Kan could not help but blurt out, “Where did you grow up in?”
Ling Ran answered truthfully, “Lower Groove Clinic.”
“What?” Ouyang Kan was puzzle.d
The attending physician sitting beside Ouyang Kan was a young man. He could not help but mutter, “Don’t even ask. You’re making yourself sound like a ‘genius’.”
“Those who are genii don’t need to be proven as genii at all, you know?” Ouyang Kan responded. He did not understand the attending physician’s sarcasm at all.
“Aspirate.”
On the screen, the surgery continued.

The speed in recovery alone meant that the patient could go through chemotherapy earlier, and he can even use medication which required him to have a higher body tolerance. sentences.text: “Radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope?
No way, it’s way too risky!” Even though Ouyang Kan was an amicable person, he stopped acting so five minutes into the preoperative consultation.
As expected, the department director of the General Surgery Department, two attending physicians, and a resident doctor who were sitting beside him sat still without saying a thing.
Huo Congjun merely froze for a moment before he smiled in relief.
No matter how amicable certain surgeons were, there was definitely a limit to it, and Ouyang Kan had reached his limit.
Huo Congjun felt that Ouyang Kan was already considered a pushover for being able to withhold his temper to this extent.
Of course, associate chief physicians or even chief physicians of small departments might not really be capable of bullying him.
But Huo Congjun was capable of doing so, and from his perspective, he was very satisfied with how soft Ouyang Kan was as a person.
Ling Ran, who was sitting beside Huo Congjun, though, did not seem like he was the slightest bit affected by Ouyang Kan’s attitude.
He continued pointing at the Powerpoint slide with a laser pointer and said, “There are two main reasons why I’m choosing to carry out the radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope.
First of all, the patient is still in the early stages of stomach cancer, so the boundaries of the malignant growth are clear enough.
With a laparoscope, we will inflict less damage to the patient’s body.
Secondly, I am very good at lymphadenectomy.”
Ouyang Kan was about to raise the issue of lymphadenectomy anyway, and after he heard Ling Ran’s reply, he got so exasperated that he laughed.
“This means that you know about the issues that we will face if we were to carry out the radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope too.
But lymphadenectomy is a world-class problem.
To ensure a good survival rate and reduce the chances of recurrence, you have to make sure that all the lymph nodes around the malignant tumor are removed, and this is very difficult.
You also have to remove all the cancerous cells that are scattered around the abdominal cavity, and this is even more difficult...”

“However, I’m very good at lymphadenectomy too.” Even though Ling Ran’s reply made it sound to outsiders like he was trying to start an argument with Ouyang Kan, he was indeed confident in his abilities.
After all, he possessed Perfect Level Lymphadenectomy, and this skill could be utilized regardless of whether he was using a laparoscope or carrying out open surgery.
Ouyang Kan did not believe in Ling Ran’s abilities.
He shook his head and said, “I agreed to play second fiddle to you because I was worried that something like this would happen.
Doctor Ling, I know that you have operated on patients with liver cancer before.
But operating on patients with liver cancer and operating on patients with stomach cancer are different, after all.
If you insist on operating on the patient using a laparoscope, I would like to ask you to transfer the patient under my care.
This way, we can talk properly to the patient too...”
“Ouyang.” The department director of the General Surgery Department had made up his mind earlier not to say anything.

However, right now, he had no other choice except to speak, “Since Doctor Ling said that he will not have a problem when it comes to lymphadenectomy, why don’t we decide on this first and see where the discussion takes us...”
“There wouldn’t be any point in that.
It’s very troublesome to perform lymphadenectomy when a laparoscope is used for the surgery.
Now that we can’t even decide on whether to use a laparoscope or carry out an open surgery, there wouldn’t be any point in continuing the discussion...”
“You’ve never seen Doctor Ling carry out a hepatectomy before, have you?” The department director of the General Surgery Department cut Ouyang Kan off again.
Ouyang Kan hesitated for a few seconds and said, “I’ve watched him carry out a hepatectomy as well as an Achilles tendon repair surgery...”
“Please find a video of Doctor Ling performing lymphadenectomy during a hepatectomy and play it.
Doctor Ouyang is quite a stubborn man, and it would help to show him a video,” the director of the General Surgery Department requested.
The doctors from the Emergency Department glanced at Huo Congjun and started searching for a video.
The director of the General Surgery Department shook his head, a little resigned.
The main reason doctors like Ouyang Kan were becoming slower and slower when it came to improving their skills was because they were always busy working instead of learning.
Ouyang Kan was always busy carrying out surgeries to accumulate experience, but he never bothered becoming a spectator to other surgeons’ surgeries.
That may be why Ouyang Kan became a pretty good doctor, but it was also why he had hit a brick wall in terms of getting further ahead on his path as a doctor.
It only took Yu Yuan a very short time to find a video of Ling Ran performing a hepatectomy.
She introduced the video, “Doctor Ling carried out this hepatectomy in Beijing, and he is using the Ling Hepatectomy Technique that he established.

This technique involves carrying out pathological examination during the duration of the hepatectomy, and it is used in many hospitals in Beijing including the Second Affiliated Hospital of Beijing Medical University right now.
At the moment, this technique is also being tried out in other countries including the United Kingdom.
After Yu Yuan finished her introduction, everyone in the room immediately became silent.
Yu Yuan raised her head when she saw this, pleased with herself.
She then looked around and said slowly, “Due to time constraints, I will fast forward to the part where Doctor Ling performs lymphadenectomy.”
As she spoke, she slid the circle icon on the timeline and fast-forwarded the video.
The meeting room was silent.
On the screen, the surgical field could be seen clearly.

The lymph nodes, which were about the size of a grain of rice were removed one after another.

He definitely understood the patient’s condition very well too.
Ouyang Kan could not help but blurt out, “Where did you grow up in?”
Ling Ran answered truthfully, “Lower Groove Clinic.”

chapters.title: Chapter 816: Greeting
paragraphs: Chestnut, the police dog walked arrogantly as it patrolled the area around Yun Hua Hospital.

It liked the place quite a lot. There were neither other dogs nor other feeders. It could go anywhere it wanted to, and it could roll on the ground as it pleased. If it were in the mood, it could also hump a pillar or even flash a fierce grimace. No one would care.
If Chestnut had a diary, it would probably rate the day four out of five. It was the pinnacle of its life as a dog indeed.
If it were not for the fact that a goose pecked its neck for 3.17 seconds, it would definitely rate the day five out of five.
Qin Min was holding Chestnut’s leash with one hand, and she followed the dog whenever it went in a leisurely manner. She did not seem like she was heading anywhere.
She did not really feel like heading to the ward.

The conditions in the ward were by no means bad. Ever since the inception of Yun Hua Medical Center, most wards only had to accommodate three patients. The interior of the ward was spacious and bright, and it also came equipped with a private bathroom and other facilities. It was even more comfortable compared to the rooms most people rented. However, the atmosphere in the ward was way too dreary. This was especially true after Old Xu’s wife and children arrived.

Old Xu’s family was actually quite well off. He had two houses, one in the city center and one in the outskirts. He also had sizeable savings and a car. Even though his wife was no longer working as she was staying together with his son who was studying somewhere else, he had money to spare every month as he had rented one of his houses out.
However, no one in the police force was jealous of Old Xu’s family.

His house in the city center was what his parents left behind, and his house on the outskirts was given to him by the government. It was among the last batch of houses that the government gave to children of parents who had sacrificed their lives for the country. As for his savings... the money came from his parents’ pension.
No one in the police force wanted to inherit money under such circumstances. Even Old Xu himself was not ready to let his son inherit his money either.
Qin Min really could not bring herself to look at the way Old Xu talked to his son.
Even though Ling Ran was the one who would be operating on Old Xu, it was impossible for anyone to feel at ease in a ward.

“Police Officer Qin, are you here to visit your teammate again?” A resident doctor from the General Surgery Department walked over to Qin Min with a smile. While he was at it, he made some weird noises at the dog.
Chestnut did not even bother to wag its tail.
Qin Min let out a nasal hum. She then turned to leave with the dog in tow.

The resident doctor was reluctant to let her leave as he stared after her. Hence, he followed her and said with a smile, “Police Officer Qin, I know a lot of people in the hospital. If your teammate needs a checkup or something, I’m definitely the right person to talk to.”
Qin Min said in resignation, “My teammate is suffering from stomach cancer.”
The resident doctor was at a loss for words. He thought about it for a while and said, “Even patients with stomach cancer need checkups, right?”
Qin Min sighed. She was not in the mood to make small talk, to begin with, and it was even more so after she glanced at the other party’s face. She called out Chestnut’s name and continued walking.
The resident doctor thought about it for a few seconds and followed her again.

As a doctor, he had very little free time. He did not spend much time away from the hospital either. A beautiful lady like this was hard to come by, and he had to treasure this opportunity, as he would otherwise end up like Lu Wenbin from the Emergency Medical Center. Even though Lu Wenbin owned a house and a car, the most he knew how to say to a woman was, “Have you farted?”

The resident doctor calmed down and told himself to draw a lesson from Lu Wenbin’s painful experience. As he thought about this, he followed closely behind Qin Min and tried to recall all kinds of tactics a man could use to flirt with a woman.
Qin Min walked in front of the resident doctor, and both of them traversed the buildings.
Qin Min was holding Chestnut on a leash. Chestnut was wearing a mouth face mask, and it was quiet and obedient.
The resident doctor from the General Surgery Department who was walking behind Qin Min was wearing a mouth face mask, and he looked quiet and obedient too.
Qin Min glanced at him with a baffled expression and asked, “Why are you still following me? I’m starting to suspect that you’re a stalker.”

The resident doctor who was wearing a mask face mask flashed a mysterious smile. He was cackling internally. ‘This beautiful policewoman is getting curious about me, hahahahaha. I’m only one step away from successfully seducing her.”
He forcefully suppressed the surge of joy in his heart and said calmly, “I’m not stalking you. I intend to see the patient.”
“Why?” Qin Min became even more baffled.

The resident doctor said in a low voice, “To give myself a goal, I’m aiming to become the chief surgeon in a radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer. It’s one of my aims in life. When this finally becomes a reality, I’ll think of your name as I stand beside the operating table and operate on the patient...”
Qin Min looked at this resident doctor, who had a goal in life, with a profound gaze.
There was a smile on the resident doctor’s face. He was feeling as jubilant as before.

“Doctor Ling will be the chief surgeon for my teammate’s surgery today. He’s probably even younger than you...” Qin Min decided to be straightforward so that this resident doctor, who had a goal in life, would definitely understand what she was saying.

Just like many other young doctors in Yun Hua Hospital, when the resident doctor with a goal in life heard the word “Doctor Ling”, he instinctively pricked up his ears and perked up. “Doctor Ling isn’t that much younger than me. If you were to calculate how many months we have been in this world, I’m around the same age as him...”

“You look a lot older than Doctor Ling,” Qin Min said expressionlessly. She then called out Chestnut’s name and walked away from the resident doctor, who was wearing a shocked expression, with Chestnut in tow.

Qin Min left Chestnut outside the ward area. She then washed her hands and lathered some alcohol-based hand sanitizer from the bottle that was hung outside the ward on her hands before entering Old Xu’s ward.
A group of people was chatting with Old Xu.

Some of them were their teammates, and their leader was also there. There were also a few cadres from the city bureau as well as the government, and all of them filled up the ward. There were also a few representatives from among the Xu family’s distant relatives, but all of them were sitting outside the ward. They did not look perturbed.
After the group of people was done talking to Old Xu, they exited the ward. Another group of people went in and they, too, exited after a while.
Even though Old Xu was repeating the same words again and again, he was not annoyed.
Old Xu had not experienced such a lively scene for quite a while, and it was able to act as an analgesic that reduced the pain in his heart.

After another group of people left. Old Xu turned and smiled at his son. He held his son’s hand and said, “I’m alright. Have you finished your homework? You shouldn’t delay your homework anymore, or you’ll get scolded by your teachers.”

“I’ve asked for a day off.” Old Xu’s son looked around thirteen or fourteen years old, and he was somewhat but not fully mature. There was a lost expression on his face. He looked just like how Old Xu did back when something happened to Old Xu’s parents.
Old Xu forced a smile. He then raised his head and said to his wife, “Why don’t you guys head outside and take a rest? There’s no point staying inside here.”

His wife wanted to smile, but she was unable to do so. She had not seen her husband for quite a few months. She thought that she would just need to endure being away from her husband for a few more years and that she would have plenty of time together with him after her son finished university. Little did she know that fate had a way of playing games.
“Visiting hours are over. Can the patient’s family members and friends please leave? We are about to start carrying out preoperative preparations.” A nurse came in and started chasing everyone away.
Everyone immediately bade farewell to Old Xu with reluctant expressions on their faces. It was as if they might not get to see him again tomorrow.
The atmosphere in the ward was never cheery.
Qin Min had no choice but to leave after merely greeting Old Xu.

In the operating theater, the scrub nurse was checking the laparoscope. She then laid out all the medical consumables in the order of which ones would be used first. The circulating nurse was preparing some sterile water that would be used to wash the lenses during the surgery. When it was almost time for the patient to enter the operating theater, they started checking and familiarizing themselves with the equipment.

The scrub nurse who would be assisting in the operation today was from the Department of Surgery. However, the circulating nurse was from the Emergency Medical Center, as it would make things easier for Ling Ran when it came to asking for instruments and medical consumables.

The anesthetist and his assistant, too, arrived early. They were bored as they waited for the surgery to begin. When Huo Congjun came over to examine the operating theater, they put on an act and flashed an earnest expression.
Ouyang Kan who would be acting as the assistant was a little envious, for some reason.

Even though he was an associate chief physician of the General Surgery Department and an expert within Changxi Province when it came to gastric surgery, the Department of Anesthesiology had never been so cautious around him whenever he was acting as chief surgeon.

In a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital, doctors from more than ten departments carried out surgeries every day. Among them, not only were there extraordinary chief physicians and associate chief physicians from the Neurosurgery Department, but there were also rich chief physicians and associate chief physicians from the Orthopedics Department. Some were even top surgeons like Chief Physician Jin Xi from the Hand Surgery Department. The status of a treatment group’s leader in the hospital was plain to see whenever he carried out surgery. A person just had to look at whether the other departments offered him their full cooperation.
“Isn’t it great to be young? The Department of Anesthesiology is going all out for Doctor Ling’s surgery.” Ouyang Kan took a stool and sat beside the anesthetists.

Su Jiafu, who was acting as the anesthesiologist assistant today, felt something being pulled out from beneath his buttocks, and he looked at Ouyang Kan in surprise. “You aren’t from the Emergency Medical Center, right?”
“What?” Ouyang Kan felt like he had missed something.

“Oh... nothing much.” Su Jiafu sighed internally as he looked at the stool beneath Ouyang Kan’s buttocks. He mentally reminded himself to be vigilant, as the former military doctor was not the only person who liked to steal chairs from anesthetists.
The attending physician from the Department from Anesthesiology knew Ouyang Kan, and he winked at Ouyang Kan. “This has nothing to do with youth.”
“It has something to do with Department Director Huo too, hasn’t it?”
The attending physician could not help but laugh “It also has something to do with our bonus.”
“Bonus?”
“Do you know which doctor is the one who treats the most foreign patients as well as patients who fund themselves in the hospital?” The attending physician gestured with his chin at the person.
Ouyang Kan immediately understood, and he realized something. “So, you guys receive quite a lot of bonuses from the Emergency Medical Center?”
The two anesthetists looked at each other and laughed.

In a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital, doctors from more than ten departments carried out surgeries every day.

Among them, not only were there extraordinary chief physicians and associate chief physicians from the Neurosurgery Department, but there were also rich chief physicians and associate chief physicians from the Orthopedics Department.
Some were even top surgeons like Chief Physician Jin Xi from the Hand Surgery Department.
The status of a treatment group’s leader in the hospital was plain to see whenever he carried out surgery.
A person just had to look at whether the other departments offered him their full cooperation.
“Isn’t it great to be young?
The Department of Anesthesiology is going all out for Doctor Ling’s surgery.” Ouyang Kan took a stool and sat beside the anesthetists.
Su Jiafu, who was acting as the anesthesiologist assistant today, felt something being pulled out from beneath his buttocks, and he looked at Ouyang Kan in surprise.
“You aren’t from the Emergency Medical Center, right?”
“What?” Ouyang Kan felt like he had missed something.
“Oh... nothing much.” Su Jiafu sighed internally as he looked at the stool beneath Ouyang Kan’s buttocks.
He mentally reminded himself to be vigilant, as the former military doctor was not the only person who liked to steal chairs from anesthetists.
The attending physician from the Department from Anesthesiology knew Ouyang Kan, and he winked at Ouyang Kan.
“This has nothing to do with youth.”
“It has something to do with Department Director Huo too, hasn’t it?”
The attending physician could not help but laugh “It also has something to do with our bonus.”
“Bonus?”
“Do you know which doctor is the one who treats the most foreign patients as well as patients who fund themselves in the hospital?” The attending physician gestured with his chin at the person.
Ouyang Kan immediately understood, and he realized something.
“So, you guys receive quite a lot of bonuses from the Emergency Medical Center?”
The two anesthetists looked at each other and laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 817: Pioneer
paragraphs: Ouyang Kan squirmed awkwardly, and the stool he was sitting on was creaking from the movement of his buttocks.

He was tall and was of above-average weight. Right now, he was curling himself up like a ball, and he looked like a large chunk of flesh that weighed heavily on the tiny stool. At least, it looked like this from Su Jiafu’s perspective.

Unless the surgeons had to carry out the surgery while sitting down, the stools in the operating theater were prepared for anesthetists, anyway. At times, the surgery would go on for too long, or the anesthetists might have been working on a few consecutive surgeries. This was when they would line up two stools and prop their legs up with their spine against the wall so that they could take a nap.

Of course, this was against the rules. But it felt tremendously good too. Su Jiafu could not stand it the most when surgeons snatched stools from anesthetists. Surgeons had snatched way too many things from anesthetists, such as popularity and opportunities to show off. How did they even have the audacity to snatch the anesthetists’ stools?
That was so unreasonable!
“Associate Chief Physician Wei is here,” the attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology suddenly said. He immediately lowered his head and pretended to be busy.

Ouyang Kan followed the attending physician’s gaze, and saw the scene behind the long, protruding glass wall of the visitation room upstairs. Not only was Wei Qing, the experienced associate chief physician from the General Surgery Department, here, but the director of the General Surgery Department and two other associate chief physicians were also here.
Ouyang Kan smiled nonchalantly, and his lips betrayed him. “This visitation room built by the Emergency Medical Center is truly cool.”

“I heard that Yunli Medical Company specially hired a team just to build it, and the signature fee alone was three million RMB.” The attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology clicked his tongue as he gossiped. Anesthetists were either gossiping or getting high, and from a certain perspective, it was safer for them to gossip.
Ouyang Kan did not really believe this. “Isn’t three million RMB a bit too much? Do people make so much more money building houses compared to digging out patients’ intestines nowadays?”

“Don’t put it this way. Digging intestines sounds too pleasant.” The chief physician from the Department of Anesthesiology chuckled. Because of age differences, he did not end up making the joke that surgeons were sh*t diggers.
“Then, how much money did Department Director Huo spend for this visitation room?” Ouyang Kan did not want to talk about sh*t digging either, so he changed the topic.
The attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology smiled. “Probably a few million RMB.”
“Yunli Medical Company made an unprofitable deal? Seriously?”

“Why would it be? The cost to build this visitation room isn’t that high. Aside from this, look at the number of hospitals that want a visitation room too after seeing this.” The anesthetist laughed scornfully. “The hospital’s paying for the construction of the visitation room, but Yunli Medical Company gets to boast about it. You’re a surgeon, so you will certainly agree with me, right? Hehe...”

Even as a surgeon himself, Ouyang Kan did not how to defend surgeons in this case. Among all the people in the hospital, surgeons definitely liked boasting the most, followed by associate chief physicians in the Orthopedics Department.

“Yunli Medical Company is making a lot of money.” The attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology continued gossiping. “Not only are other hospitals within Changxi Province interested in building a visitation room now, but there are also hospitals from other provinces nearby who engaged their services. I heard that Yunli Medical Company has even expanded its services to Beijing and Shanghai. The money they put in to hire the team to build the visitation room has returned to them in many folds.”
“They’re pretty bold, aren’t they?”

“This is why they’re so popular. For example, our...” The attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology pouted and gestured with his chin at the visitation room upstairs. “Yunli Medical Company supports us in using drugs from other medical companies. They let us pick out whatever drugs we think are the best, and they would fight for the distributorship of those drugs. I reckon that such a company definitely has an extremely bright future as long as they stay in the industry. All the drugs they distribute are excellent drugs that have stood the test of time, and in the end, we’ll have no choice but to use drugs distributed by them.”

Ouyang Kan nodded quietly, but he did not say anything in reply. After all, there are doctors from the General Surgery Department upstairs, and to them, medical companies and the choice of drugs were sensitive topics. It was not even appropriate for doctors from the same department to talk about this.

The attending physician realized that he had gone overboard too, so he quickly changed the topic. “The General Surgery Department pays quite a lot of attention to this surgery, don’t they? Even the department director is here.”
“How can they not?” Ouyang Kan smiled glumly. “If my memory isn’t failing me, this is the first time radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer is carried out using a laparoscope in Yun Hua Hospital.”
“The first time?” The attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology looked at Ouyang Kan in astonishment.

“I don’t believe in this method, and statistically, there isn’t any advantage to using this method either.” Ouyang Kan was experiencing quite a lot of complicated emotions. “The Japanese started using this surgical method in the nineties. It has been more than twenty years since then, but the results have been mediocre. They themselves don’t even know why the results are like that. Aside from Japan, only a small number of countries are doing this in an experimental manner.”

Every time a new technology was employed, it was always a step by step process. This was especially true when it came to surgical methods, as they were related to matters of life and death, and they relied a lot on the experiences of surgeons themselves.

In short, even if a person were to discount developing countries like China, a large number of new technologies and techniques were employed in the medical centers of more than thirty developed countries around the globe every year. And medical personnel from every country would be faced with the questions of whether to learn these new techniques, how to learn these new techniques and how to start employing these new technologies. It could be said to be a whole new world.
Aside from this, to learn these new techniques, they could not just copy other people directly. They had to get to know these techniques and study them. It was a process.

Take radical gastrectomy using a laparoscope as an example. Hospitals from all over the world were relatively slow in picking up this surgical method. Not only was it because this surgical method was rather hard, but it was also because experts from all over the world had differing opinions.

On one hand, doctors who were proponents for open surgery believed that because of how rich the blood circulation to the stomach was and how complicated the lymphatic structure in the stomach was, chances of recurrence were extremely high if a laparoscope was used. On the other hand, doctors who believed in using a laparoscope proposed that all abdominal surgeries could be carried out using a laparoscope. It was just a matter of whether it was difficult or not.

All proponents for radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope were young doctors below the age of forty or fifty. However, Ouyang Kan was a conservative doctor who had operated on almost a thousand patients with stomach cancer via open surgery. Of course, he was reluctant to use a laparoscope. He was a little too old to learn a new trick too, even if he wanted to.
However, Ouyang Kan was willing to see Ling Ran do it. It was just that he did not really believe in Ling Ran’s ability to do it well.
“It’s not so easy to act as the pioneer for something.” Ouyang Kan glanced at the visitation room upstairs before he immediately looked away.
“Didn’t you say that some surgeons in Japan have done it before?”

“There were 2,600 cases in ten years, which means that only a few doctors are doing it. You know how Japanese hospitals are kind of divided into sects.” Ouyang Kan paused for a moment, and this was when someone opened the door of the operating theater and wheeled the patient in.

The circulating nurse did not need anyone to bark orders at her. She gently checked the patient’s name and other details before she inserted a catheter for venous access. She then placed the aspirator beside the patient’s head, performed urinary catheterization and adjusted the patient’s body.
At the same time, the anesthetist and his assistant started getting busy for real.

For ordinary surgeries, there would only be one anesthetist, and the circulating nurse would need to help out. However, since Su Jiafu was acting as the attending physician’s assistant today, the attending physician was able to do things very smoothly.

“Anesthetics should be administered by two doctors, to begin with,” the attending physician from the Department of Anesthesiology marveled at how smoothly things were going, and he saw that Ouyang Kan who was standing beside him was starting to carry out preoperative preparations too. Ouyang Kan’s maneuvers were so skillful that it made the attending physician’s heartache. Ouyang Kan knew every movement by heart, and the attending physician wondered how many years Ouyang Kan had spent on being an assistant to be able to do all the tasks assistants were required to do instinctively. Only after being an assistant for a long time did he get to act as the chief surgeon, and he eventually made it in life and became an associate chief physician...

chapters.title: Chapter 818: All Eyes on Him
paragraphs: The visitation room was already full of people by the time Ling Ran entered the operating theater with his hands positioned vertically over his chest.

As this was the first time radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer was carried out using a laparoscope in Yun Hua Hospital, it was quite a hot topic among surgeons in the hospital. If a person were to look at it from a broader scope, even the General Surgery Department of Yun Hua Provincial Hospital that carried out radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope before had not performed many cases of it. In short, this surgery was quite a breath of fresh air among the doctors.

If a person were to make comparisons, this surgery could be likened to Spanish cuisine. Even though people who paid quite a bit of attention to food would have heard about it, not many people had tried it before. There were even fewer people who had tried it multiple times and were used to eating it.

The visitation room consisted of doctors who were interested in this surgical method, doctors who were interested in laparoscopy and doctors who were interested in Ling Ran. They easily filled up the entire visitation room. Even the director of the General Surgery Department did not enjoy any special privilege on this occasion. He had no choice but to sit obediently in the front row, and it was impossible for him to enjoy extra legroom.

“Let’s get started.” Ling Ran carried out demonstration surgeries all the time, and he was used to people watching him from the visitation room. He did not find the fact that the visitation room was full of people anything special. In reality, even under normal circumstances, the visitation room was often full whenever Ling Ran carried out surgeries.

Surgeons would get used to many people observing them when they operate sooner or later. For example, the operating theaters of certain large hospitals in Europe and the United States, such as Mayo Clinic, were perpetually full of medical interns as well as foreign visitors. The surgeons in those hospitals had no choice but to get used to it.

Besides, members of the Ling Treatment Group often worked in Operating Theater 1, which was equipped with a visitation room. Even a doctor like Yu Yuan had slowly gotten used to being watched by many people, let alone Lu Wenbin and the other doctors.

Ouyang Kan, who was a high and mighty associate chief physician, though, was not really used to this. However, it only took a moment for him to adapt to the situation. By the time the patient’s abdominal cavity was pumped full of carbon dioxide, Ouyang Kan slowly calmed down as he gazed at the familiar sight of a pneumoperitoneum.

Ouyang Kan always performed open surgery for patients with stomach cancer. But aside from radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer, Ouyang Kan had performed quite a few cases of laparoscopy. It was impossible to stay away from laparoscopy, as most of the open surgeries in the General Surgery Department had been replaced with laparoscopy. It was only a matter of whether surgeons were capable of performing these surgeries well.

Those like Ouyang Kan who rarely performed a laparoscopy and were bad at it usually only used a laparoscopy for appendectomy and intestinal obstruction repair. They mostly did it to put in some practice, and sometimes, they were left with no choice. Those like Ling Ran who were good at it...
Ouyang Kan watched as Ling Ran worked, and a hint of jealousy appeared in his heart.

It only took one look for other people to discern a genius. There was no need for a selection process or to identify the distinguishing characteristics of a genius. Geniuses were born to stand out among the crowd.
As Ouyang Kan watched Ling Ran’s maneuvers, he recalled his journey of learning how to perform laparoscopy. He was more than affected by it. There was practically a storm brewing inside his heart.

Laparoscopy was extremely popular nowadays, and a person would have to go against his conscience to say that Ouyang Kan and the other doctors did not spend time and energy on learning how to use a laparoscope. In reality, to keep up with the times, Ouyang Kan had spent almost a thousand hours practicing laparoscopy.
However, it took a lot for an untalented doctor to learn something.

If Ouyang Kan were still young and familiarizing himself with this surgical method for the first time, he might be able to spend a few hundred hours to learn laparoscopy, just like how he did with open surgery. He could then spend a few hundred hours studying laparoscopy and a few hundred more hours improving himself to build a competitive advantage.

However, Ouyang Kan was no longer young. If he wanted to replace open surgery with laparoscopy, he would at least need to be almost as good at laparoscopy as he was at open surgery. And truth be told, he no longer had what it took to learn a new surgical method.

He was not a genius and was unable to quickly learn how to perform laparoscopy. He was also responsible for his own treatment group and had to spend time on that. Moreover, he did not have a teacher who could guide him in performing laparoscopy. Hence, laparoscopy was basically beyond his reach.

The hospital and even his department would not put any consideration into ways in which a fifty-year-old surgeon could learn a new surgical method. All they wanted was for Ouyang Kan to shine brightly during his last moments in the hospital by being one of the last batches of doctors who performed open surgery.
Only genii who were extraordinarily talented could change directions as they pleased so that they could fully realize their worth in this world.
“No signs of metastases in the abdominal aorta and mesentery.” Ling Ran’s voice was loud and clear, and it immediately snapped Ouyang Kan out of his reverie.
Ouyang Kan nodded as he looked at the screen to show his approval.
“The surface of the intestine is clear.
“There’s no metastases in the pancreas and the transverse mesentery.
“There are no metastases in the retroperitoneal lymph nodes.”
Ling Ran was not in a hurry to remove the tumor from the stomach. Instead, he looked around the primary tumor to check for metastases.
“We’re kind of in luck.” This was Ouyang Kan’s subconscious reaction, and he did not bother to hide it.

One of the reasons doctors from the General Surgery Department did not like to perform radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope was because of limitations when it came to the parts of the abdominal cavity that could be operated on. Radical gastrectomy for stomach cancer using a laparoscope was basically only possible for patients who were at the early stages of stomach cancer. Even though there were research papers that delved into using this surgical method for patients who were at the advanced stages of stomach cancer, many things were still up in the air. In short, this surgical method was only suitable for those who were in the early stages of stomach cancer.

Aside from this, stomach cancer was rarely detected at its early stages. And even if a patient was diagnosed with early-stage stomach cancer, after laparoscopy began and a pneumoperitoneum was produced, metastases might be discovered. In that case, what should a surgeon do?

The surgeon would have to halt the laparoscopy and carry out open surgery instead. Since a pneumoperitoneum had been produced and an incision to insert the laparoscope had been made, there was a higher chance that more metastases would appear. These maneuvers were risk factors for metastases to begin with.

Ouyang Kan said that they were in luck because the patient was still in the early stages of stomach cancer. However, this was still a beginning. Ordinarily, this surgery took five to six hours, and there were plenty of obstacles that they would have to weather.

Ouyang Kan shifted his gaze from the screen to Ling Ran’s face. Ling Ran was wearing an earnest expression, and Ouyang Kan felt secondhand embarrassment for him. ‘Only a young person can do this. A person of my age would never take such a huge risk and carry out such a dangerous surgery in front of so many people.’
Heated discussions were also going on in the visitation room above the operating theater.

The department director of the General Surgery Department could not help but say to Huo Congjun as he chuckled, “Young people are really impulsive. Why didn’t you help him out and ask him to tone things down a little?”

“Why would I do that? As emergency physicians, we never expect anything to go as we want them to. If this world were perfect, there wouldn’t be a need for the Emergency Department,” Huo Congjun said philosophically with his hands crossed in front of his chest.
It only took one look for the department director of the General Surgery Department to know what he was thinking about. “Are you this confident in Ling Ran?”
“With his skills, of course, I’m super confident in him.” Huo Congjun laughed.

The director of the General Surgery Department was not convinced. “This is just the beginning. Even if we were to disregard other things, how long do you reckon that he will take to examine the patient’s taenia coli before he can be certain that there are no metastases in there? And what’s the probability that he won’t even be able to detect the presence of metastases?”
“The patient’s taenia coli looks thick and fair. It seems pretty healthy.” Huo Congjun smiled.
“This doesn’t mean that there’s no metastases.”
“If a pig were to have such a taenia coli, it would probably be quite tasty.”
“Of course. Pork intestines are delicious, to begin with. As long as it is washed thoroughly, the taenia coli is one of the most delicious body parts of a pig.”
“There’s no point in washing it too thoroughly.”
“Forget about it. I don’t want to be the one lying on the operating table.”
