The barbeque taste made from the endotherm knife was not comparable to grilled beef.

A chef who looked rather familiar personally used the knife and removed a tenderloin from the cow which had already been processed and was hanging by the side before he cut it into big pieces, skewered them, and grilled them on the spot.
He then whispered in a low voice, “Chef Zhu is making the beef entrails inside, but I often cut up the cow and roast the beef as well.”
“Thank you.” Ling Ran did not care about it either way, and he did not say much either.
The view in the sky was not bad, and the heat from the bonfire was warm.
It was the exact temperature that made him feel most comfortable.
Tian Qi also relaxed.
It was only when she saw two skewers of beef being served in front of her that she snapped out of her daze and smiled.
She took one of them and passed Ling Ran the other.
She asked, “Are you still busy lately?
Did you perform a lot of surgeries?”
“Yes.”
“You perform more surgeries than other doctors, right?
What’s the feeling of performing so many surgeries?”
“I feel good most of the time.
I performed a stomach cancer surgery a few days ago...
Hmm...
If humans have four stomachs, the surgery will be simpler,” Ling Ran said while looking at the cow at the side.
Tian Qi thought about it and said, “But cows can’t go having one stomach missing either, right?
Therefore, the probability of getting liver cancer should be four times higher for them, isn’t it?”

“It is not quite accurate to calculate it this way either” Ling Ran thought about it and said slowly, “It should be around one time to four times higher, but we’ll have to analyze the entire situation again if we want to think about the specifics.”
“Make sense.” Tian Qi agreed on it.
Ling Ran touched his chin and thought for a moment.
Then he ate the beef skewer and asked, “What have you been up to recently?”
“My grandfather asked me to take over a few companies to practice my skills.” Tian Qi pursed her lips, “Compared to your life, that’s much more boring.
All of them are companies that are not entirely necessary in the market.
The only reason to buy them is just to get rid of potential competitors and increase the occupancy rate of our company.
This kind of thing will happen every few years.
It’s really boring.
But doctors don’t have to worry about their competitors, right?”
Ling Ran thought about it and nodded slowly.
“Doctors will always have multiple paths available for them to take when it comes to their development, just like Department Director He from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
He is now focusing on liver cancer and bile duct cancer.”
Tian Qi certainly knew about He Yuanzheng.
She covered her mouth and smiled.
“It might also be because companies aren’t humans.
That’s why companies will always greedily try to take in all resources available, but doctors are human.
There will come a time for them to retire and eventually die.”
Ling Ran nodded.
“The golden period of a doctor’s life is truly short.”
“That won’t happen to you, Doctor Ling.” Tian Qi smiled faintly and passed one newly grilled beef to Ling Ran.
The blazing bonfire illuminated the grass around them and caused the beef to release a fragrance of the meadow, which can never be found in the beef served from restaurants in the city.
The quiet starry sky seemed to look at the ground, giving off a sense of alienation, but it also brought forth a precious tranquility to the place.

chapters.title: Chapter 826: Detailed Arrangement
paragraphs: Early in the morning, Captain Chu opened his eyes to see a dog standing before him.
The dog had bright eyes and shiny white teeth.

“Who brushed my dog’s teeth?” Captain Chu shouted angrily as he sat up straight, his arms supporting him. He shifted his knees. When he found that it no longer hurt as much as before, he could not help but laugh.
“My son did it,” Old Xu came over in a wheelchair, he had an amiable-looking face, “Your dog was sitting so still with my son as he brushed its teeth. My son is so gifted, whew...”
When Captain Chu saw that Old Xu was healthy, he happily retorted. “What’s the use of being gifted in dealing with dogs? Why would he brush the dog’s teeth? It’s not like he’s going to kiss it.”
“It’s a semi-retired dog, it should be happy to have someone brush its teeth,” Old Xu retorted with great confidence.
Captain Chu snorted. “Why isn’t your son getting ready for school yet?”

“He’s getting ready to go to Yun Hua High School.” Old Xu pursed his lip. “His mother came around with her thoughts. What’s the use of studying so hard? Nothing will come out of it in the end. We talked it over, and we found that we could not take it anymore. We’ll let him be a policeman in the future.”
Captain Chu was surprised. “Didn’t you forbid him to be a policeman?”

“We don’t have a lot of relatives and friends left in both our families. We’re alone in the world. If he becomes a policeman, he’ll have someone to take care of him.” Old Xu nodded to Captain Chu and said with a smile, “This time, my wife felt the warmth of our police team.”

Captain Chu was a little smug. He happily received the compliment, turned his head around, and whispered, “Speaking of which, I promised to send some more people with injured knees to Doctor Ling. Take a seat here, let’s figure out something together...”
“Figure out... what?”

“There’s a recovery period for surgeries, you know? We can’t send those people here all in one go. It would delay our day-to-day work. So we must have a reasonable allocation of who comes first, who comes later, and who needs to take a long rest, right?”
Old Xu nodded slowly.

Captain Chu whispered, “This stays between us. It would only put all sorts of thoughts in the minds of people. We’ll go by these three principles when we allocate the members here. First, we’ll use the health of the members as the basic rule for allocation. The second rule will be that we’ll allocate them based on the work within the police force. The third one is to make it as convenient as possible for the members. Ignore any other requests. I would suggest listing out the names of those who need surgeries...”
Old Xu then took a pen and paper. Both of them sat in front of the hospital bed as they listed down the names of the people who had their knees injured before.
As soon as the list was completed, Old Xu sighed. “So many people in our team were injured.”
Captain Chu also sighed and adjusted his seating posture.
The names of their team members and their titles were listed on the list, and behind them were either stars, crosses, or curved lines readjusting their positions on the list.
Old Chu looked at the list and sighed subconsciously. “Captain Chu, doesn’t it look like we’re in human trafficking right now?”
Captain Chu looked at the white paper and said without raising his head, “Even if this is really human trafficking, they still have to go. By the way, how are you recovering?”
“It’s pretty good. What about you?”

“Very good. Doctor Ling is really skilled when it comes to surgery. Hey, let’s take advantage of this opportunity to let Old Wang and the other old members in our team go have their surgery. We can’t be waiting for them to get any older before they get their surgery. By then, their bodies will be riddled with injuries and illnesses. We’re already in this era, and now, we rely on our brains to catch thieves. We need to take good care of our bodies...” Captain Chu lamented as he thought of his seniors.
During consultation day, Captain Chu led several members straight to Ling Ran’s consultation office.

Zuo Cidian gave them the extra slots at the door, and said, “Doctor Ling only consults ten people every day. So far, he has consulted five to six people. Please wait for a little while. You’re now slotted at the front of the queue.”
“Thank you very much,” Captain Chu leaned on his crutches as he voiced his gratitude. He then told the others, “You all must have met Doctor Zuo before. He helped me a lot when I was hospitalized.”
The team members who were led by Captain Chu to see the doctor were not very happy, but they were still polite to the doctor.
“Thank you, Doctor Zou.”
“If we work together with other departments in hunting down punters and we catch you, I will definitely let you go.”
“If you’re caught in illegal gambling, just call out my name.”
“If you got into fights, call out my name.”
“If you got into accidents, call out my name.”
Even though they were mostly involved in rearing dogs, they knew quite a lot of people. All of them expressed their gratitude to Doctor Zuo.
Zuo Cidian accepted them with a smile and then sent them to take a seat in the corridor.
The people waited in boredom, but as they waited, they chatted or walked around, and they were not as bored as they thought they would be.
After a while, a man who looked like a shopkeeper for a snack counter came back with a member of the police force.
“Captain Chu.” The team member who came back was a tiny man. He had short legs, thick buttocks, was thin and lean, like a Corgi who only ate lean meat.
Captain Chu frowned as he looked over. “What’s going on?”
“This brother has heard that we’re slotted at the front. He wants to buy our numbers.” Corgi Man winked and sent the team a signal they were familiar with. ‘Jack up the prize.’
Captain Chu looked at the man and asked, “What do you mean?”
“I’m not from here, and I don’t have a number. I just want to know if I can get one number from your group. It would be even better if you can give us two.”
“We also came to see the doctor,” Captain Chu said.

“We are all patients.” The businessman revealed a dejected smile. Then, he drew the figure of an eight in the air and said, “There’s so many of you, I’m sure one of you can do me a favor and give me a number.”
“What are you trying to say?” Captain Chu refused to admit that he understood what the businessman said, and he just let him continue speaking.
The businessman smiled. “800 RMB. Two for 1,800.”
“One number for 800 RMB?” Those who were talking incessantly just now became dumbfounded.

As soon as the businessman saw their expressions, he knew what was going on. He smiled and said, “You’re queued right in front of the line, right? 800 RMB is the market price. I will not scam you. It has been decided, then. If you look it up the on Doctors. Here, you’ll find that that’s the price for numbers at the front.”
“We won’t sell them.” Once Captain Chu got a clear statement, his expression darkened.
The businessman frowned, but the frown disappeared and smiled before he said, “Brother, you don’t have to be like that. 800 RMB is a lot. How about one for 900 RMB and two for 2,000 RMB?”
Captain Chu took out his ID card and swung it a little without saying anything.
The businessman stood still, laughed bashfully before obediently turning around and left.
“Did you see that? You usually won’t be able to get to see a doctor whose consultation numbers cost 1,000 RMB.” Captain Chu took the opportunity to educate his team members.
Everyone clicked their tongues as they continued saying strange things, but none of them mentioned about going back anymore.
After a while, Ling Ran consulted the first ten patients. Captain Chu and his team swarmed in and entered Ling Ran’s office.
Ling Ran took a look and asked, “Who’s going first?”
A few people looked at each other and pushed Corgi Man to the front.
“You want knee arthroscopy?” Ling Ran remembered Captain Chu’s promise. He looked at the patient’s scan and immediately formed his impression.
Corgi Man nodded hesitantly.

“Go and get a scan. If there aren’t any changes to your condition, you can have your surgery during the afternoon. Next.” Ling Ran handed over the task of writing the prescription and the authorization form for the related scans to the houseman and looked at the people behind Corgi Man.
Corgi Man hesitated again. “This afternoon? So soon?”
“It can also be scheduled next week. There is no need to hurry for elective surgeries.”
“Do it this afternoon,” Captain Chu glanced at Corgi Man. “There will be others queueing up for surgery for next week.”

chapters.title: Chapter 827: Pre-operation
paragraphs: Ling Ran patiently answered questions from several police dog owners.
For doctors, every surgery varied, but for patients, no matter how small the surgery was, the nervousness remained.
Ling Ran was used to explaining the procedure to them in detail.
Some doctors did not like it, partly because they could not explain it clearly. In most cases, they did not have enough time to do so.

For a doctor who consulted thirty to forty patients in the morning, the average time they could spend on each patient was only a few minutes. Naturally, they did not have enough time to go into detail. Even if the doctor could explain it clearly, the patient and their family members may not be able to understand it.
Most of the high-ranking doctors were always praised by the patients and their families, but that was mainly because they had enough time to do the explaining.
This was because the more advanced a doctor was, the fewer patients they had to deal with in person.

Most illnesses and patients could be handed over to junior doctors for treatment. High-ranking doctors only cared about the patients and illnesses that they wanted to care about. So, the time spent on each patient would naturally be extended.
In fact, Ling Ran had just recently found himself in this position, or rather, he had escaped from the plight of a junior doctor.
Ever since he started providing consultations, he did not have to perform unappreciated tasks and obey the hospital’s medical production line anymore.

Ordinary assistant lecturers did not have any choice in terms of choosing how many patients they wanted to consult. The people from departments or treatment groups sent them out for consultations to bring back the patients, just like how hunting dogs were sent out to bring back game. Taking the initiative to reduce the number of surgeries by themselves would definitely not be approved.

Even if a doctor held a senior position, he could not choose to reduce the number of consultations—not unless he was a medical director. Even department directors could not always reduce the number of consultations.

A treatment group or department was an organic organization. The leaders over there could not afford to not bring patients back just because they wanted to have a good time. How would the junior doctors be able to improve their surgery skills if they did not work?

Besides, the number of patients was directly related to the doctors’ bonuses. Pharmaceutical sales representatives would not even bother with doctors who performed few surgeries. Only doctors with strong mental fortitudes could insist on reducing the number of consultations and patients.

Or if they had Ling Ran’s skill and status. The better skills they had and the broader range of skills they had, the more sources of patients they would have. A higher status also meant that they could decide their patients’ whereabouts and so on.

The houseman next to him waited patiently. When Ling Ran was done consulting all the patients and figured out all their problems, he immediately handed out the forms and said, “This is the hospitalization form. You can take it to the inpatient area in the center.”
“Okay.” After Corgi Man went for his consultation and listened to Ling Ran’s explanation, he gradually changed his mind.
Now, he wanted to have surgery.
He can be considered to have hit the jackpot to be able to receive surgery from such an awesome doctor like Ling Ran.
After Corgi Man got the hospitalization form, he looked down at it and smiled with satisfaction.
When everything was settled, they sat on their beds in the ward, and Corgi Man as well as the others were relieved.

The vice-captain looked like he was abducted. He sighed heavily, exhaled one more time, looked at the ward, and said, “It’s very convenient to put all of us into one room. At least that means we can take care of each other.”
This was a three-bed room, when another two beds were added here, the hospital can fit five people inside.

Ling Ran had been back for some time. The rooms were now fully occupied, and they had almost reached full capacity for the extra beds. Having five people stay in a three-bed room was already considered basic operations for the hospital at present.
“Vice-captain, please help us find a larger room later. It would be better if it’s a single room or something similar to that.” Corgi Man laughed.
The vice-captain snorted. “Yeah right, I don’t even know anyone here. Help you to find a bigger room? Is it so troubling for you to stay with me?”
“What? No! We see each other in the team every day. I’m sure you’re tired of having me around already.” Corgi Man began to act obediently and cutely for his own benefits.
Once again, the vice-captain let out a hum before he took out his phone and said, “Let me ask them. They seem to be really short on rooms.”
Several other team members nodded obediently and did not hurry in unpacking their things. They took out their phones to contact their families.
They thought they could go back after their consultation. They did not think that they would need to be hospitalized.
*Click*
Captain Chu walked into the door, like a human trafficker. There was a proud smile on his face. “You’re settled down? Have your surgeries been scheduled?”
“Captain,” Corgi Man greeted him.

The vice-captain said angrily, “Our surgeries are scheduled in the afternoon. Old Chu, you did not even discuss this with me before you sent me here before I can prepare myself. You’re making me do things way beyond my ability. What’s the difference between this driving me to do something drastic?”

“Would you have come if I discussed this with you? How long can you last with your legs in this condition?” Captain Chu waved his hand and said, “After I did the surgery, I found out that it is meaningless to delay this issue. Now that we found this doctor after so much hardship, it would be a waste if we did not grab this opportunity.”

“You should have let the others do it first. There are so many things to do in the team. You can’t be on duty right now, and I’m hospitalized, the team might be in chaos now.” The vice-captain shook his head vigorously.
Captain Chu stared at him for a while and said, “Didn’t you take leave for a week before Chinese New Year? When you came back, did you find any changes in the team?”
The vice-captain was stunned.

“You play with your dog all day long. Even when you stay in the hospital, things will be the same. Don’t worry.” Captain Chu paused for a moment, he then said slowly, “I will be back in the team in a few days. It’s just about ten dogs. Having us absent for just a few days is perfectly fine.”
The vice-captain licked his lips and felt resigned.
A few other members looked at each other before they quickly heaped praises, compliments, and wishes on the captain.
“It’s good that you’ve recovered, captain.”
“I hope that you’ll be healthy and realize your ambitions.”
“Captain, don’t forget to send some food to my family.”
*Click*
The door to the room was pushed open again.
“Come, it’s time to prepare for the surgery.” A nurse came in with steel plates and occupied the door as if to prevent people from escaping.
“Now? So soon? Didn’t the doctor say that the surgery will be in the afternoon?” A few people in the room who were talking and laughing gradually lost their smiles.
“We have to start to get ready for the surgery in the afternoon. There are a lot of things for us to check.”
“A... lot?”

“Routine blood tests, liver function, blood biochemical tests, infectious diseases test, blood clotting function, and routine urine and fecal tests...” the nurse said while drawing their blood. She left a plastic container behind and said, “After you poop, get some into it. A little will do. Close the lid properly.”
The five people looked at each other and suddenly felt embarrassed that they were staying together.
“Are your families informed? They need to sign some forms,” the nurse urged them again.
“Yes,” the captain replied in their place.
“Any smokers? You should not smoke before surgery.”
Several people giggled and did not utter a word.
The nurse looked at them and chuckled. “And...”
“Please, go on.”
“Have you all done surgeries before?”
Some shook their heads.
Corgi Man was a little bit embarrassed. “I did circumcision.”
The nurse nodded. “Well, then, I’ll teach you how to do your business on the bed, which is good for your postoperative recovery...”
The men had shocked expressions plastered on their faces.

He sighed heavily, exhaled one more time, looked at the ward, and said, “It’s very convenient to put all of us into one room.
At least that means we can take care of each other.”
This was a three-bed room, when another two beds were added here, the hospital can fit five people inside.
Ling Ran had been back for some time.
The rooms were now fully occupied, and they had almost reached full capacity for the extra beds.
Having five people stay in a three-bed room was already considered basic operations for the hospital at present.
“Vice-captain, please help us find a larger room later.
It would be better if it’s a single room or something similar to that.” Corgi Man laughed.
The vice-captain snorted.
“Yeah right, I don’t even know anyone here.
Help you to find a bigger room?
Is it so troubling for you to stay with me?”
“What?
No!
We see each other in the team every day.
I’m sure you’re tired of having me around already.” Corgi Man began to act obediently and cutely for his own benefits.
Once again, the vice-captain let out a hum before he took out his phone and said, “Let me ask them.
They seem to be really short on rooms.”
Several other team members nodded obediently and did not hurry in unpacking their things.
They took out their phones to contact their families.
They thought they could go back after their consultation.
They did not think that they would need to be hospitalized.
*Click*
Captain Chu walked into the door, like a human trafficker.
There was a proud smile on his face.
“You’re settled down?
Have your surgeries been scheduled?”
“Captain,” Corgi Man greeted him.
The vice-captain said angrily, “Our surgeries are scheduled in the afternoon.
Old Chu, you did not even discuss this with me before you sent me here before I can prepare myself.
You’re making me do things way beyond my ability.
What’s the difference between this driving me to do something drastic?”
“Would you have come if I discussed this with you?
How long can you last with your legs in this condition?” Captain Chu waved his hand and said, “After I did the surgery, I found out that it is meaningless to delay this issue.
Now that we found this doctor after so much hardship, it would be a waste if we did not grab this opportunity.”
“You should have let the others do it first.
There are so many things to do in the team.
You can’t be on duty right now, and I’m hospitalized, the team might be in chaos now.” The vice-captain shook his head vigorously.
Captain Chu stared at him for a while and said, “Didn’t you take leave for a week before Chinese New Year?
When you came back, did you find any changes in the team?”
The vice-captain was stunned.
“You play with your dog all day long.
Even when you stay in the hospital, things will be the same.
Don’t worry.” Captain Chu paused for a moment, he then said slowly, “I will be back in the team in a few days.
It’s just about ten dogs.
Having us absent for just a few days is perfectly fine.”
The vice-captain licked his lips and felt resigned.
A few other members looked at each other before they quickly heaped praises, compliments, and wishes on the captain.
“It’s good that you’ve recovered, captain.”
“I hope that you’ll be healthy and realize your ambitions.”
“Captain, don’t forget to send some food to my family.”
*Click*
The door to the room was pushed open again.
“Come, it’s time to prepare for the surgery.” A nurse came in with steel plates and occupied the door as if to prevent people from escaping.
“Now?
So soon?
Didn’t the doctor say that the surgery will be in the afternoon?” A few people in the room who were talking and laughing gradually lost their smiles.
“We have to start to get ready for the surgery in the afternoon.
There are a lot of things for us to check.”
“A... lot?”
“Routine blood tests, liver function, blood biochemical tests, infectious diseases test, blood clotting function, and routine urine and fecal tests...” the nurse said while drawing their blood.
She left a plastic container behind and said, “After you poop, get some into it.
A little will do.
Close the lid properly.”
The five people looked at each other and suddenly felt embarrassed that they were staying together.
“Are your families informed?
They need to sign some forms,” the nurse urged them again.
“Yes,” the captain replied in their place.
“Any smokers?
You should not smoke before surgery.”
Several people giggled and did not utter a word.
The nurse looked at them and chuckled.
“Please, go on.”
“Have you all done surgeries before?”
Some shook their heads.
Corgi Man was a little bit embarrassed.
“I did circumcision.”
The nurse nodded.
“Well, then, I’ll teach you how to do your business on the bed, which is good for your postoperative recovery...”
The men had shocked expressions plastered on their faces.

chapters.title: Chapter 828: Corpse
paragraphs: “Old Xu, hurry up.”
“I’m number one, I’m number one.”
“Space yourselves. If we run into each other, it’ll be really bad.”
Several men who were like Corgis and kept dogs either leaned against their crutches or held the handles of the corridor, and they still attempted to race as they limped together.
Beside them, their physiotherapist had an expression as if he just screwed a dog. While he watched helplessly as they competed, he had to follow and pay attention to them lest someone really fell.

Old Xu was still in a wheelchair, pushing himself to move while on wheels. He moved in front of a familiar looking physiotherapist and asked, “They just finished their surgery, is racing really okay?”

“With their speed, even racing against dogs wouldn’t be a problem to them.” After the physiotherapist finished speaking, he took a few steps and watched the breathless Corgi guys who were supporting their bodies with their arms. He then urged them. “Walk faster, hurry up. Didn’t you guys eat?”
Everyone turned around indignantly: φ(≧ω≦*)?
The physiotherapist pouted. “Is that the best you can do? The last time I rehabilitated a thief, that person ran faster than you and was more determined. How do you guys catch thieves like this?”
“The police dogs are the ones which catch the thief!” The crowd retaliated, refusing to accept the insult.
“Isn’t that much simpler for you? Just run forward and say a command, and the dogs would rush forward.” The physiotherapist chuckled.

“They’re police dogs! Do you know how difficult it is to train police dogs?” The Corgi guys glared at him. Their heads were already covered in a faint sheen of sweat after their recovery from the surgery. “We are technical officers, we dabble in pens and electronics.”
The physiotherapist had seen many more incredible people and heard even more obscene words. When people were tired, they would start talking nonsense.
The physiotherapist pursed his mouth and waved his hand. “Everyone in this hospital dabbles in the technical aspects in their field. Run forward.”
“Oh.” The Corgis gritted their teeth again and walked forward while grunting in pain.
As they walked, the crowd slowly came to a stop.
“Were we scolded just now?” Corgi Man asked the people behind him hesitantly.
The others were silent for a few seconds. “We were scolded to be like dogs, that’s not scolding.”
“That’s true.”
“Aye.”
“Carry on.”
After a lively hundred-meter race, several members of the police dog unit held their crutches in a relaxed state.
“I have to say, it’s good to be hospitalized together.”
“Yeah. We don’t have to think about anything, all we need to do is rest. It almost feels like we’re on holiday.”
“Aren’t we actually on vacation now?”
“Sick leave feels different,” Corgi Man said as he stretched out his legs and made a lazy stretch. His whole body was relaxed like a ginger cat, and he started to doze off.

In the hospital corridor, all sorts of people came and went, especially the family members of the patients who came to fill up some water. They talked about prohibited topics often, and they amused the dads of the police dogs.
At that moment, Yu Yuan also brought a thermos with her to refill water.
As she walked, she was talking on her phone.
“Yes, the location is fine.
“Was the corpse disposed of?
“Don’t let anyone see it.”
Several police dog fathers sat up straight and looked at each other with serious expressions.
“Doctor Yu is probably talking about some dissection stuff.”
“There are too many bodies in the morgue of the hospital.”

“Doctors don’t need anyone’s help if they want to kill people. They can pull someone from the ambulance to the operating theater and rescue them. Why would they need someone else to help in killing people?” The vice-captain laughed and shook his head. “I heard that half of the doctors who kill think they are God’s hands, performing merciful strokes, like they’re the angels of death or something ... ”

At this moment, Yu Yuan’s topic changed, and her expression became serious. “What we’re doing is euthanasia, not killing someone with a chainsaw. You just have to dispose of the corpse, and you don’t need to worry about anything else.”
The vice-captain could not sit still this time. He leaned against his crutch and walked toward Yu Yuan.
Yu Yuan held her phone and slowly filled up the thermos with hot water before she turned around and walked in the other direction.
The vice-captain said nothing and continued to chase after her with his crutch.
Several teammates behind him also chased after her, even though they did not know what was going on.

If anyone looked, they would see a small dot at the front of the corridor while a few men at the back with crutches walked after her as if they were practicing how to walk. They were also sweating bullets.
In this white, light blue, and gray world, everyone was doing their own thing.
“Elevator, wait.” The vice-captain was lagging further and further behind. Then, when Yu Yuan entered the elevator, he shouted.
Yu Yuan looked indifferently at the patients across her, but in the end, she still chose to wait.
“Doctor Yu, where are you going?” the vice-captain asked straightaway as he panted.
Yu Yuan furrowed her brows. “To the lab.”
The elevator door finally closed while she spoke.
In the confined space, the expressions of the vice-captain and the others were unreadable.
“So, what do you mean by a corpse?” Corgi Man was panting so hard he looked as if he had been toyed with by a Golden Retriever.
Yu Yuan calmly said, “A little white mouse.”
“Oh.” The vice-captain and everyone laughed.
*Ding*
The elevator opened. After Yu Yuan went out, she turned around and said, “Do you guys believe what I just said?”
*Ding*
The elevator closed, the vice captain, and Corgis looked at each other before they sighed. “Should we forget it?”
“Forget it.”
Outside the elevator, Yu Yuan smiled with contempt.
Ling Ran performed the operation at a leisurely pace.
In just over twenty minutes, a knee arthroscopy operation was declared complete.
“The operation went well, take a good rest,” Ling Ran said, then took off his surgical gown and watched Zuo Cidian as well as the others finish the surgery.

Knee arthroscopy was usually done with regional anaesthesia. Under Zuo Cidian’s suggestion, Ling Ran did not turn around and leave as he usually when he operated on patients under general anesthesia. He stood by the side to watch for a while and only walked away when the patient did not raise any requests.
Most patients did not have any requests.
But today’s patient was involved in an accident.

“Doctor, um... when I go out, can I pretend that I’m unconscious after the anesthesia?” The patient looked at the anesthetist and Ling Ran with a pitiful look. After the operation, he also knew who was in charge.
Ling Ran stunned. “Why do you want to pretend to be unconscious?”
The anesthetist resolutely said, “I’m okay with that.”

The patient put on a little smile and whispered, “My wife nags a little more than the usual person. Before I had the operation, she held back and said nothing. Now that the operation is done, I’m afraid she will bother me.”
Ling Ran had to think about what he said with a little more brain power.
Zuo Cidian coughed and said, “Doctor Ling, can you help him? He’s a pitiful man.”
“Oh, okay.” Ling Ran decided to trust Zuo Cidian’s judgment and followed his advice readily.
The patient was extremely grateful and laid down quickly to appear to be asleep.
“Let’s carry him out.” When Zuo Cidian saw that the surgery was at its end, he made this declaration.
The nurse worked hard with him to send the person to the gurney. Then, they pushed him out slowly.
Right from the start to the end, the patient remained in a state where he looked as if he was unconscious because of anesthesia.
The nurse pushed the man all the way to the door of the operating theater. At this time, she asked, “Is it a little weird if the patient snores after he has been anesthetized?”
“Patients are likely to snore without intubation—” When the anesthetist said this, his mind went blank. He hesitantly asked, “He’s asleep?”
The nurse said, “Yes.”
“Continue as usual,” Zuo Cidian said seriously, “Snoring is not a sin.”

chapters.title: Chapter 829: Using Large Flames to Turn Soup into Stew
paragraphs: *Wee woo... Wee woo...*
The sound of the ambulance was like an alarm bell, and it had awakened the Emergency Medical Center from its slumber at midnight.
Lu Wenbin opened his eyes wide and walked out soullessly from the treatment room.
“If I have the same shift with Su Mengxue again, I’ll cut my own hand and braise it.” Lu Wenbin was so tired that when he spoke, it was clear that his mind had decided to abandon him.

Zuo Cidian, who woke up early for work, was not surprised by this at all, and he pursed his lips. “I thought you don’t believe in that sort of stuff. Are you superstitious? Do you feel superstitious now?”

“Of course not.” Lu Wenbin shook his head firmly. “If you work with Su Mengxue for night shift, you will be insanely busy. This is a fact that is more real than cooking mangoes in a hotpot. It can’t be superstition.”

“I know, right? This has long since been proven true. Whoever shares a shift with Su Mengxue will be busy for the entire night. I’ll admit defeat if anyone can even rest for an hour.” Zuo Cidian clicked his tongue. “These are sayings passed down from our previous colleagues, we should believe them.”
If this happened in the past, Lu Wenbin would have thrown out a sarcastic quip. However, after he went through that scary night, Lu Wenbin had decided to believe in Zuo Cidian.
Lu Wenbin was still terrified when he recalled yesterday’s night shift. But when his words reached the tip of his tongue, he sighed heavily. “I perform four surgeries in a night.”

Zuo Cidian stared at Lu Wenbin sympathetically. Four surgeries was not scary, but everyone in the Emergency Department knew that the resident doctors on night shift would not possibly just perform surgeries for an entire night. That was only applicable to doctors at an administrative level. And if the resident doctors and bosses found something they did not want to do, the resident doctors would still end up having to do it.

“You’ll be fine after you get through it.” Zuo Cidian patted his shoulder, smiled, and said, “Go and grab breakfast. There are chefs and pâtissies sent over by Miss Tian. Ling Ran just finished his ward round.”
“Oh,” Lu Wenbin replied, and his expression was finally livelier while he said, “Then, I’ll go over first. Bed 4 needs to be transferred to the Cardiology Department. Please take a look into that.”
“They haven’t come over to pick up the patient yet?”
“Four of their patients died yesterday night, and they’re very busy. They’ll only send someone over to pick up the patient once working hours start.”
Zuo Cidian nodded and smiled in anguish. “Four is truly an unlucky number.”

“It is.” Lu Wenbin stopped spewing nonsense. He carried his items and went to the Operating Area. In the Emergency Department, the only place that a doctor could eat peacefully would be the small cafeteria in the Operating Area.

The small cafeteria was really small. There were only a total of six tables, and they were arranged closely to one another. Those tables were mainly for the bosses’ use. During the peak hours in the Emergency Department, the four operating theaters would be occupied by seven to eight chief physicians and associate chief physicians, along with the anesthetists and nurses, there would be thirty people who will work together in the operating theater. So, it would not be strange if all six tables were fully occupied once they were done with work.

Of course, most of the time, the cafeteria would not be occupied with that many people. Before being upgraded into an Emergency Medical Center, the usage rate of the operating theaters in the Emergency Department was not even up to 30%.

But now, most of the operating theaters were used by Ling Ran’s treatment group. However, in the foreseeable future, as the Emergency Medical Center became more famous, it will slowly begin to bear the responsibility of a center. The Operating Area would only get busier.
Lu Wenbin looked exhausted while he went away. Sometimes, he will even need to lean against the wall.

He only got through last night entirely through the support from Red Bull and coffee. Now, the effects were gone, and he was totally exhausted. He went to the small kitchen and wanted to get something warm to eat.
“What do you want to eat?” someone asked politely from the small kitchen.

Since the cafeteria was very small, the small kitchen was even smaller, and it was even an open kitchen to boot. Usually, it was a place for doctors and nurses to heat up their meals and pork trotters. Lu Wenbin could not recognize this voice, and he could not help but to look up.
“I’m a chef from Yunli Medical Company... Ah, and also a pharmaceutical sales representative.” The man standing in the small kitchen smiled faintly.

Pharmaceutical sales representatives will not just visit doctors during their consultation hours, they can also be found in the wards of the Operating Area or the operating theaters. The superficial reason for this was because they needed to help test the instruments and devices in the hospital or introduce some of the consumables, but the actual reason was because they were cheap labor.

Pharmaceutical sales representatives were more useful than the interns who just graduated from the medical college. After all, the doctors will still feel a sense of burden when they exploited students. However, no one would care about the lives of pharmaceutical sales representatives because they were just consumables.
But Lu Wenbin had never seen a pharmaceutical sales representative like this before.
However, Lu Wenbin’s adaptability was very strong. In just a few seconds, he showed a foolish smile as if he had his questions answered. “Yunli, huh?”
The chef nodded and asked, “There are rice noodles and noodles. Which one do you prefer?”
“Rice noodles, I guess...”
“Do you want eggs? Fried eggs or boiled eggs?”
“Fried eggs.”
“Okay. Please wait a minute. Is there anything you can’t eat or are allergic to?”
“No.”
Lu Wenbin shook his head. After a few seconds, he turned around and saw that Tian Qi was sitting at the table at the center and was eating quietly.
When he looked carefully, Ling Ran, who sat in front of Tian Qi, was also eating quietly.
“Miss Tian is also one of the pharmaceutical sales representatives from Yunli Medical Company.” The chef grinned while he explained.
Lu Wenbin was impressed. “Pharmaceutical sales representatives truly have all sorts of talented people hidden among them.”
“There are bite-sized fried lard, steak, small lamb chops, and fried fish. Which side dish would you want?” The chef did not continue the topic of conversation and asked with a boisterous voice.
“You have steak and lamb chop as well?” Lu Wenbin frowned and asked, “That’s too greasy. Who will eat that sort of stuff so early in the morning?”

“The steak is top quality Zebu meat selected from Brazil. It was brought from Brazil to Yun Hua and slaughtered. The lamb chop is fried in the style of the French. The meat texture is tender, and the smell of mutton is completely gone.”
Lu Wenbin remained silent for a few seconds. “I want it all.”
The chef was used to it. “Okay.”
“Get me another pork trotter. Pork trotters are a must in this cafeteria.” Lu Wenbin’s mind seemed to be working again, and he stated something born from his own persistence.
The chef also said persistently, “Pork trotters do not match well with rice noodles.”
“Don’t you say that.” Lu Wenbin raised his head and looked calm. “Yesterday, I cut someone up.”
The chef trembled. “Why?”

Lu Wenbin’s gaze was distant. “One idiot went to his father’s grave to honor him—Sorry, I meant that someone went to his father’s grave to honor him. He went with another idiot—Sorry, I mean that he went with another person and decided to use the old hunting gun his father hid in the cellar forty years ago. And there was an in-bore premature detonation.”
The chef was stunned and thought for a while before he said, “Luckily the other idiot... No, I mean, the other person is fine.”
“Oh, the other one got one of his eyes blinded and was sent to the Ophthalmology Department.” Lu Wenbin raised his head again and said, “Remember to add pork trotters into the rice noodles.”
“Okay.” The chef gave a smile.
A while later, Lu Wenbin carried his bowl and sat at the corner. He was not stupid enough to rush over to Ling Ran’s table to greet him.
That bowl of rice noodles made Lu Wenbin sweat.
When he looked up again, he saw Huo Congjun come in through the door.
Lu Wenbin immediately lowered his head and kept pretending to eat. He looked as if he was acting in a sketch.
“Ling Ran.” Huo Congjun sounded very happy.
“Department Director Huo,” Ling Ran replied.
“Department Director Huo!” Tian Qi sounded very sweet and gave up some space. “Did you stay up late? Want to grab some soup?”
“No need. I’ll just talk for a while and leave.” Huo Congjun immediately sat in front of Ling Ran and said, “Let me introduce you to a surgeon going through in-service training.”

A surgeon going through in-service training was a doctor sent over from a low-ranking hospital to a high-ranking hospital. Since this kind of doctor was more mature, they were considered as favored cheap labor in all departments.
But since Ling Ran did not have any sort of preference for any doctor, he just nodded. “Sure.”

“Hmm... This man is an attending physician from the county hospital of Qiu County. He probably wants to learn something before he’s promoted to an assistant lecturer. He’s rather good at handling matters, so you can use him for two months.” Huo Congjun chuckled and said, “He mainly wants to learn about abdominoscopy. Just teach him according to the situation.”

Lu Wenbin frowned as he heard that. Ling Ran’s treatment group had free reign over any new venture it had in mind. If a mature doctor suddenly came over to learn from Ling Ran, he would be like soup being boiled into stew, over a large flame!
He was a great threat.

Do you feel superstitious now?”
“Of course not.” Lu Wenbin shook his head firmly.
“If you work with Su Mengxue for night shift, you will be insanely busy.
This is a fact that is more real than cooking mangoes in a hotpot.
It can’t be superstition.”
“I know, right?
This has long since been proven true.
Whoever shares a shift with Su Mengxue will be busy for the entire night.
I’ll admit defeat if anyone can even rest for an hour.” Zuo Cidian clicked his tongue.
“These are sayings passed down from our previous colleagues, we should believe them.”
If this happened in the past, Lu Wenbin would have thrown out a sarcastic quip.
However, after he went through that scary night, Lu Wenbin had decided to believe in Zuo Cidian.
Lu Wenbin was still terrified when he recalled yesterday’s night shift.
But when his words reached the tip of his tongue, he sighed heavily.
“I perform four surgeries in a night.”
Zuo Cidian stared at Lu Wenbin sympathetically.
Four surgeries was not scary, but everyone in the Emergency Department knew that the resident doctors on night shift would not possibly just perform surgeries for an entire night.
That was only applicable to doctors at an administrative level.
And if the resident doctors and bosses found something they did not want to do, the resident doctors would still end up having to do it.
“You’ll be fine after you get through it.” Zuo Cidian patted his shoulder, smiled, and said, “Go and grab breakfast.
There are chefs and pâtissies sent over by Miss Tian.
Ling Ran just finished his ward round.”
“Oh,” Lu Wenbin replied, and his expression was finally livelier while he said, “Then, I’ll go over first.
Bed 4 needs to be transferred to the Cardiology Department.
Please take a look into that.”
“They haven’t come over to pick up the patient yet?”
“Four of their patients died yesterday night, and they’re very busy.
They’ll only send someone over to pick up the patient once working hours start.”
Zuo Cidian nodded and smiled in anguish.
“Four is truly an unlucky number.”
“It is.” Lu Wenbin stopped spewing nonsense.
He carried his items and went to the Operating Area.
In the Emergency Department, the only place that a doctor could eat peacefully would be the small cafeteria in the Operating Area.
The small cafeteria was really small.
There were only a total of six tables, and they were arranged closely to one another.
Those tables were mainly for the bosses’ use.

During the peak hours in the Emergency Department, the four operating theaters would be occupied by seven to eight chief physicians and associate chief physicians, along with the anesthetists and nurses, there would be thirty people who will work together in the operating theater.
So, it would not be strange if all six tables were fully occupied once they were done with work.
Of course, most of the time, the cafeteria would not be occupied with that many people.
Before being upgraded into an Emergency Medical Center, the usage rate of the operating theaters in the Emergency Department was not even up to 30%.
But now, most of the operating theaters were used by Ling Ran’s treatment group.
However, in the foreseeable future, as the Emergency Medical Center became more famous, it will slowly begin to bear the responsibility of a center.
The Operating Area would only get busier.
Lu Wenbin looked exhausted while he went away.
Sometimes, he will even need to lean against the wall.
He only got through last night entirely through the support from Red Bull and coffee.
Now, the effects were gone, and he was totally exhausted.
He went to the small kitchen and wanted to get something warm to eat.
“What do you want to eat?” someone asked politely from the small kitchen.
Since the cafeteria was very small, the small kitchen was even smaller, and it was even an open kitchen to boot.
Usually, it was a place for doctors and nurses to heat up their meals and pork trotters.
Lu Wenbin could not recognize this voice, and he could not help but to look up.
“I’m a chef from Yunli Medical Company...
Ah, and also a pharmaceutical sales representative.” The man standing in the small kitchen smiled faintly.
Pharmaceutical sales representatives will not just visit doctors during their consultation hours, they can also be found in the wards of the Operating Area or the operating theaters.

The superficial reason for this was because they needed to help test the instruments and devices in the hospital or introduce some of the consumables, but the actual reason was because they were cheap labor.
Pharmaceutical sales representatives were more useful than the interns who just graduated from the medical college.
After all, the doctors will still feel a sense of burden when they exploited students.
However, no one would care about the lives of pharmaceutical sales representatives because they were just consumables.
But Lu Wenbin had never seen a pharmaceutical sales representative like this before.
However, Lu Wenbin’s adaptability was very strong.
In just a few seconds, he showed a foolish smile as if he had his questions answered.
“Yunli, huh?”
The chef nodded and asked, “There are rice noodles and noodles.
Which one do you prefer?”
“Rice noodles, I guess...”
“Do you want eggs?
Fried eggs or boiled eggs?”
“Fried eggs.”
“Okay.
Please wait a minute.
Is there anything you can’t eat or are allergic to?”
“No.”
Lu Wenbin shook his head.
After a few seconds, he turned around and saw that Tian Qi was sitting at the table at the center and was eating quietly.
When he looked carefully, Ling Ran, who sat in front of Tian Qi, was also eating quietly.
“Miss Tian is also one of the pharmaceutical sales representatives from Yunli Medical Company.” The chef grinned while he explained.
Lu Wenbin was impressed.
“Pharmaceutical sales representatives truly have all sorts of talented people hidden among them.”
“There are bite-sized fried lard, steak, small lamb chops, and fried fish.
Which side dish would you want?” The chef did not continue the topic of conversation and asked with a boisterous voice.
“You have steak and lamb chop as well?” Lu Wenbin frowned and asked, “That’s too greasy.
Who will eat that sort of stuff so early in the morning?”
“The steak is top quality Zebu meat selected from Brazil.
It was brought from Brazil to Yun Hua and slaughtered.
The lamb chop is fried in the style of the French.
The meat texture is tender, and the smell of mutton is completely gone.”
Lu Wenbin remained silent for a few seconds.
“I want it all.”
The chef was used to it.
“Okay.”
“Get me another pork trotter.
Pork trotters are a must in this cafeteria.” Lu Wenbin’s mind seemed to be working again, and he stated something born from his own persistence.
The chef also said persistently, “Pork trotters do not match well with rice noodles.”
“Don’t you say that.” Lu Wenbin raised his head and looked calm.
“Yesterday, I cut someone up.”
The chef trembled.
“Why?”
Lu Wenbin’s gaze was distant.
“One idiot went to his father’s grave to honor him—Sorry, I meant that someone went to his father’s grave to honor him.
He went with another idiot—Sorry, I mean that he went with another person and decided to use the old hunting gun his father hid in the cellar forty years ago.
And there was an in-bore premature detonation.”
The chef was stunned and thought for a while before he said, “Luckily the other idiot...
No, I mean, the other person is fine.”
“Oh, the other one got one of his eyes blinded and was sent to the Ophthalmology Department.” Lu Wenbin raised his head again and said, “Remember to add pork trotters into the rice noodles.”
“Okay.” The chef gave a smile.
A while later, Lu Wenbin carried his bowl and sat at the corner.
He was not stupid enough to rush over to Ling Ran’s table to greet him.
That bowl of rice noodles made Lu Wenbin sweat.
When he looked up again, he saw Huo Congjun come in through the door.
Lu Wenbin immediately lowered his head and kept pretending to eat.
He looked as if he was acting in a sketch.
“Ling Ran.” Huo Congjun sounded very happy.
“Department Director Huo,” Ling Ran replied.
“Department Director Huo!” Tian Qi sounded very sweet and gave up some space.
“Did you stay up late?
Want to grab some soup?”
“No need.
I’ll just talk for a while and leave.” Huo Congjun immediately sat in front of Ling Ran and said, “Let me introduce you to a surgeon going through in-service training.”
A surgeon going through in-service training was a doctor sent over from a low-ranking hospital to a high-ranking hospital.
Since this kind of doctor was more mature, they were considered as favored cheap labor in all departments.
But since Ling Ran did not have any sort of preference for any doctor, he just nodded.
“Sure.”
“Hmm...
This man is an attending physician from the county hospital of Qiu County.
He probably wants to learn something before he’s promoted to an assistant lecturer.
He’s rather good at handling matters, so you can use him for two months.” Huo Congjun chuckled and said, “He mainly wants to learn about abdominoscopy.
Just teach him according to the situation.”
Lu Wenbin frowned as he heard that.
Ling Ran’s treatment group had free reign over any new venture it had in mind.
If a mature doctor suddenly came over to learn from Ling Ran, he would be like soup being boiled into stew, over a large flame!
He was a great threat.

chapters.title: Chapter 830: Telling Jokes
paragraphs: In the afternoon, Ling Ran saw the surgeon mentioned by Department Director Huo to be in Yun Hua Hospital for in-service training. He was Ren Qi, a senior attending physician who came from the General Surgery Department of the county hospital in Qiu County.

Ren Qi was a fat middle-aged man with an average body size. As a member of society who sang daily in karaoke boxes in a small province, he was considered to have put in effort in keeping his body figure at an average to obese level.

Ren Qi was still quite proud of his own effort. After he came to Ling Ran’s treatment group and introduced himself, he said proudly, “I personally do not have any talents, but I can endure hardship. Doctor Ling, if you have anything you need me to do, please tell me. I will complete it even if I need to do it until midnight.”
After he said that, the doctors in Ling Ran’s treatment group stared at each other and communicated using their eyes.

Zuo Cidian thought. ‘This man probably has no background, and when I say probably, I mean around 85%. At least, he doesn’t have anyone supporting him at Yun Hua Hospital. If he did, then he should know that midnight is the time for us to perform surgery at Yun Hua Hospital, because everyone in Yun Hua Hospital knows this. If he went and did miscellaneous tasks, does that mean that he can ignore all the important tasks?’

Lu Wenbin thought. ‘Sounds like he’s making himself sound great. Enduring hardship? Working until midnight isn’t considered enduring hardship. Have I told you about the story where I read until midnight, sleep for two hours, and wake up to cook pork trotters? I think he’s trying to draw a line for himself and let us be unable to arrange work for him. I say, could it be that someone with a powerful background had taught him about this?’
Ma Yanlin thought. ‘I’m a normal person. I had a deep sleep yesterday. I fell asleep while hugging my wife.’
“You came over for in service training. Which area do you want to focus on?” Ling Ran’s attitude was quite cordial.

He did not care what others did, mainly because the people around him always talked about what they did, and it was impossible for him to care about all that. In comparison, Ling Ran would care more about the person himself.

While facing the group of people in white coats, Ren Qi said with his normal attitude. “I’m truly lucky to be able to learn in your group, Doctor Ling. I do not mind learning anything at all, and I don’t have any specific limitations about what I want to learn. I’m willing to learn even if it’s just a little bit.”

Zuo Cidian focused his eyes and pursed his lips. This person was able to say such words without being drunk, and this showed that he could really lower his own status. This sort of person will be able to survive in places like county hospitals as long as he was a little skilled.

Zuo Cidian did not take him seriously. If this were Zuo Cidian who first came and only had the experience of working in the town hospital, he would definitely treat Ren Qi as a great enemy. However, Zuo Cidian was no longer that new resident doctor who was in his forties.
He became older.

Furthermore, Zuo Cidian had seen the way the doctors at Yun Hua Hospital did things, went to the Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center at Shanghai, and accompanied Ling Ran for a freelance surgery at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Beijing Medical University. Thus, he slowly developed a new concept: the experts with excellent skills, especially those in rural areas, will usually be very bad when it comes to buttering up to others.

It was not that they did not butter up to anyone at all, but because they did not have many chances to learn, and their skills in buttering up to others was not sufficient. They were also not too shameless just yet.

Ren Qi was only of average skill when it came to buttering up to others, but he was shameless. That meant that he was the kind of doctor who practiced buttering up and only had average talent in this field. His skill level as a surgeon was probably not good as well. Zuo Cidian shook his head secretly. ‘Doctor Ling is not someone you can hope for support just by relying on buttering up to him.’

“What surgeries are you mainly performing now?” Zhang Anmin stood out from behindLing Ran. He purposely came over as he heard that there was a surgeon who came here for in service training, and he was even from the field of general surgery.

Surgeons who came for in service training, interns, and housemen were totally different, especially the person who came over today. A senior attending physician from the county hospital might have even performed more surgeries than Zhang Anmin. Of course, he might not be able to compare to Zhang Anmin when it came to the surgery level and quality, but that might not always be true. Yun Hua Hospital was only the top hospital at the regional level, after all, and Zhang Anmin had previously been suppressed. Before he came to Ling Ran, he never touched livers before, and he only did crude surgeries like cholecystectomy. He only got started to perform the finer surgeries within this year.

With such a background, Zhang Anmin became sensitive to surgeons who came for in service training, because both of their identities were quite similar, and theoretically speaking, general surgeries covered hepatobiliary surgery...

It can be said that Zhang Anmin’s greatest concern was the areas Ren Qi covered for his surgeries. If possible, Zhang Anmin would even want to defeat his opponent with this. After all, Doctor Ling learnt cholecystectomy from him.

Ren Qi could hardly recognize the doctors’ faces. He just smiled. “When I’m at the county hospital, I perform all surgeries in the General Surgery Department, including the commonly seen appendicitis, intestinal obstruction, cholecystitis, and also intestinal cancer surgery as well as hepatectomy for major parts of the liver...”
“You’ve done quite a lot, huh...?” Zhang Anmin was a bit jealous for some reason when he heard that.
Ren Qi chuckled. “We just do what we can do in the county hospital. Most of us are in the field of general surgery.”

“It’s impossible to learn Doctor Ling’s skill within two months. By the way, what is the best type of surgery you can perform?” Zhang Anmin could not hold it anymore and decided to make Ren Qi slightly uncomfortable, and he can already be considered to have given a chance for Ren Qi to get used to being bullied. This did not fit his status as an associate chief physician, but at this moment, who would care?
Ren Qi coughed and said, “I wouldn’t say I’m good at any of them. Most of the surgeries I do are treating appendicitis and cholecystitis ...”
“Try and do it.” Ling Ran did not wait for them to continue. He waved his hand and said to Zuo Cidian, “Have him become an assistant for some surgeries.”
“Okay.” Zuo Cidian agreed and asked Ren Qi, “Is it okay if we perform surgeries until six o’clock or seven o’clock?”
“Sure, no problem.” Ren Qi immediately agreed. He smiled and said, “Sometimes, I’ll perform surgeries until around one o’clock or two o’clock in the morning.”
Zuo Cidian smiled faintly. “Sometimes we’ll do surgeries until one o’clock or two o’clock in the morning as well.”
“I know, right? I’m okay with working until seven o’clock.”
Zuo Cidian continued to smile faintly. “Have you made arrangements for your accommodation?”
“Yes. Department Director Huo arranged for me to stay at the hostel for one person.”
“Okay then.” Zuo Cidian stood up and found Ren Qi a working space.
Ren Qi watched the smiles on everyone’s faces while he remained on high alert. He quietly pulled Zuo Cidian to the side and said, “Doctor Zuo, did I boast too much just now?”
Zuo Cidian smiled warmly. “Did you boast just now?”
“I’m not too sure too...” Ren Qi said tentatively, “But I just feel like everyone wants to laugh at me...”

Zuo Cidian saw the anxiety in Ren Qi and remembered when he first came to Yun Hua Hospital. His heart went out for Ren Qi, and he reminded Ren Qi, “Since everyone wants to laugh at you, you should just let them do so. As the saying goes, just go along with the flow. If you cannot resist it, you might as well enjoy the ride.”
Ren Qi felt his heart tense. “Is... it?”
“Just listen to my advice.” Zuo Cidian patted Ren Qi’s shoulder and went away.
In the afternoon, as the other departments also got to work, Ling Ran’s treatment group was separated into three teams, and they started to work.

Today, Yu Yuan was still the one who was on duty in the Emergency Treatment, since she was weak, and it was Ma Yanlin’s turn to be the chief surgeon. Lu Wenbin and another houseman were in the other operating theater and doing surgery preparation for Ling Ran.
The first surgery in the afternoon was knee arthroscopy, which was a relatively easy surgery.
When Ling Ran went up the fray, he asked Ren Qi, “Have you done this before? Can you do it?”
“I performed two knee arthroscopies before. I should be okay,” Ren Qi immediately answered.
Ling Ran nodded and announced the start of the surgery.
The operating theater was silent.
The team was used to perform knee arthroscopies, and they were silent even when they passed the instruments and devices. Ling Ran could not even be bothered to speak.

Ren Qi looked around and remembered what Zuo Cidian had said before. He finally decided to cast away his shyness and said, “Then, let me tell the first joke. There is a rabbit and a tortoise in the jungle. The rabbit wore silk stockings and the tortoise wore...”

chapters.title: Chapter 831: What
paragraphs: “Finally, the tortoise raised its legs and revealed...
“Let me tell you another joke. One day, a bear suffered from breast cancer...
“You know about the legend where there are no donkeys in the area of Qian? The donkey in the legend...”
Ren Qi’s voice echoed throughout the operating theater, and he sounded like a jinn who was telling a joke.

Ling Ran did not stop him. Even though he did not like to chat, he would not stop other surgeons from chatting or playing music. Even though he found doctors who told jokes non-stop a little strange, to him, all other surgeons were about the same.

The anesthetist today was the one who administered anesthetics to Chestnut the dog. He did not stop Ren Qi from making jokes either, as matters concerning surgeons had nothing to do with anesthetists.

Ren Qi was talking so much that his throat had become dry, but he had no intention of stopping. Even though it was strange to tell so many jokes, since Doctor Zuo told him to do it, he had no choice but to play along. After all, a lot of surgeons were weirdos, and it was not considered weird at all for a surgeon of Ling Ran’s status to like to listen to jokes. Truth be told, when a surgeon had achieved the kind of success Ling Ran had, it would not even be strange if he were to summon two doctors over from Tianjin for in-service training just to tell him jokes.
At most, he would just send them away after he was done listening to their jokes.

When Ren Qi thought of this, his heart skipped a beat, and he could not help but slow down. ‘I must not tell the jokes too quickly. I must learn from the queen in One Thousand and One Nights and take my time so that I can survive in front of this king who likes to listen to jokes.’
“I’m done.”
The moment Ling Ran finished speaking, everyone in the operating theater sighed in relief in unison.
Ren Qi found it a little strange, and he could not help but ponder with his eyebrows furrowed. ‘Is there anything that’s very difficult about the surgery just now?’
He had basically never really performed arthroscopy before. However, this was due to the way his department delegated tasks to him, and not because it was difficult.

Although Ren Qi was suspicious, he breathed a sigh of relief. At least, he had smoothly carried out his first surgery in Yun Hua Hospital. Even though it was a little tiring to tell jokes nonstop for twenty or thirty minutes, at least he took the first step to fit into Yun Hua Hospital.
Ren Qi raised his head in anticipation and asked, “Will there be another surgery after this?”
The anesthetist who administered anesthetics to Chestnut the dog looked at Ren Qi with a smile, and his face looked as puffy as a Corgi’s butt.

The two nurses looked at Ren Qi with a smile too. They made sure that they were facing Ling Ran with the prettier side of their faces, and their faces were glowing as they had spent more than thirty minutes putting on makeup this morning.

“Which operating theater?” Ling Ran did not give Ren Qi a straightforward answer either. If he were to answer every question asked by idiotic junior doctors, he might as well become a school teacher rather than work as a senior doctor.
“Operating Theater 3,” the circulating nurse quickly answered.
Ling Ran nodded. He then turned and left.
Ren Qi had not regained his senses, and he stood dumbfoundedly in front of the operating theater.

“I thought that he seemed pretty clever.” When the anesthetist who administered anesthetics to Chestnut the dog saw that he was not moving at all, he could not help but shake his head. He quickly ran over to the door and stepped on the black pedal beside the door to open it.

Even though he was only an attending physician and belonged to the Department of Anesthesiology, based on how things were like in Yun Hua Hospital just now, even if he were bitten by a dog, he would crawl over to Ling Ran to serve him.
As a doctor in a hospital, he would not be able to get medical leave even if he were bitten by a dog.
Ling Ran did not stop at all as he walked.
He was used to having someone open the door for him. He flashed a polite smile at the anesthetist and walked toward Operating Theater 3.
This was when Ren Qi regained his senses, and he wanted to slap himself across the face so badly. He sped forward and thanked the anesthetist. “I’m really sorry. Sigh, I’m so dumb.”

“A lot of doctors who are here for in-service training are dumb. Even though both of them were attending physicians, Ren Qi was merely from a county hospital, and he was from Yun Hua Hospital. Ling Treatment Group was mainly focusing on hepatectomy right now. He was becoming more and more renowned, and on “Doctor’s Here”, he was already labeled as a “hepatectomy expert”. Some were from Yun Hua Hospital, some were from other provinces, and some came because other doctors recommended Ling Ran to them. Hence, it was now a common sight for members of Ling Treatment Group to be carrying out hepatectomy every week.

It was major surgery, so they could not focus on giving the doctor who was there for in-service training the opportunity to learn. They mainly let him act as the second assistant and contribute whatever he could.
Hence, there was no need for Ling Ran to explain things in detail to him.
Ling Ran quietly washed his hands step by step. He was neither slow nor fast, and he looked like he was taking a rest instead of washing his hands.

Ren Qi who was feeling bored as he washed his hands was reciting jokes again. He froze for a moment when he heard that. “Yes, there’s an MRI machine in our hospital too.”
An MRI machine cost millions of RMB. Even though it was quite rare a few years ago, ever since China started producing its own MRI machines, they were now a very common sight.

Ling Ran was done washing his hands. He said, “Later, you can take a look at the MRI scans before participating in the surgery. Prioritize the T1 axial plane images. There’s no need to look at all of them. Try to be as fast as possible.”
He fished out a towel from a bucket to dry his hands before walking over to the operating theater.
Ren Qi was a little dumbfounded. ‘What are T1 axial plane images?’

chapters.title: Chapter 832: A Cheery Atmosphere
paragraphs: “Show two sets of MRI scans.” Ling Ran clasped his hands beside his back as he stood in the operating theater and ordered his assistants to show the MRI scans.
Qu Xiaolian the houseman froze for a moment, but he did not say anything. He merely glanced at Ren Qi before walking to the computer and showing the MRI scans.

Ren Qi had just entered the operating theater, and he felt extremely diffident when he saw that the houseman was looking at him. He wanted to explain things, but he did not know a single person in the operating theater.
Ren Qi hesitated for a moment before saying with a shy smile, “There’s no need to switch on a computer just for me.”
“The assistants should understand the situation too,” Ling Ran turned and said, denying Ren Qi the opportunity to showcase his humility.
Qu Xiaolian continued switching on the computers to show the MRI scans.

Ren Qi’s smile became even more anguished. He wanted to help out, but he had already washed his hands, so he should not contaminate them. His face slowly turned stoic as he watched the junior doctors from Yun Hua Hospital work.
“The operating theater is pretty big.” Ren Qi tried to liven up the atmosphere.
No one in the operating theater smiled to play along with him.
Su Jiafu the anesthetist said, “Department Director Huo likes big ones.”
Ren Qi said with gratitude, “No wonder...”
“I’m talking about breasts,” Su Jiafu joked expressionlessly.

“My breasts are pretty big.” Ren Qi was the best at telling dirty jokes. In the operating theater of the provincial hospital he worked at, the atmosphere was the most cheery whenever someone told dirty jokes. Everyone would be smiling like one big happy family.
And the chief physicians often started scolding people the moment the dirty jokes ended.
Ren Qi would rather talk about his breasts and carry on with the dirty jokes than to let them stop.

Su Jiafu, though, froze. He had been working with members of the Ling Treatment Group for a long time, and he was used to how quiet they were. For a moment, he was not very used to having someone tell dirty jokes together with him.
“Is it a problem if they’re too big?” Ren Qi continued with a grin on his face.
Su Jiafu continued looking at Ren Qi in a daze. ‘The atmosphere in the operating theater had changed instead.’

“The scans are ready.” Qu Xiaolian did not take long. Everyone knew that Ling Ran would read the patient’s MRI scan the moment he entered the operating theater. This was especially true for major surgeries like hepatectomy, and it would not do for a surgeon to skip the step.

To junior doctors who were working under Ling Ran, persuading patients to get an MRI scan was an important task. This was because of how expensive it was to get an MRI scan, and there was a general consensus that it was not needed for many of the organs and body parts of the human body. Hence, the junior doctors had to spend a lot of energy to persuade patients to get this expensive scan done.
Aside from this, many doctors did not know how to read MRI scans. This was why certain patients were aversive to getting an MRI scan.
Truth be told, most surgeons did not know how to read MRI scans.
For example, Ren Qi the attending physician.
“I’ll scroll the page for you. Is this speed okay? This is the index page...” Qu Xiaolian earnestly explained things to Ren Qi.
As long as a doctor knew how to read MRI scans, no matter which Grade A hospital he came from, he was considered an excellent doctor.
Ren Qi the attending physician had no choice but to stand before the computer. He glanced at Qu Xiaolian who was scrolling the page, then at the monitor.
Several dozen MRI scans flashed past his eyes, and all of them were raw scans.
Ren Qi’s brain slowly stopped functioning.
A gradual change was happening to his thought process.
‘What on earth is this?
‘What on earth?
‘I’m afraid that I’m actually an idiot...’
After Ling Ran was done reading the MRI scans, he turned to glance at Ren Qi and asked, “Are you done? Or should we get started first?”
“I...” Ren Qi’s lips quivered a few times, and he did not know where to begin.
He was even feeling a little aggrieved.

‘If I knew how to read raw MRI scans, why would I come for in-service training in the field of surgery in Yun Hua Hospital? Wouldn’t it be better for me to head to the Medical Imaging Department? The environment there is cleaner, with very few cases of doctor-patient disputes. I’ll have quite a good income too. Most importantly, I won’t need to dig sh*t...”

“Spill the beans.” Zhang Anmin was being a little authoritative. Ling Ran did not like to talk in the operating theater, and the doctors working under him had to create an effective hierarchy so that the team could work together effectively. That was something crucial, as it tested the team members on how much they could cooperate with each other.
Right then, the doctors of the Ling Treatment Group had formed a consensus that they could scold doctors who were not part of their treatment group as much as they want to.
Ren Qi’s lips quivered again.
He wanted to apologize, but he ended up swallowing his words.

“I...” Ren Qi’s lips quivered a few more times, and he finally managed to speak. “I usually just read MRI scan reports. I thought that Doctor Ling was asking me if I know how to read MRI scan reports.”
For some reason, Zhang Anmin breathed a sigh of relief. “He wouldn’t have asked you anything if he was referring to the report.”
“You’re right.” Ren Qi lowered his head, but he was feeling a little indignant.
‘Learning how to read MRI scan reports takes time too, okay?
‘If everyone knew how to do it, patients wouldn’t need to waste time queuing up just to consult doctors.
‘Only a few doctors know how to do it in the provincial hospital I work in.’
As Ren Qi thought of this, he could not help but look at Ling Ran.
“Doctor Ling is an expert at reading MRI scans in our hospital,” Zhang Anmin said a little proudly.
“I have never expected there to be a surgeon who knows how to read raw MRI scans.” Ren Qi immediately flattered Ling Ran.
This time, no one said anything in response to his words.
Ren Qi gulped. “Let me tell you guys a joke...”
Ling Ran arched an eyebrow and glanced at Ren Qi. He did not say anything.
Zhang Anmin, though, had no problem with that. “Go ahead.”
“Sure.” Ren Qi breathed a sigh of relief. “There was a tortoise who wore a...”
Ling Ran stayed quiet as he operated on the patient.

He had carried out a lot of hepatectomies. But compared to other surgeries, hepatectomy was more interesting because there were plenty of variations when it came to the human liver and related structures.
Ling Ran soon became immersed in the surgery.
Zhang Anmin also became immersed in Ren Qi’s jokes.

He had been working with Ling Ran for quite some time. Whenever there was no other assistant, he would have no choice but to work quietly and play his part as a lonely assistant because anesthetists were more often than not zoning off. Nurses usually spent their time looking at Ling Ran, so they would not speak much either. Every time this happened, the atmosphere in the operating theater would become strange. This was especially true when an endotherm knife was used, causing the operating theater to smell like a barbeque restaurant.
As he got to listen to jokes, it was a relatively good working environment, and he felt calmer. He assisted Ling Ran while listening to the jokes.
Ren Qi told one joke after another.
And then another...
Ren Qi worked hard to tell jokes to prove his worth in the operating theater. “There was a tortoise who wore a—”
“You’ve already told this joke before.” Su Jiafu raised his head and said airily.
“Oh, I’m so sorry. I’m so sorry.” Ren Qi apologized profusely. “Let me tell you guys another joke. There was a tortoise who liked to take the bus.”
“You’ve already told this joke before.”
“Then, how about this? There was a tortoise who felt that turtles led a happy life...”
“You’ve already told this one before.” Zhang Anmin’s voice rang out. “Don’t you have any jokes that don’t involve tortoises?”
Ren Qi licked his dry lips in resignation. “I didn’t expect there to be so many surgeries today. After we’re done with all the surgeries today, I’ll search for more jokes.”
Zhang Anmin and Su Jiafu looked at each other. They then laughed out loud.
The two young nurses laughed too.
“That’s a good one.” There was a cheery atmosphere in the operating theater.
