chapters.title: Chapter 833: Abdominal Closure
paragraphs: At six in the evening, the fourth surgery was completed. Ling Ran examined everything and took off his gloves. “I’ll grab dinner first.”
Lu Wenbin, who was acting as the assistant, immediately hummed in acknowledgment. He had acted as the chief surgeon of two M-Tang surgeries today, and he was feeling extremely energetic.

Ling Ran nodded and exited the operating theater without bothering to wait for his assistants. This had always been the way things were in operating theaters. The chief surgeons enjoyed more freedom and better treatment. They did not have to do that many miscellaneous tasks. At the end of the day, it was because the chief surgeons’ time was the most precious.

To patients who were waiting to receive surgery or even those who were waiting to receive surgery but did not get a chance to, they only cared about being operated by top-notch doctors using cutting-edge equipment. They did not want junior doctors to touch them, because they were not skilled and attentive.
After Ling Ran left, Lu Wenbin did not carry on with the surgery either. He took a step back and said, “I’ll leave this to you guys.”

Qu Xiaolian the houseman was a junior doctor among junior doctors, and he charged toward the patient whose abdomen was open with a delighted expression. Ren Qi who was in Yun Hua Hospital for in-service training hesitated for a moment. He was neither proactive nor passive.
Naturally, Ren Qi did not care much for abdominal closure. However, since he knew that Lu Wenbin wanted to see him in action, he said nothing and got started.

If a doctor from another hospital was in the provincial hospital he worked in for in-service training, Ren Qi would have done the same. Abdominal closure was a simple procedure, but it showcased a surgeons’ habits and basic capabilities. Even though not all surgeons who could perform abdominal closure well were good surgeons, doctors who were supervising them could test on more difficult procedures in the future or even let them perform certain maneuvers on their own. If the surgeon failed to perform abdominal closure well, senior doctors would at most give them another chance or two to prove their worth. If they failed to do that, it meant that they were sh*tty doctors.

Qu Xiaolian stood opposite Ren Qi and helped him out by holding the surgical thread. He was watching Ren Qi work with widened eyes, and he imagined himself being the one who was doing it instead and tried to remember every single step.
Meanwhile, Lu Wenbin watched them with his hands clasped behind his back.

If abdominal closure was not done well, it could bring about plenty of consequences. For example, some patients’ wounds would get infected repeatedly and take a long time to heal. This caused a great deal of pain.

There were no neurons in most of the organs such as the stomach and the liver. So, even though half of them were removed, which caused a lot of damage to the body, the patients themselves would not know, because they could not see it. However, even though the damage caused by surgical incisions was minimal, if a patient’s wound were to get infected with pus flowing out from it right before his eyes, he would feel a lot of pain. Even though it was a minor, non-fatal issue, this would make the patient extremely sad, and he would grumble about it.
Since Lu Wenbin was the doctor in charge, he placed a lot of emphasis on the abdominal closure being performed well. He watched Ren Qi like a hawk and was prepared to order him to stop at any moment.

To large tertiary Grade A hospitals like Yun Hua Hospital, doctors who were there for in-service training were seen as cheap labor. Even though those in the hospital would be happy if they were skilled, they would not be that happy. After all, they would be gone a few months later. If they were mediocre or even lousy, those in the hospital would not mind either as long as they did not cause major trouble. They got to enjoy free labor anyway, but there were times where they would not use them at all.
No matter how stupid a surgeon was, he could be put to good use. He could even replace someone on a night shift.

Hence, Lu Wenbin only cared about whether Ren Qi could suture the patient’s incision well. He did not mind ordering Ren Qi to stop should the situation call for it even though it would affect Ren Qi’s learning progress.
Ren Qi was anxious but skillful as he performed abdominal closure.
A few minutes later, he was drenched in sweat.

“Please wipe off my sweat for me.” Ren Qi did not want his sweat to drip onto the operating table. This was a low-level error that would only be excused if it were to happen with medical interns. If an experienced doctor like him were to make such a mistake, he would become the brunt of many jokes.
One of the nurses picked up a cotton gauze with a pair of forceps and wiped the sweat off Ren Qi’s forehead carelessly.
“Thank you very much.” Ren Qi thanked the nurse profusely.

Back in the provincial hospital, he scolded nurses all the time. However, now that he was going through in-service training in the large hospital, Ren Qi knew that nurses and junior doctors were the people that he should avoid offending the most.
What senior doctors and leaders of the hospital thought of him, though, did not have much to do with him.

Lu Wenbin hummed in acknowledgment and asked, “Did you forget something?”
“Forget...” Ren Qi was immediately on his toes and started thinking about it. A few seconds later, he said slowly, “I forgot to tell jokes just now.”
Lu Wenbin’s lips quivered a few times. He cleared his throat and said, “You can go for dinner after you help with cleaning up the operating theater.”

After Lu Wenbin said that, he left, leaving the houseman, Ren Qi and a couple of nurses in the operating theater. They cleaned the operating theater while counting how many pieces of gauze had been used during the surgery.
After everything was done, Ren Qi did not dare to take his time eating dinner either. He simply purchased a few steamed buns to fill his tummy before rushing back to the Operating Area again.
All the medical interns and housemen working under the Ling Treatment Group did this. Meanwhile, those working under other treatment groups sat down in the cafeteria and ate slowly.

This was because other treatment groups did not carry out as many surgeries. Aside from this, the number of opportunities other treatment groups gave to junior doctors to perform was different as well.

Treatment groups other than the Ling Treatment Group only carried out around twenty surgeries a week, and those were not even enough to go around the attending physicians and experienced resident doctors. Hence, junior doctors, as well as housemen and medical interns, got very few opportunities to perform. Even if those junior doctors were to charge back to the operating theater after their dinner break, they would not even get the opportunity to perform abdominal closure. Hence, it was natural that they were not as driven.

Aside from this, there could only be a limited number of people in the operating theater. When senior doctors did not need to carry out many surgeries, they naturally would not force junior doctors to be present. This was especially true for departments such as the Emergency Department. There were plenty of tasks that must be done every day. Senior doctors preferred to make those junior doctors carry out miscellaneous tasks.

Ren Qi, though, was a little tired. When he arrived at the operating theater, he realized that the surgery had already started. He walked over to the operating table to take a look. When he saw Zuo Cidian, he quickly greeted him and said with a smile, “Doctor Ling is operating on a patient again right after having dinner. He’s such a dedicated doctor. What time would we be done today?”

“This is the last surgery today.” Zuo Cidian smiled and said, “Lately, Doctor Ling has the habit of operating on a patient after dinner. He said that it’s a good way to unwind, just like how people take a walk after meals. He’ll head home after he’s done.”
Ren Qi nodded dumbfoundedly. “Operating on a patient after dinner?”
“Yes, it’s something along those lines.” Zuo Cidian smiled with his hands crossed before his chest. “You’re not needed here anymore. You can go back early and take a rest.”
“Oh, alright...” Ren Qi said, but he was reluctant to leave. “I’m not too tired yet, so I would like to take a look.”

He was not here in Yun Hua Hospital to get tortured. He had the intention of leveling up his skills. Hence, even though Ling Ran was only performing a cholecystectomy using a laparoscope, he did not want to give up the opportunity to learn.
Naturally, Zuo Cidian did not insist. He merely smiled and said, “Go ahead if you want to. If you have the energy, you can come to work earlier tomorrow morning.”
“Sure, no problem.” Ren Qi immediately agreed.
“Our working hours are long. Are you able to get used to it?” Zuo Cidian asked with a smile.
“It’s not a problem. Back in the county hospital I worked in, we would work until seven in the evening too.”
“Great, then. But when I said that we wake up early in the morning, I mean that we wake up super early. Just let me know if you find it tiring, and I can adjust your schedule.”

“Alright, I understand.” Ren Qi started laughing as he spoke. He said with a relaxed expression, “Back when I was a medical student, medical interns even had to wash toilets. It’s very normal for me to wake up early. Oh, by the way, what time do you guys usually come over in the morning?”
“About four or five. You just need to remember to come here half an hour earlier than Doctor Ling.”
“Four or five?”
“Sometimes, in extreme cases, you would need to come here at two or three in the morning. But this is quite rare. If you’re coming over tomorrow morning, you can come at three or three-thirty.”
Ren Qi finally started trembling. “So, our actual working hours are from three in the morning to seven in the evening?”
“Yes, something along those lines.”
Ren Qi looked around vigilantly and asked, “By the way, where is the toilet located in Yun Hua Hospital?”

chapters.title: Chapter 834: You Want to Ask Me for a Favor
paragraphs: Ling Ran operated on a patient after dinner. He then headed home in a leisurely manner.

At that point, only 120 beds were assigned to him. However, he could also occupy some hospital beds that belonged to other treatment groups or other departments such as the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. So, he actually had access to around 150 hospital beds. If he were to emulate other hospitals and only keep patients for a short time, he was supposed to have enough hospital beds to go around.
However, most of the surgical methods Ling Ran carried out did not allow the patients to stay in the hospital for a mere fifteen days.

Take hepatectomy, finger replantation surgery, and Achilles tendon repair as examples. For optimal recovery, they had to invest a lot of time in the patients. It was normal for those patients to stay in the hospital for a total of twenty days or even thirty days.

Aside from this, the other members of the Ling Treatment Group were also acting as a chief surgeon in more and more surgeries. So, it was unavoidable that the Ling Treatment Group was experiencing a shortage of hospital beds.

It was impossible for them to procure more hospital beds to solve this problem, as the Ling Treatment Group was already in charge of the most number of hospital beds in Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center. Even if he were to fight for that, he would not be able to get many more hospital beds. With the number of hospital beds that were assigned to him right now, some smaller secondary hospitals might have even fewer hospital beds than that. Of course, in reality, most secondary hospitals did not even carry out as many surgeries and had as many patients as the Ling Treatment Group.
This was how things were like in the field of medicine right now. It was normal for a secondary hospital to be inferior to an excellent treatment group from a tertiary Grade A hospital.

This phenomenon was not only seen in the Ling Treatment Group. The biggest treatment group of the General Surgery Department of Yun Hua Hospital had five associate chief physicians and two chief physicians alone. They also had around four or five attending physicians and a herd of resident doctors. This treatment group could carry out ten surgeries simultaneously, and it was not a problem for them to perform as many surgeries in a month as a secondary hospital did in a year. Of course, things were even more extravagant in the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, which was a massive hospital. They performed 35,000 surgeries in a year. There were around two thousand hospitals in Canada, and this was basically one-third of the total surgeries carried out in Canada annually. In other words, if the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou Hospital were to be placed in Canada, it would theoretically provide an instant fix to the shortage of medical providers in Canada.

Unfortunately, Yun Hua Hospital could not expand indefinitely. The wards there were crowded, and there was not enough space. Additionally, the mental stress that nurses and doctors in charge experienced whenever there were too many patients was self-evident.
The most suitable choice would involve lowering the number of surgeries performed every day so that there were more medical staff members to go around.

As for Ling Ran, he reduced the number of surgeries where the patients would have to stay in the hospital for a long time and carried out more surgeries whereby patients could be discharged after a short stay.
Correspondingly, he got more time to rest because of this.
When Ling Ran arrived home at Lower Groove Clinic, Ling Jiezhou was already done cooking. He was setting up the table.

Ever since Lower Groove Clinic was renovated, not only was it larger, but the boundary between their living space and the clinic had become clearer. Now, the members of the Ling family could enjoy having their meals in a secluded dining room. They no longer had to worry about their neighbors asking them for food, or feel embarrassed because they did not offer their neighbors any food.

“Wow, dinner is very scrumptious today.” Ling Ran looked at the dishes on the table. There were fish, chicken, pork, and beef. There was even Japanese-style sukiyaki. It was obvious that his father had put in a lot of effort.
Ling Jiezhou laughed with his hands on his waist.
Ling Ran furrowed his eyebrows. “Don’t tell me that you guys are going on another vacation.”
Ling Jiezhou sprained his waist, and he almost cursed. “You brat, can’t your father make you guys some good food?”
“Did you piss mom off again?” Ling Ran continued inquiring.
“No!” Ling Jiezhou was so pissed that he raised his voice.
Ling Ran was not intimidated, and he continued inquiring. “Are we having a guest?”
Ling Ran immediately understood. He nodded and said, “Then, that means you didn’t cook these.”
“How can you taint my innocence like that?” Ling Jiezhou was so pissed that his lips started to quiver, and he even quoted a line from Kong Yiji.
Ling Ran wore a calm expression as he waited for the drama to unfold.
Finally, Ling Jiezhou sighed loudly and said tiredly, “Son, you don’t even know how to act dumb. After you become a member of the society, you will be at a huge disadvantage.”
“I’m already part of the society.”

“Being a doctor isn’t the same, especially when it comes to doctors like you. So many people are attending to you that you can no longer tell the wheat from beans.” Ling Jiezhou seemed to be truly worried.
Ling Ran looked suspiciously at his father, but he suppressed the urge to ask him what was going on. He merely looked quietly at Ling Jiezhou.

As expected, a few seconds later, Ling Jiezhou could not hold it in anymore. “For example, today, two pharmaceutical sales representatives from medical companies came over. They offered to help out with chores and stuff, but in the end, they almost started fighting. What else could I do?”
Ling Ran nodded and asked, “Which companies are they from?”

“Changxi Medical Company and Yunli Medical Company, I think. They looked very proactive, so they should be from normal medical companies.” Ling Jiezhou glanced at his son and continued, “I didn’t make them do much. I merely asked them to buy some groceries at the wet market and make them wash those vegetables. I then asked them to cook a few dishes. I paid them for the meat and vegetables.”
Ling Ran looked at the dishes on the table. There were eight dishes and a pot of soup. It seemed that one of them had cooked four dishes, and the other one had made five dishes.

“Alright, go and tell your mother that it’s time for dinner. Both of the pharmaceutical sales representatives have left. I asked them to stay for dinner, but they were against it.” Ling Jiezhou still felt a little guilty. When he said this, he reminded Ling Ran of something. “Don’t tell her that I asked them to cook. She insists on not allowing this sort of attitude, but I was really too busy today.”
Ling Ran flashed his father a meaningful smile.

He left the dining room and headed to the tea room to relay his father’s message. All the neighbors who were sitting around Tao Ping’s tea table excused themselves. They either went for a fluid transfusion or retrieved medications before they went home for dinner.

For a very long time, that was how Lower Groove Clinic sustained its business. If Tao Ping did not hold her tea and embroidery sessions as well as the book club, the neighbors might have headed to the competitors of Lower Groove Clinic that were better equipped instead.

“Juan Zi is on a diet and she’s not eating, so she can stand guard at the clinic. Doctor Xiong is here, so do go ahead and ask him to join us.” Tao Ping made arrangements, and Ling Ran acted accordingly.
Since there were no resident doctors and medical interns at home, he could only do everything by himself.
Soon, Doctor Xiong entered the dining room and sat beside the dining table as he fanned himself with a paper fan.
Ling Jiezhou greeted him enthusiastically. “I was having a headache over having made too much food. I got bored today...”
Doctor Xiong did not buy it at all. He fanned himself and smiled, “Someone else is coming, isn’t it?”
“No. Since Juan Zi isn’t eating, it’s just the four of us.” Ling Jiezhou smiled.
Doctor Xiong shook his head. “You pissed your wife off again, right?”
Ling Jiezhou put an arm around Tao Ping and raised his chin.
Doctor Xiong furrowed his eyebrows and pondered earnestly. “If that’s so, there’s only one possibility...”

Ling Jiezhou immediately got anxious. During this old man’s sixty-fifth birthday, his granddaughter gave him a fan. She said that it was befitting for him, as he was as intelligent as Zhuge Liang. Ever since then, he carried the fan and liked to act like a detective. Ling Jiezhou did not hide the fact that the pharmaceutical sales representatives were around today.
“I know!” Doctor Xiong slapped the fan onto his palm, and the pain made him shiver. “You want to ask me for a favor, right?”

I merely asked them to buy some groceries at the wet market and make them wash those vegetables.
I then asked them to cook a few dishes.
I paid them for the meat and vegetables.”
Ling Ran looked at the dishes on the table.
There were eight dishes and a pot of soup.
It seemed that one of them had cooked four dishes, and the other one had made five dishes.
“Alright, go and tell your mother that it’s time for dinner.
Both of the pharmaceutical sales representatives have left.
I asked them to stay for dinner, but they were against it.” Ling Jiezhou still felt a little guilty.
When he said this, he reminded Ling Ran of something.
“Don’t tell her that I asked them to cook.
She insists on not allowing this sort of attitude, but I was really too busy today.”
Ling Ran flashed his father a meaningful smile.
He left the dining room and headed to the tea room to relay his father’s message.
All the neighbors who were sitting around Tao Ping’s tea table excused themselves.
They either went for a fluid transfusion or retrieved medications before they went home for dinner.
For a very long time, that was how Lower Groove Clinic sustained its business.
If Tao Ping did not hold her tea and embroidery sessions as well as the book club, the neighbors might have headed to the competitors of Lower Groove Clinic that were better equipped instead.
“Juan Zi is on a diet and she’s not eating, so she can stand guard at the clinic.
Doctor Xiong is here, so do go ahead and ask him to join us.” Tao Ping made arrangements, and Ling Ran acted accordingly.
Since there were no resident doctors and medical interns at home, he could only do everything by himself.
Soon, Doctor Xiong entered the dining room and sat beside the dining table as he fanned himself with a paper fan.
Ling Jiezhou greeted him enthusiastically.
“I was having a headache over having made too much food.
I got bored today...”
Doctor Xiong did not buy it at all.
He fanned himself and smiled, “Someone else is coming, isn’t it?”
“No.
Since Juan Zi isn’t eating, it’s just the four of us.” Ling Jiezhou smiled.
Doctor Xiong shook his head.
“You pissed your wife off again, right?”
Ling Jiezhou put an arm around Tao Ping and raised his chin.
Doctor Xiong furrowed his eyebrows and pondered earnestly.
“If that’s so, there’s only one possibility...”
Ling Jiezhou immediately got anxious.
During this old man’s sixty-fifth birthday, his granddaughter gave him a fan.
She said that it was befitting for him, as he was as intelligent as Zhuge Liang.
Ever since then, he carried the fan and liked to act like a detective.
Ling Jiezhou did not hide the fact that the pharmaceutical sales representatives were around today.
“I know!” Doctor Xiong slapped the fan onto his palm, and the pain made him shiver.
“You want to ask me for a favor, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 835: Iron Body
paragraphs: “Why should I beg you?” Ling Jiezhou retorted Doctor Xiong as usual, and he said, “Today, I cooked some good dishes, and I just want to treat you to some.”

“Treating me with good dishes is not as good as increasing my salary.” Doctor Xiong snorted before he said, “Do you know how much of my workload has increased recently? There’s only Juan Zi and me around, and we’re so busy that we’re almost dead.”
“Old Miao is still here, right?” Ling Jiezhou felt slightly guilty when he heard about the salary increment.

Old Xiong snorted. “Old Miao is busy with his own business, and now, he always asks Juan Zi to help him out. I must say, Juan Zi is very busy, and she always needs to work here and there. She might be strong like iron, but even her strength is limited. Of course, Juan Zi can do a lot more work, but we shouldn’t add to her workload.”
“You’re right.” Ling Jiezhou felt even more guilty.
Old Xiong did not show any mercy, and he took the opportunity to say, “Old Ling, the recent business in your clinic is quite good. Shouldn’t you hire a nurse?”

“Hire another one? No way.” Ling Jiezhou shook his head again. His Lower Groove Clinic survived by controlling costs. Take hiring Old Xiong for example, although he was old, his salary was the lowest that could be found in the market.
If he hired another person, just how much would that cost him?
“If you can’t, you must tell Old Miao that Juan Zi can’t afford to work for both sides.”

“Sigh... this is... Old Xiong, please take a seat first, alright?” Ling Jiezhou let Old Xiong take his seat, then he turned around, looked at his son, who showed a faint smile, and got angry suddenly. But at the next moment, he came up with a thought. “Old Xiong, look, can’t we ask those pharmaceutical sales representatives for help?”

Old Xiong could not help but gave Ling Jiezhou a sidelong glance. Then he clicked his tongue and said, “I did not expect that you, Old Ling, actually have the potential of a department director despite looking like a chivalrous person.”
Ling Jiezhou showed a simple and honest smile. “We are a medical family.”
Old Xiong said, “In other medical families, it’s usually the father guiding the son.”
Ling Jiezhou immediately had his smile fade away.
Tao Ping smiled and said, “It’s been really busy recently, we should just hire another nurse.”
“We’ll have to pay a lot to hire a nurse,” Ling Jiezhou mumbled and sighed. “Alright, I’ll go get a nurse.”
“As soon as possible,” Old Xiong said. Then, he gave a reminder. “If we can’t handle the customers anymore, the patients who come from afar will not be happy, and you can’t compensate for it.”

“How far can they come from? The furthest is those from Upper Groove.” Ling Jiezhou knew his own business well. No matter how well a community health center was run, it could only attract so many people. Even their current scale of business was also because everyone worked hard.
However, it was also because everyone had worked hard for it that Ling Jiezhou compromised to the situation.
“Sigh, now, I’ll have to spend another two thousand per month.” As Ling Jiezhou spoke, he lost his appetite to eat.
Old Xiong sighed. “In the current economy, you can’t hire anyone with two thousand RMB per month.”
“I know,” Ling Jiezhou mumbled and said nothing else.
Ling Ran sat at the place near the door while he happily had his meal.
The relaxing feeling at home could not be found in the hospital, and it made Ling Ran so excited that he even wanted to perform a few rounds of suturing.
After getting a night of good sleep, the morning of the next day, Ling Ran returned to the hospital, did seven surgeries, and rested again.
When he clocked off work, the day shift of the Emergency Department had not even ended.
Over the next few days, he operated in a similar fashion.

Aside from the lucky members who became the chief surgeon for the surgeries, most of the doctors could clock off work at four or five in the afternoon. At the moment, the doctors from Ling Ran’s treatment group felt a sense of relaxation.
Except for Ren Qi, the in-service training doctor.
Another day arrived. When Ren Qi walked out of the dark underground parking lot at half-past three in the morning, Ren Qi’s tears started streaming down.
People always said men should not shed tears easily, but could it be easy to wake up at three in the early morning every day?
Ren Qi felt that his body was dying.

After working for almost ten years in the county hospital, Ren Qi felt that he was already very hardworking, but when he compared himself with the doctors in Yun Hua Hospital, he found that he might actually be very hardworking. Just a few days of in-service training in the Emergency Medical Center of Yun Hua Hospital was enough to make Ren Qi feel despair.
*Ding*
The lift let out a beep, so Ren Qi quickly wiped the tears off his eyes.
When he entered the operating area, Ren Qi looked like a hardworking doctor getting in-service training again.
“Doctor Lu, you’re already here?” In the dressing room, Ren Qi recognized Lu Wenbin when he saw a nude back.
Ren Qi did not see many surgeons who could train up their bodies until they were built like the Hulk, so Lu Wenbin was considered someone to be incredibly unique, and he was rich.
Lu Wenbin turned his head around gently, saw Ren Qi, and nodded, “Yes.”
“Doctor Lu, you come very early in the morning. What time did you come?”
“After two,” Lu Wenbin calmly answered.
“After two... You just slept for a few hours.”

“I slept directly when I went back home. If I sleep starting from eight to two, that means I’ve slept for six hours.” When Lu Wenbin finished speaking, he spoke naturally again, “I’m alone when I go back, anyway. I have nothing to do if I don’t just sleep.”

Ren Qi understood what he meant, and he shook his head in resignation, “You come to work at dawn, then you go back home and sleep. If you do that, you won’t be able to find someone to sleep with, you know?”
Lu Wenbin’s biceps trembled.
Ren Qi obviously saw Lu Wenbin’s elbows became bigger.
Ren Qi dared not trigger him anymore, so he quickly said, “So, Doctor Lu, according to our current rhythm in performing surgeries, how long will this last?”
“I’m not sure, too. Maybe ten days to two weeks, maybe just a few days more.” Lu Wenbin slowly put on his scrubs, deflated his belly, and started to think about his own troubles.
Ren Qi sighed. “It’s my fault to come at this time. If I came after ten days or two weeks, it’ll be better, right?”
“Do you also like to perform surgery?” Lu Wenbin looked at Ren Qi skeptically.
Ren Qi laughed. “There should be a limit, no matter how much I like it. I don’t like performing surgeries day and night.”
Lu Wenbin understood what he meant slightly, and he could not help but grin. “After ten days to two weeks, you will start feeling nostalgic to the time now.”
“Huh?”

“Because considering the surgery volume we had over the recent months, I dare say that we’ve had the least surgeries to do over these past few days.” Lu Wenbin gave his reply, then he saw Ren Qi’s face changing from surprise to despair.
Then... Ren Qi suddenly walked quickly and looked at the surgical schedule hanging on the door. His finger went down the schedule.
When Ren Qi’s finger stopped, he was pointing at a few big words—Single site laparoscopy.
“Haven’t you performed a single site laparoscopy yet?” Lu Wenbin saw Ren Qi’s choice.
Ren Qi was slightly embarrassed and troubled when he nodded.

Compared to normal laparoscopy that only created three ports on the belly, single-site laparoscopy needed only to pierce through the belly button, and it was more advantageous in terms of difficulty and recovery period.
The only disadvantage was that the difficulty of the surgery for the surgeon would be increased.

While he stared at the words that spelled single-site laparoscopy, Ren Qi found himself a little unsettled. For him, this skill was very practical. When he went back to the county hospital later, he could just buy a few instruments and launch a new surgery method.
Ren Qi took another look at Lu Wenbin, and he could not help but said, “Doctor Lu, how do you keep yourself so energetic?”
Lu Wenbin was stunned when he was asked this question. He thought for a while before he answered, “It’s probably the stimulus from my bank loans.”

chapters.title: Chapter 836: Tiny Waist
paragraphs: Due to the shock he received after seeing the single-site laparoscopy, Ren Qi was able to carry on until the afternoon without having a mental breakdown.
He was even a little excited as he entered the operating theater again.
That was extremely hard to come by. Ren Qi was a little excited during his first two days in Yun Hua Hospital, but the tediousness of work had worn that down.
Ren Qi deliberately changed into a pair of new scrubs, as the one he was wearing was soaked in sweat after he worked for a whole morning.

The surgery was held in Operating Theater 2, which was not equipped with a visitation room. Hence, a few doctors who had no surgeries on their schedules entered the operating theater to watch the surgery. The red light of the high-definition camera mounted on the ceiling was also shining.

Ren Qi stuck out his tongue when nobody was looking at him. He had been in Yun Hua Hospital for a few days, and he had not walked around Yun Hua City for even a single minute. He spent all his time in the operating theaters, so he knew the doctors in the hospital quite well. He knew that only a few renowned doctors in Yun Hua Hospital got to receive this kind of treatment.
Even department directors of ordinary departments would not have such a big audience unless they were carrying out demonstrative surgeries.
Humans did not have much tolerance for ordinary things.
That was even truer in hospitals since it was an ivory tower.

Renowned doctors merely had to raise their hands, and thousands of other doctors would follow them. However, top-class doctors who were slightly less skillful than those renowned doctors would have no choice but to spend their days alone.

Aside from this, the camera lenses in the operating theaters were also a double-edged sword, and not every doctor dared to take up this challenge. That was especially true for older doctors and the one who had never received training from an excellent academy. They had an instinctive fear of the camera lenses in the operating theaters.
They did not mind carrying out live demonstrations, but it was a completely different thing when their maneuvers were being captured on camera, allowing other people to watch every single detail.
Many doctors who managed to obtain their positions through social connections naturally disliked being watched by doctors they were not familiar with.
Ren Qi moved closer to the operating table and greeted the doctor beside him. “It’s a single site laparoscopy today, isn’t it?”
“Oh, it’s a single site one?” The resident doctor beside Ren Qi looked like he had just regained his senses.
Ren Qi froze for a moment. “Then, what are you here for?”

“Hmm... Surgery for chronic appendicitis?” The resident doctor sounded rather hesitant, and this was mostly because of Ren Qi’s age. To resident doctors, all men who were old with wrinkles and were wearing large white coats were senior doctors.
Ren Qi was also paying attention to the other party’s age. He deliberately asked, “Aren’t you excited that it’s a single site laparoscopy?”
The young resident doctor asked in a baffled manner, “Why should I be?”

Ren Qi licked his lips, and for some reason, he felt a surge of bitterness wash over him. Even the young doctors in Yun Hua Hospital were used to this kind of technology, but these technologies were new to him, and he yearned for them.
Single site laparoscopy was indeed a new technology that Ren Qi yearned for.

Very few surgical methods were carried out in the county hospital, and all the patients who suffered from serious illnesses head to Yun Hua City for surgery. There were even patients who would go straight to Beijing or Guangzhou.

Aside from idiots, who were rare to come by, only those with minor ailments were willing to get operated in the county hospital. For example, patients with appendicitis or cholecystitis. They either found it inconvenient to head to Yun Hua City or were worried that the medical fees in Yun Hua City would be too high, and these were the only reasons that made them willing to receive surgery in the county hospital.

However, even patients who were willing to get operated in county hospitals hoped that they would receive the kind of quality treatment that they could receive in Yun Hua. In reality, the probability of this was extremely low, it would not hurt to give patients something to look forward to. Hence, it was important to leave a good impression on them.

Laparoscopy was becoming increasingly common in secondary hospitals, and this was because it was hard for the General Surgery Departments that did not have laparoscopy as a surgical method to even survive. Even though patients knew nothing about the field of medicine, the differences between open abdominal surgery and laparoscopy were plain to see.

There were always patients who would choose to receive surgery at a provincial hospital that was closer to their homes and they were more familiar with just because both the provincial hospital and the hospital in the city offered open abdominal surgery. They might also choose to receive surgery at a provincial hospital that was closer to their homes and they were more familiar with the occasion where both the provincial hospital and the hospital in the city offered laparoscopy. However, if the provincial hospital only offered open abdominal surgery while the hospital in the city offered laparoscopy, these patients might choose to head to the latter.

Single site laparoscopy was also a similar determining factor. Even though it would not influence a patient’s decision as much as the choice between open abdominal surgery and laparoscopy, the difference between having three or four incisions on the abdomen and having only one incision on the abdomen was very obvious to patients.
Ren Qi hoped that he would be able to master single scope laparoscopy so that he could launch this surgical method in the General Surgery Department of his county hospital in Qiu County.
He could imagine the way he would receive more and more patients after launching this surgical method. He might even get promoted to associate chief physician or chief physician because of this.

Doctors from the same departments rarely chose to further their skills in the same surgical method, as the competition would be as tough as when there were two manufacturers offering the same kind of product in a seller’s market.
However, he would not face the same sort of challenge for single-site laparoscopy.
Hence, Ren Qi felt that he could make this his ultimate aim.
Ren Qi gulped. He turned toward the operating table with the decision to focus on the surgery.
He had long since realized that the doctors in Yun Hua Hospital were not the same kind of people as he was.
*Shick*
The airtight access door slid open.

Ling Ran entered the operating theater with his hands clasped behind his back, and he totally ignored the young doctors around him. It was normal for him not to pay attention to those who were crowding around him.
“Ma Yanlin will be the chief surgeon today.” Ling Ran did not change his plan because of the big audience. He announced this and took the position of an assistant.

Ma Yanlin had been officially transferred to Yun Hua Emergency Center, and he was now a new resident doctor of the Ling Treatment Group. As he was no longer a houseman, there were more opportunities in store for him.

He used to focus on Achilles tendon repair, but his skills were lackluster. He was not adept at it enough to act as a chief surgeon in the event where patients required great use of their Achilles tendons. Comparatively, he was more talented when it came to general surgery.
And right now, all patients with appendicitis or hemorrhoids were assigned to Ma Yanlin.
Ling Ran did not even need to show up if it were not for the fact that it was a single site laparoscopy today.
A doctor got bored when he saw Ma Yanlin assuming the role of the chief surgeon, and he left the operating theater. The other junior doctors did not move.
Ren Qi did not leave either.

He did have the desire to act as an assistant. However, even though he really wanted to participate in a single site laparoscopy, Ren Qi did not think that making requests during his first week of in-service training in Yun Hua Hospital was the right thing to do.
Since he never had many opportunities to witness single scope laparoscopy anyway, Ren Qi decided to just take it as a learning opportunity.

“We will get started with the single-site umbilical laparoscopy now.” As per the tradition, Ma Yanlin announced. He then double-checked things with the anesthetist before making a small incision on the belly button. He then created a pneumoperitoneum and muttered. “1,300.”
He was referring to the fact that the air pressure in the stomach had to be 1,300 pascals.
The patient’s abdomen became slightly inflated.
The atmosphere in the operating theater also became slightly livelier.
“It’s easier to operate on thin patients, isn’t it?”
“It’s the fact that it’s an appendectomy that makes it easy.”
“Single-site laparoscopy will never be too easy. I still find the old school method more convenient.”

“What are you saying? Do you think that young women nowadays would prefer to have a few incisions on their tummy when they could choose to have one single small incision that wouldn’t leave any scar? They still have to wear crop tops, you know?”
“Ah, young women look quite nice when they’re wearing crop tops.”
“Old Liu, stop being a pervert. Yes, they look nice, but do you have the guts to look?”
“It’s not a matter of whether I dare to look or not. It’s mainly about whether I have the ability to do so.”
Ma Yanlin was listening in to their conversation, but his maneuvers were not affected at all. He inserted the insufflation needle and cannula.

The difference between single-site laparoscopy and traditional laparoscopy was that in single-site laparoscopy, all three laparoscopes were inserted in through the same incision on the patient’s belly button. To make it easier and to give the surgeons more room for maneuver, a small disk with three holes would be placed on the patient’s belly button.

However, since the room of maneuver was smaller, the surgery could not be carried out the same way as traditional laparoscopy. To solve this problem, there were some extra maneuvers that were only used in single-site laparoscopy.
Since Ma Yanlin was not familiar with them, he had no choice but to focus.
Ling Ran stood beside him and watched him. He was not thinking about anything else either.

He possessed Perfect Level Appendectomy, and he could have finished this surgery in around fifteen minutes if he were to act as chief surgeon. However, it was important for him to train the members of his treatment group. Nowadays, people suffered from appendectomy all the time. He could not just spend all day carrying out an appendectomy.
Even though the audience was focusing on the surgery too, they continued chit-chatting.
“Old Liu’s been pretty promiscuous lately, don’t you think so?”
“Well, now that he’s an attending physician, things are no longer the same.”
“Old Liu, calm your t*ts. You’ll always be able to find girls as long as you’re alive, so make sure not to tire yourself out.”
Ma Yanlin suddenly froze, and he looked around vigilantly.
As if a spell was cast on them, the doctors who were chit-chatting suddenly froze and stopped speaking. Their gazes shot toward the monitor and the screen.
“Is there a hemorrhage?” After a long time, one of the doctors asked hesitantly.
“I was seeing things.” Ma Yanlin laughed in embarrassment and lowered his head.
“That scared me.”
“It’s pretty exciting, isn’t it? Young Ma gave me the impression of a young woman who’s wearing a crop top just now.”
“Well, his waist is quite thin.”

Aside from this, the camera lenses in the operating theaters were also a double-edged sword, and not every doctor dared to take up this challenge.
That was especially true for older doctors and the one who had never received training from an excellent academy.
They had an instinctive fear of the camera lenses in the operating theaters.
They did not mind carrying out live demonstrations, but it was a completely different thing when their maneuvers were being captured on camera, allowing other people to watch every single detail.
Many doctors who managed to obtain their positions through social connections naturally disliked being watched by doctors they were not familiar with.
Ren Qi moved closer to the operating table and greeted the doctor beside him.
“It’s a single site laparoscopy today, isn’t it?”
“Oh, it’s a single site one?” The resident doctor beside Ren Qi looked like he had just regained his senses.
Ren Qi froze for a moment.
“Then, what are you here for?”
“Hmm...
Surgery for chronic appendicitis?” The resident doctor sounded rather hesitant, and this was mostly because of Ren Qi’s age.
To resident doctors, all men who were old with wrinkles and were wearing large white coats were senior doctors.
Ren Qi was also paying attention to the other party’s age.
He deliberately asked, “Aren’t you excited that it’s a single site laparoscopy?”
The young resident doctor asked in a baffled manner, “Why should I be?”
Ren Qi licked his lips, and for some reason, he felt a surge of bitterness wash over him.
Even the young doctors in Yun Hua Hospital were used to this kind of technology, but these technologies were new to him, and he yearned for them.
Single site laparoscopy was indeed a new technology that Ren Qi yearned for.
Very few surgical methods were carried out in the county hospital, and all the patients who suffered from serious illnesses head to Yun Hua City for surgery.
There were even patients who would go straight to Beijing or Guangzhou.
Aside from idiots, who were rare to come by, only those with minor ailments were willing to get operated in the county hospital.
For example, patients with appendicitis or cholecystitis.

They either found it inconvenient to head to Yun Hua City or were worried that the medical fees in Yun Hua City would be too high, and these were the only reasons that made them willing to receive surgery in the county hospital.
However, even patients who were willing to get operated in county hospitals hoped that they would receive the kind of quality treatment that they could receive in Yun Hua.
In reality, the probability of this was extremely low, it would not hurt to give patients something to look forward to.
Hence, it was important to leave a good impression on them.

Laparoscopy was becoming increasingly common in secondary hospitals, and this was because it was hard for the General Surgery Departments that did not have laparoscopy as a surgical method to even survive.
Even though patients knew nothing about the field of medicine, the differences between open abdominal surgery and laparoscopy were plain to see.

There were always patients who would choose to receive surgery at a provincial hospital that was closer to their homes and they were more familiar with just because both the provincial hospital and the hospital in the city offered open abdominal surgery.

They might also choose to receive surgery at a provincial hospital that was closer to their homes and they were more familiar with the occasion where both the provincial hospital and the hospital in the city offered laparoscopy.
However, if the provincial hospital only offered open abdominal surgery while the hospital in the city offered laparoscopy, these patients might choose to head to the latter.
Single site laparoscopy was also a similar determining factor.

Even though it would not influence a patient’s decision as much as the choice between open abdominal surgery and laparoscopy, the difference between having three or four incisions on the abdomen and having only one incision on the abdomen was very obvious to patients.
Ren Qi hoped that he would be able to master single scope laparoscopy so that he could launch this surgical method in the General Surgery Department of his county hospital in Qiu County.
He could imagine the way he would receive more and more patients after launching this surgical method.
He might even get promoted to associate chief physician or chief physician because of this.

Doctors from the same departments rarely chose to further their skills in the same surgical method, as the competition would be as tough as when there were two manufacturers offering the same kind of product in a seller’s market.
However, he would not face the same sort of challenge for single-site laparoscopy.
Hence, Ren Qi felt that he could make this his ultimate aim.
Ren Qi gulped.
He turned toward the operating table with the decision to focus on the surgery.
He had long since realized that the doctors in Yun Hua Hospital were not the same kind of people as he was.
*Shick*
The airtight access door slid open.
Ling Ran entered the operating theater with his hands clasped behind his back, and he totally ignored the young doctors around him.
It was normal for him not to pay attention to those who were crowding around him.
“Ma Yanlin will be the chief surgeon today.” Ling Ran did not change his plan because of the big audience.
He announced this and took the position of an assistant.
Ma Yanlin had been officially transferred to Yun Hua Emergency Center, and he was now a new resident doctor of the Ling Treatment Group.
As he was no longer a houseman, there were more opportunities in store for him.
He used to focus on Achilles tendon repair, but his skills were lackluster.
He was not adept at it enough to act as a chief surgeon in the event where patients required great use of their Achilles tendons.
Comparatively, he was more talented when it came to general surgery.
And right now, all patients with appendicitis or hemorrhoids were assigned to Ma Yanlin.
Ling Ran did not even need to show up if it were not for the fact that it was a single site laparoscopy today.
A doctor got bored when he saw Ma Yanlin assuming the role of the chief surgeon, and he left the operating theater.
The other junior doctors did not move.
Ren Qi did not leave either.
He did have the desire to act as an assistant.

However, even though he really wanted to participate in a single site laparoscopy, Ren Qi did not think that making requests during his first week of in-service training in Yun Hua Hospital was the right thing to do.
Since he never had many opportunities to witness single scope laparoscopy anyway, Ren Qi decided to just take it as a learning opportunity.
“We will get started with the single-site umbilical laparoscopy now.” As per the tradition, Ma Yanlin announced.
He then double-checked things with the anesthetist before making a small incision on the belly button.
He then created a pneumoperitoneum and muttered.
He was referring to the fact that the air pressure in the stomach had to be 1,300 pascals.
The patient’s abdomen became slightly inflated.
The atmosphere in the operating theater also became slightly livelier.
“It’s easier to operate on thin patients, isn’t it?”
“It’s the fact that it’s an appendectomy that makes it easy.”
“Single-site laparoscopy will never be too easy.
I still find the old school method more convenient.”
“What are you saying?
Do you think that young women nowadays would prefer to have a few incisions on their tummy when they could choose to have one single small incision that wouldn’t leave any scar?
They still have to wear crop tops, you know?”
“Ah, young women look quite nice when they’re wearing crop tops.”
“Old Liu, stop being a pervert.
Yes, they look nice, but do you have the guts to look?”
“It’s not a matter of whether I dare to look or not.
It’s mainly about whether I have the ability to do so.”
Ma Yanlin was listening in to their conversation, but his maneuvers were not affected at all.
He inserted the insufflation needle and cannula.

The difference between single-site laparoscopy and traditional laparoscopy was that in single-site laparoscopy, all three laparoscopes were inserted in through the same incision on the patient’s belly button.
To make it easier and to give the surgeons more room for maneuver, a small disk with three holes would be placed on the patient’s belly button.
However, since the room of maneuver was smaller, the surgery could not be carried out the same way as traditional laparoscopy.
To solve this problem, there were some extra maneuvers that were only used in single-site laparoscopy.
Since Ma Yanlin was not familiar with them, he had no choice but to focus.
Ling Ran stood beside him and watched him.
He was not thinking about anything else either.
He possessed Perfect Level Appendectomy, and he could have finished this surgery in around fifteen minutes if he were to act as chief surgeon.
However, it was important for him to train the members of his treatment group.
Nowadays, people suffered from appendectomy all the time.
He could not just spend all day carrying out an appendectomy.
Even though the audience was focusing on the surgery too, they continued chit-chatting.
“Old Liu’s been pretty promiscuous lately, don’t you think so?”
“Well, now that he’s an attending physician, things are no longer the same.”
“Old Liu, calm your t*ts.
You’ll always be able to find girls as long as you’re alive, so make sure not to tire yourself out.”
Ma Yanlin suddenly froze, and he looked around vigilantly.
As if a spell was cast on them, the doctors who were chit-chatting suddenly froze and stopped speaking.
Their gazes shot toward the monitor and the screen.
“Is there a hemorrhage?” After a long time, one of the doctors asked hesitantly.
“I was seeing things.” Ma Yanlin laughed in embarrassment and lowered his head.
“That scared me.”
“It’s pretty exciting, isn’t it?
Young Ma gave me the impression of a young woman who’s wearing a crop top just now.”
“Well, his waist is quite thin.”

chapters.title: Chapter 837: Gather Together
paragraphs: “Separating forceps.”
“Electrocoagulation electrotome.”
“Check the blood loss...”
When Ma Yanlin managed to calm himself, the surgery was already progressing very smoothly.
Ling Ran became relieved after he observed half of the surgery. He called out to Houseman Qu Xiaolian to hold the laparoscope while he observed from the side.

Single-site laparoscopy had a slightly higher difficulty. Theoretically, if any problems occurred, they would need to perform open laparotomy to deal with it. No matter which mode it was, Ma Yanlin could actually perform the surgery. Ling Ran had actually come over this time with the intention of checking his performance.

“Doctor Ling, there is no bleeding. Should I place the drainage tube now?” Ma Yanlin performed the last check. He did not get any response from Ling Ran, so he checked again before he asked in a whisper.

“Yes, continue.” Ling Ran put down his hands as he answered, then he said, “When you performed separation with the electrocoagulation electrotome, you cut in too deep. Next time, remember to adjust the frequency.”
After he finished talking, Ling Ran turned around and left the operating table.
Ma Yanlin was stunned a little, and his mind immediately conjured all his previous maneuvers.
If Ling Ran had not said anything, he might be slightly arrogant when he left for home at night.
However, his mind was filled with all the surgical details now.
Ren Qi was extremely envious.

He was not envious of Ma Yanlin being able to perform surgeries. The lower rank hospitals had fewer patients, but the number of doctors was even fewer, so the competition for patients was not aggressive. Doctors who were able to perform surgeries would eventually get to do them. However, it was extremely rare for them to get guidance, and it was even rarer for surgeries which were more difficult.

For example, when Ling Ran went for freelance surgeries in the district, the local doctors in the field of hepatobiliary surgeries would get ready in advance. Besides maintaining their relationship with Ling Ran, more than half of them aimed to learn some skills.
However, in a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital, even a small resident doctor like Ma Yanlin could also get guidance from Ling Ran, so Ren Qi felt all sorts of complicated feelings in his heart.
When he saw Ma Yanlin lower his head to end the surgery, Ren Qi felt slightly dispirited.
Ren Qi, who was already a senior attending physician, naturally did not need to watch something like subcuticular sutures anymore.
He quietly took two steps backward, then he followed a resident doctor to leave the operating theater.
“Sigh...” Ren Qi sighed deeply. Then he raised his head and walked forward quickly.
It was his resting time just now, and in the subsequent hours, he still had surgeries to perform.
“Be careful, walk slower.” Ling Ran walked at a moderate speed. From the distance, he saw Ren Qi walking very quickly with his head lowered, and he reminded him of this.

Ling Ran was experienced with this kind of scenario. Many people, especially girls, always walked at a fast speed with their heads down. Even when he reminded them from afar, there were still some of them who bumped into him.
This was especially prominent during his time in school, Ling Ran always encountered this kind of careless people at the corner of the stairs, corridor, or even the entrance of the classroom.
The most troublesome thing was when he bumped into them, they would even open their eyes widely, ask for compensation, or ask to give him compensation.
Ling Ran just did not want to be bumped into.
Ren Qi stopped in a second.
He recognized Ling Ran’s voice because it was too nice to hear and easy to recognize.
Ren Qi felt that even if Ling Ran entered the entertainment industry, he would still thrive and succeed.

“Excuse me, Doctor Ling.” Ren Qi was slightly embarrassed when he raised his head. He smiled and said, “I watched a surgery just now, and I’m going to the operating theater for the preoperative preparation.”

Ling Ran nodded. When he was finally able to see the person clearly, he saw that he was the surgeon sent for in-service training, who was sent to him by Department Director Huo. He thought for a while and asked, “Have you decided on your training direction?”

Not every person in-charge of the treatment group would bear the responsibility of managing a doctor who came over for in-service training. Under most circumstances, doctors who came for in-service training were similar to housemen and even interns, as they were all in a constant state of being exploited.
It was especially so for departments that did not have sufficient resources.
However, the conditions in Ling Ran’s treatment group were obviously different.

His treatment group did not have many main surgical methods, but it involved a very wide coverage, and its depth was among the top in Yun Hua Hospital. In this situation, the doctors in the group would have a large number of patient resources and other resources no matter which direction they chose to develop, and Ling Ran was also willing to give the doctor who came for in-service training a chance to choose.
Ren Qi realized what was going on immediately, and he became tense instantly.
It was not easy to get a chance to pursue advanced studies, especially under Ling Ran’s supervision. At this time, his choice was probably the key that would decide his success.
Ren Qi’s brain worked swiftly, and he reluctantly gave up on learning any hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery methods.

If he could learn hepatectomy, he did not even need to consider whether Qiu County had the patients who needed hepatectomy. Ren Qi was sure that he could just work in any new hospital in Changxi Province.
However, two months of training would not allow him to master hepatectomy.
Ren Qi wisely gave up. He raised his head and said, “Doctor Ling, I’ve made up my mind. I want to learn single-site laparoscopy.”
Ling Ran frowned and said, “What about the surgical method?”
“Appendectomy,” Ren Qi immediately answered.

Appendectomy was the basic work in general surgery. From laparotomy, laparoscopy, to single-site laparoscopy, appendectomy always served as the surgery method that would start their path in learning their respective form of surgery.
And this was also the surgical method which was most often performed in the county hospital. If he could master it in two months, Ren Qi felt that he would not have wasted his trip.
Ling Ran did not understand Ren Qi’s situation, so he could not help but ask, “Why would you choose appendectomy? You know how to do it, right?”
“But I haven’t performed single-site laparoscopies before,” Ren Qi answered before he continued, “I want to master the use of single-site laparoscopy. ”
“The impact of single-site laparoscopy is still not as good as the traditional laparoscopy at the current stage.”

Ren Qi explained, “But the patients are willing to receive single site laparoscopies. There is no scar, since the incision is hidden in the belly button, and this is a strong attraction to the youngsters nowadays. I feel... I also have to advance with the times...”

Ren Qi sounded slightly diffident. He glanced at Ling Ran’s face, and he immediately added, “I don’t mean that I’m pursuing more advanced medical skills, but my training time is too short. I’m thinking that I should have enough time to learn single-site laparoscopy in two months... Doctor Ling?”
Ling Ran’s facial expression remained unchanged. After Ren Qi finished talking for a while, he nodded and answered, “Sure. Then, we will temporarily set your training as single-site laparoscopy.”
“Okay.”
“Go on with your work.” Ling Ran waved his hand and dismissed Ren Qi. Then, he started to think.
In general surgeries, it was easy to relate appendectomy with cholecystectomy. Ling Ran’s appendectomy was at Perfect Level, but his cholecystectomy was only at Specialist Level.
That was because Ling Ran trained up his cholecystectomy by himself, and he obtained two Intermediate Treasure Chests as a result.
However, ever since his cholecystectomy reached Specialist Level, Ling Ran never managed to reach Master Level for the surgery no matter how hard he tried.

Ling Ran read up a lot of information for a period of time and did not stop exploring cholecystectomy’s depth. Now, when he thought about it, there was a need for him to expand his coverage for him to reach Master Level.

It was just like when Ling Ran performed appendectomies. He could perform the surgery through laparotomy, single-site laparoscopy, and also multiple site laparoscopy. Ling Ran had performed cholecystectomy with laparotomy before, but he rarely performed single-site laparoscopy for cholecystectomy.
“Find patients with cholecystitis who want single-site laparoscopy.” Ling Ran took out his phone and made a call to Zuo Cidian.

He would always ask for patients with cholecystitis after some time, and Zuo Cidian was not surprised when he received the call. He agreed immediately and thought about how he should wait for emergency cases of cholecystitis cases in the Emergency Departments in the province while also making a few phone calls to a few hospitals he was familiar with in Yun Hua City. Then, he would grab some patients with chronic cholecystitis from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. It would then be very easy for him to gather the number of patients Ling Ran wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 838: Small Ward Round
paragraphs: In the ward of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, two pots of devil’s ivy looked like they had sunburn as they stood on the windowsill side by side while they stared at the sky. Their entire bodies were green.

The patient on the hospital bed looked tired. She had dark circles, pale lips, rough face, and sagging face. She looked just like someone who was taken care of carelessly by an unprofessional embalmer.
“Ward round.” A doctor knocked on the door, and he walked into the room.
“Didn’t you just come for a ward round?” Her best friend by the hospital bed was playing with her phone, so she felt slightly angry for her game to be interrupted.
“The chief surgeon decided to come and take a look.” The doctor explained in a low voice, and he stood to the side of the patient.
Young Ling, who laid on the bed, opened her eyes and waited for her best friend’s endless complaints.

The hospital was very boring. She did not want to stay in the hospital, and her best friend did not want to accompany her as well. Now, since a junior doctor came, she let her best friend complain for a while, and she could also relax a little.
Stepping sounds were heard in the room. They did not know how many doctors walked in.
However, her best friend’s complaints never appeared. If it were not for the soft pants, Young Ling would start to wonder whether she had died of myocardial infarction.
She craned her neck and looked at the door of the hospital room.
Young Ling’s neck froze when she saw Ling Ran.
‘What a handsome doctor! Are we sure we’re not filming a movie?
‘Impossible. Even movies will not cast such a handsome actor. If there was one, my best friend group would be discussing it madly, and we’d all book the entire movie theater to watch the movie.’
Zhang Anmin stood by the bed and showed a friendly smile. “Doctor Ling, this is the patient, Li Ling. She has acalculous cholecystitis, has always been in good health, and her age is...”
“Wait!” Li Ling suddenly sat up on the bed, as if she was someone pretending to be dead a moment ago. She shouted loudly, “How could you just state a girl’s age?”
Zhang Anmin was stunned, and he said, “I am stating your medical record to Doctor Ling.”
“That won’t do either.” Li Ling stubbornly shook her head. She combed her hair with her hands, and she talked to her best friend by the side, “Mirror, pass me a mirror.”
Her best friend saw the icky discharge at the corner of her eyes, her dry hair, and her bare face. She felt sorry for her and said, “The mirror is in the washroom.”
“Then, handphone, handphone.” Li Ling was extremely anxious.
A group of doctors calmly looked at Li Ling on the bed, just like how they always looked at patients.
“You need to handle the preoperative discussion with this patient well, and get at least two copies of operation consent forms signed.” Zuo Cidian reminded Zhang Anmin by the side.
Zhang Anmin nodded. “I’ll ask someone to inform her family.”
“You need to check once on your own. When they sign, you must either be on the spot or make them film a video, otherwise, it will not be counted.”
“No problem, the people under me work very well now.” Zhang Anmin looked at Ling Ran as he said, and his forehead was shining.

Zuo Cidian glanced at the door with the corner of his eyes. Squeezed together at the entrance were two to three doctors from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, who stared into the room strangely.

Zuo Cidian was not nervous, but he wanted to prevent something bad from happening. If only two to three juniors from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery came to watch when the doctors from the Emergency Medical Center came to the ward in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery for a ward round, this situation was already considered very harmonious.
“Take a look at her biochemical report.” Ling Ran noticed the patient’s bad skin and hair conditions, so he wanted to make another confirmation.
Zhang Anmin stretched his hand backward, then the resident doctor from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery quickly took out the report in a flurry of motion.

After Zhang Anmin became an associate chief physician, he had some underlings. Although he could yet lead a treatment group independently, he had a line up of doctors under him that could relatively make him be considered to have an independent group.
In the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery were a few remaining doctors who were not bound to He Yuanzheng. They did not hesitate to follow Zhang Anmin.

Being promoted to an attending physician from an associate chief physician might seem to only be a step upward. However, in the hospital environment, it was completely different. If there were any extreme situations, Zhang Anmin could even temporarily take over the department director. If he were lucky, he could even take over the position for two to three years.

For the few young doctors who depended on Zhang Anmin in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, they were considered to have now gained a bottom line to exist. They were probably considered future subordinates who would follow their leader wherever he went, which might be the possible Second Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, although they might be called traitors, they no longer cared about it. From their perspectives, when Ling Ran was able to promote Zhang Anmin to an associate chief physician, his capabilities could already be considered nothing short on amazing.
Ling Ran took the report and read it, while everyone else looked at Ling Ran.
Li Ling, who laid on the bed, and her best friend also stared at Ling Ran.

Her best friend stood by the bed and pouted habitually. Her cute face was the outcome of what she practiced in front of the mirror.

She knew just how much Li Ling valued her waist usually. Since she always went clubbing, others would know the condition of her skin right when they touched her waist regardless of how well she put on makeup. Therefore, Li Liang usually put on a mask on her belly.
This time, if she had not found out about the laparoscopic surgery that would not leave any scar on her, Li Ling would not have gone for a cholecystectomy even if could possibly die of pain.
Compared to that, Li Ling did not bother with the complications like not being able to eat meat with high fat.
Ling Ran quietly performed a stomach physical examination for Li Ling, and he said, “Tell me if you feel pain.”
“Ouch... It hurts slightly.” Li Ling gasped softly.
The young doctors in front of the hospital bed had their facial expressions change, and they changed their facial expressions again when they raised their head and saw Li Ling’s face.
“My... skin... is it too rough?” Li Ling asked Ling Ran.
“No,” Ling Ran answered as usual without changing his facial expression.
Li Ling showed a faint smile.

Lu Wenbin stood slightly further away. He did not look at Li Ling’s belly skin. He only stared at Li Ling’s face and comforted her, “As a doctor, we need to take care of patients from all age groups, including old ladies. Your skin condition is considered good.”
Li Ling’s face fell in a second. If she were in the night club the night before yesterday right now, the guy next to her right then would know how to comfort her right now.
Lu Wenbin showed an honest and humble smile as if he lifted ten 220-pound weights in one go in the gym.

“Arrange her surgery for tomorrow morning.” Ling Ran finished the physical examination, stood up, and used an alcohol-based hand sanitizer to wipe his hands. Then, he said, “Doctor Zhang will be the assistant.”

“Alright.” Zuo Cidian immediately made a note in his notebook. Asking Zhang Anmin to be the assistant meant that the condition of the gallbladder was slightly complicated, and extra attention would need to be provided during nursing care.
“The next patient is in the next room.” Zuo Cidian put away his notebook and gestured for the doctors in front of him to leave.
Zuo Cidian nodded. He was surrounded by the doctors while they left the room in a mighty wave.
Li Ling laid on the bed and showed a nice smile. After a long while, she felt the corners of her eyes itch, and she rubbed her eyes furiously. Then, suddenly, her fingers stopped moving.
Li Ling got up from her bed in a second. She took off the infusion bag and rushed to the washroom.
Her best friend sighed leisurely. She put down her phone, combed her hair by the side of her ears, and closely covered her ears.
A few seconds later, a loud shout from the washroom rose, as if it made an agreement beforehand to the best friend that it will show up later. “Aaaaaahhhhh!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 839: The Quest for Knowledge
paragraphs: Before going to sleep, Li Ling meticulously applied a super subtle layer of makeup on her face.
It was the kind of subtle makeup look that was applied so meticulously that any straight guy would not be able to tell that she was wearing makeup even if they were to carefully study her face.

Her best friend looked at Li Ling, who once again looked like a young woman who would score 90 out of 100 marks. She went against her conscience and praised Li Ling for a bit. She then asked, “He has even seen your goop before. Isn’t it too late to put on makeup now?”
Li Ling chuckled. Her gaze was electric. “So what? On the bright side, since he has seen me at my ugliest, there’s nothing that I need to be afraid of.”
“Are you afraid of losing?” her best friend asked in a soft voice.
Li Ling pouted. “It’s impossible that I will lose.”
Her best friend smiled.
“Look at my chest. Look at my slim waist,” Li Ling said solemnly, “These won’t lie.”
Her best friend gave a light tap on her a*s and nodded in agreement. “But Doctor Ling is truly handsome.”
“There’s nothing to be afraid of. Do you know what the best thing about young and handsome men is?

“The fact that they’re young!” Li Ling said with a determined gaze. “Since they’re young, it means that they’re unwise. No matter how handsome a man is, as long as he hasn’t seen the world yet, they would fall into our traps at the end of the day.”
When her best friend heard the word “our”, her eyes immediately lit up, and she started fantasizing.
Li Ling did not even need to turn to look at her best friend to know what was going on. “Stop thinking nonsense. By ‘us’, I mean that I’ll be seducing him, and you’ll be my wingwoman.”
“Go ahead and seduce him. I’ll be your wingwoman.” Her best friend flashed a plastic smile, showcasing friendship at its finest.
At three in the morning, Li Ling was woken up, and the first thing she did was to check her makeup.
“Time to get ready for the operation.” The nurse glanced at her, but she did not give any comment.
Li Ling hummed in acknowledgment and said, “Let me touch up my makeup.”
Even until she was being placed on the operating table, Li Ling refused to let go of her mirror.
The circulating nurse was too lazy to tell her off. She scolded the new medical interns who were standing around the operating table one by one.
“Tuck your scrubs into your pants.”
“Your hair shouldn’t be visible. All of you, get out of here and only come in after you tidy up.”
“Did you wear a bra? Who was the one who told you that you shouldn’t wear a bra?! Go and wear a bra before coming in again!”
When Li Ling heard this, she could not help but curse under her breath. ‘Must be some sl*t...’
This was when a familiar voice that was cool and handsome rang out. “Administer the anesthetics.”
Li Ling wanted to raise her head, but her eyelids started feeling heavy.
“Let’s get started,” Ling Ran asked for a medical instrument before making a curved incision above Li Ling’s belly button.
Zhang Anmin was his assistant. He stood between the patient’s leg and helped raise up the abdominal wall around the belly button using a pair of towel forceps.
Next, Ling Ran extended his hand and asked for a trocar. He inserted it into the patient’s abdominal cavity and started creating a pneumoperitoneum.
He was very familiar with these maneuvers, and to the audience, there were no problems at all.

Surgeons actually follow a lot of formulae, and most surgical maneuvers were fixed. Take the single-site umbilical laparoscopy that was going on right now as an example. The laparoscope was inserted via the umbilical cord, and for normal human beings, after a pneumoperitoneum was created, the anatomical structures inside were basically the same. Hence, the steps were also the same.
If any changes were made, it meant that the surgical method was being improved.
From the perspective of both doctors and patients, the fact that a surgical method followed a formula was a good thing.
With all the steps being adhered to, the surgery could be said to have gone smoothly. The prognosis might not be perfect, but a certain standard would be achieved.
For ordinary doctors, all they wanted was for a surgery to be completed without any accident. It would be even better if the surgery went even smoother, or if they were faster.
However, Ling Ran did not feel the same.
Unlike the skills that were given to him by the system, Ling Ran only possessed Specialist Level Cholecystectomy right now. So, he was not as skillful as his other skills.
He could handle an ordinary three site laparoscopy well. However, single-site laparoscopy had a higher requirement when it came to skills, and he felt an obvious difference.
Now that Ling Ran thought about it, he had carried out fewer than a hundred cholecystectomy via single-site laparoscopy.
To ordinary doctors, this was not a small number.

This was especially true for young doctors. Even after they got promoted to attending physician, they would only have acted as chief surgeon for a certain surgical method for about a hundred surgeries. Many resident doctors would not even have achieved this tally. Aside from common surgical methods such as appendectomy, they would at most have acted as chief surgeon in a couple dozens of surgery in other surgical methods.

If a person were to be even more specific and divide the surgical methods based on whether they were an open abdominal surgery, three-site laparoscopy or single-site laparoscopy, the doctors would only have acted as chief surgeons in an even smaller number of these surgeries.
Even some of the experienced attending physicians could not carry out as many surgeries as they want to.

Everyone spent most of their time and energy on the surgical methods that they were focused on, and it was inevitable that they might not be able to catch up when it came to some of the other surgical methods.
However, this situation did not apply to Ling Ran.
As Ling Ran operated on the patient, he thought about the similarities and differences of each surgical method.

This was not something that could be felt by patients, or even doctors who were watching the surgery. This was especially true for the doctors who did not possess any master-level skills. They would not make many discoveries just by watching a minor surgery like cholecystectomy.
Ling Ran would not fool himself.
“How many surgeries do we have lined up after this?” Ling Ran asked as he stared at the screen and lifted the patient’s gallbladder with a pair of forceps.
The operating theater immediately became silent.
Ling Ran did not usually like to chit-chat in the operating theater, but whenever he spoke, all the doctors would pay a lot of attention to him.
“Five more,” Zhang Anmin immediately answered.

According to what Zuo Cidian had scheduled, most of the patients today were from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. Even though nowadays, the Emergency Medical Center and the Department of Hepatobiliary Surgery enjoyed an extremely close relationship, for the purpose of convenience, it was better to occupy the hospital beds in other departments as well as operate on the patients of other departments first.
Ling Ran, though, did not feel like operating on any more patients. He shook his head slowly and said, “There’s too many. Can you take over?”
Zhang Anmin froze for a moment. “I can, but...”
“Then, I’ll leave all five of them to you,” Ling Ran said decisively.
Zhang Anmin hummed in acknowledgment. He then asked subconsciously, “How about you?”

“I’ll think about it.” Ling Ran himself had not thought of what to do either. The Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic surgery of Yun Hua Hospital was weak, and their best surgeon, He Yuanzheng was focused on liver surgery. Ling Ran would rather study cholecystectomy himself than learn from He Yuanzheng.
The surgeons from the General Surgery Department were adept at cholecystectomy too, but he did not even know if their department director possessed Master Level Cholecystectomy.
Before Ling Ran could figure out what to do, the system had already given him a mission.
[Mission: The Quest for Knowledge]
[Mission Details: Elevate your cholecystectomy skills to Master Level]
[Mission Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]

Ling Ran pouted and commented internally. ‘I got an Intermediate Treasure Chest after elevating my cholecystectomy skills to Specialist Level, and I’m getting the same reward if I level up to Master Level? Isn’t this reward a little too unreasonable?’
The notification sparkled, but the words on it did not change.
