chapters.title: Chapter 840: Quiet Operating Theater
paragraphs: In the General Surgery Department, Chief Physician Dan Quan scolded everyone while performing surgery, and he felt quite at ease.

As a chief physician who was about the same age as He Yuanzheng, but was a chief physician who was extremely far from the throne of a department director, Dan Quan was very much at ease in the operating theater. In the words of Chinese storytellers, he was a feudal lord who only obeyed orders and did not bother about currying favor to others or having others currying favor to him.

Of course, the influence of the General Surgery Department’s director was still very large, but the person up there had to retire in the end, and it was impossible for him to sit in the position of a General Surgery Department Director all his life. Hence, he would need, to a certain extent, delegate some power to each treatment group’s leader.

After all, a doctor was still a technical position, hence the management style had to also lean more toward the technical aspect of things. It was the same way Dan Quan would also give some respect to the associate chief physicians and attending physicians under him as well as delegate power to them.
However, it would not be necessary to give resident doctors similar treatment, because what they did was just manual labor.
*Shick*
The operating theater door slid open.
Dan Quan moved his facial muscles, raised his head, and was prepared to release some harsh words to set the atmosphere.
However, what Dan Quan saw was the handsome Ling Ran wearing goggles and a mouth face mask.
So when the harsh words came to his mouth, he did not spit them out.

“What brings Doctor Ling to the operating theater of the General Surgery Department?” Dan Quan took the initiative to greet him. After all, no one lost anything by speaking politely, so why should they not speak pleasant words to each other in a cordial fashion every day?
Ling Ran showed a vibrant smile to the large number of medical staff in the operating theater, and he said, “I want to learn single-site laparoscopy.”

Dan Quan was stunned for a while before he chuckled. Then, he spoke in neither a harsh nor soft tone, “It’s unlikely that you would have the heart to learn such a technique. If it’s single-site laparoscopy, you can go to our department director instead. If I remember correctly, he published several related papers a few years ago.”
Ling Ran shook his head. “I have consulted a few doctors, and all of them said that your single-site laparoscopy is the best in Yun Hua Hospital.”
A wave of heat suddenly rushed to Dan Quan’s head.
Dan Quan subconsciously wanted to be humble, but when he looked at Ling Ran, he did not say it.

Ling Ran gave Dan Quan the impression that he was the kind of blunt and honest newbie in society who did not know how not to be too straight-forward when speaking, and he would always make it hard for people to get out awkward situations.
If he were not supported and not as handsome, Dan Quan felt that a doctor like Ling Ran would sooner or later suffer a big loss.
Nevertheless, due to that, Ling Ran’s praise was incredibly sincere and rare.
In fact, Dan Quan had not heard anyone being praised by Ling Ran as “the best of Yun Hua Hospital” before.
Dan Quan’s body trembled a little, and he was still feeling warm.
“Single-site laparoscopy, huh...?” Dan Quan said with a drawl but was not willing to be modest and decline Ling Ran’s praise.
Ling Ran nodded with certainty and said, “Yes, single-site laparoscopy. May I observe you while you perform the surgery?”

chapters.title: Chapter 841: Gradually Becoming Dumbfounded
paragraphs: Early in the morning, Dan Quan hummed a small tune as he put his hands behind his back and came to the surgical floor.

The General Surgery Department and other specialist departments all performed their operations on the surgical floor. There were more than thirty operating theaters, seven warerooms, and more than ten storage rooms on the entire floor to hundreds of operations every day.
Dan Quan walked leisurely to the washroom. As soon as he got to the place, he heard a voice from the dark room that said, “You’re late.”
Dan Quan almost jumped and hit whoever spoke to him!
Those who dared to say he, who was a dignified chief physician of the General Surgery Department, was late would not even come to the operating theater.
At this time, he saw Ling Ran in his white coat coming out of the washroom. He looked so handsome he looked as if he was walking on a runway.
Dan Quan’s anger was instantly extinguished.

He could not yell at this person. If he were to yell now, the news would spread to the whole Surgery Department in minutes. After an hour, his world would change, and even without Huo Congjun or Associate Department Director Zhou speaking to him, the young nurses in the Surgery department would never let the doctor who yelled at Ling Ran have a good life in the future.

It was dangerous to incur public wrath. If a surgeon scolded some young nurse, it was a daily routine in the hospital, and the head nurse would only advise and persuade the doctor to not take it to heart, and she would not arrange for them to work together next time.

However, if all the nurses were not in good terms with a certain surgeon, the hospital leaders would only look at such doctors differently as well. It would be possible for the doctor to not be able to smoothly perform everything during his hospital life.
Moreover, Dan Quan’s impression of Ling Ran was actually quite good.
After all, Ling Ran was an honest and frank person, and he said that his single-site laparoscopy was the best in Yun Hua Hospital...
There were a lot of determiners he used, but the strongest was still the strongest. Dan Quan had hummed so many small tunes that day because of Ling Ran’s words.

“Doctor Ling, why did you come to the General Department Surgery’s operating theater again? Are you here to watch my surgery once more?” Dan Quan said the last sentence in a joking tone. Why would there be someone who would watch someone else’s surgery all day long, especially a great doctor like Ling Ran? He could not possibly leave his treatment group and just walk into other people’s operating theater every day.
“Yes,” Ling Ran answered concisely and firmly.
“What...? Are you really here to watch my surgery again?” Dan Quan was surprised.
Ling Ran nodded. “Yes.”
Dan Quan stared at Ling Ran for a long time. He felt a little strange, a little flattered, and a little confused. “Why?”
“Because I want to learn single-site laparoscopy.” Ling Ran looked at Dan Quan and felt a little annoyed. He had said those words before, but Dan Quan still needed to ask again.

Fortunately, Ling Ran often came across this kind of person who always did not listen carefully to other people’s speech. They had to always ask again and again as if they wanted some kind of confirmation, yet after confirming what they heard, they did not believe it.

Ling Ran was not prepared to give Dan Quan the opportunity to repeatedly ask for confirmation and repeatedly be in disbelief. He then said, “The scheduled operation time today is nine o’clock, and it is five minutes to nine now. Will the operation be postponed?”
A surgeon needed ten minutes to wash his hands alone, so Dan Quan was surely going to be late.

Dan Quan shook his body unnaturally. Since he became the associate chief physician, he was rarely nagged by others on the issue of punctuality. It became even more so after he became a chief physician.

A chief physician’s desire for power was not easy to satisfy, and they were unlike department directors, who already had their desire satisfied because their words alone were already worth gold. However, they enjoyed true freedom.

Even the department director would not check on a chief physician’s attendance. Forget about checking attendance, they would even give away the fees they earned from medical consumables and hospital bills to the chief physicians at appropriate moments.
Dan Quan looked up at Ling Ran with a smile.
Ling Ran looked down at Dan Quan with a serious look.
Dan Quan’s smile slowly disappeared. ‘Sigh, it’s no use, what should I tell someone like Ling Ran who’s so straightforward?’
At this time, Zuo Cidian appeared behind Ling Ran and smiled with a face full of wrinkles. “Chief Physician Dan, if the operation needs to be postponed, I will help you inform the staff.”
Dan Quan furrowed his eyebrows. “No, we just need to perform this surgery faster.”
“Alright, you and Doctor Ling actually have the same style.” Zuo Cidian smiled and said, “Then, I will talk to the Department of Anesthesiology and tell them that the operation time may change?”

Establishing clear communication with the Department of Anesthesiology was the most comfortable thing for a surgeon. Dan Quan had no reason to refuse this. He hummed softly in agreement but still frowned. “Why are you here, Zuo Cidian?”

Zuo Cidian was unhappy to have his name called directly, but he still had a smile on his face. It was just that his face became even more wrinkled. “I mainly serve Doctor Ling. Doctor Ling wants to watch your surgery, and I am here to perform the logistics.”
“Why would logistics be needed for just watching a surgery...?” Dan Quan shook his head and said nothing more.

Watching surgeries was the most common behavior in hospitals. It was like students watching how other people answered questions and chefs watching other people cooking. It was one of the cheapest ways to learn something.
Dan Quan was still very proud that Ling Ran came to see his operation, but he was a little unaccustomed to Ling Ran’s punctuality.
He did not say much. He went to wash his hands for ten minutes and went to the operating theater.

The time needed for this step could not be reduced. Surgeons were a profession that was accustomed to acting cool but also not accustomed to acting cool, especially in the work of anti-infection. If one did not do it well, it would only make people laugh.
The more Ling Ran watched, the more Dan Quan followed the procedures.
After washing his hands by the book, he raised his arms vertically over his chest and walked into the operating theater; the patient was already on the operating table.
“Doctor Ling from the Emergency Medical Center still wants to observe today’s operation.” Dan Quan entered the operating theater, and he used Ling Ran’s name in passing to make himself look good.
Since he was there, he had to show off.
Ling Ran let out a smile without a complaint.
Zuo Cidian was not named, but his face was full of smiles while he stood humbly behind Ling Ran like an old butler.

Dan Quan saw this, and he was inexplicably envious. When he arrived in his department now, although there were a large number of attending physicians and resident doctors available for his use, and he could even easily get an unskilled doctor to work for him when he raised his arms and called out for someone, when he walked out of the department, there may not be a henchman following him.
Moreover, the old henchman actually looked like he had the air of a senior doctor...
While he thought about all this, Dan Quan put on surgical scrubs, rubber gloves, and then stretched out his hand to reach the scalpel.

During the whole process, Dan Quan did not need to talk, and the surgery was completed naturally. For doctors and nurses in the operating theater, that was a basic procedure, and it had been carried out for the past five, ten, twenty, and thirty years. There were some changes, but the process was still the same old process.

Dan Quan pushed the patient’s abdomen with one hand and made an incision above the patient’s navel with the pencil grip hold with the other hand. He then looked up at Ling Ran, laughing. “Performing a single-site laparoscopy is actually boring. Well, there’s only one incision, there are few changes to it, and it’s not easy to position the three ports when you push them all inside.”
Ling Ran nodded calmly. He also knew the advantages and disadvantages of single-site laparoscopy.
“Doctor Ling, you don’t like chatting?” When Dan Quan saw that Ling Ran was not continuing the conversation, he was a little disappointed. “Isn’t it too boring not to chat in the operating theater?”
“No,” Ling Ran watched Dan Quan’s operation and answered.

“You really don’t feel so?” Dan Quan smiled and looked at the young nurse on the other side. He then joked in passing, “There are so many beautiful young girls, and you don’t even talk to them, wouldn’t they be bored till death?”
Ling Ran gave Dan Quan a strange look but still shook his head.
However, the young nurse anxiously said, “Just watching Doctor Ling would make us happy, how can it be boring?”
Chief Physician Dan my-middle-name-is-I-Want-To-Hit-Someone-and-I-Am-Also-the-Best-in-Single-Site-Laparoscopy-in-Yun-Hua-Hospital Quan’s expression gradually became dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 842: Cut On Site
paragraphs: Ling Ran watched surgeries for the entire day. Then, when he saw that Dan Quan had started to perform open gastrectomy, he walked away.

He did not look down on Dan Quan’s open gastrectomy, he looked down on it very much. He was at most at the beginning of Specialist Level. If he could not handle the middle and later parts of the surgery well, then he would only be at advanced Novice Level. For Ling Ran, there was no use for him to refer to his skills.
From this point of view, it was clear that Dan Quan did not perform a lot of laparotomies. Perhaps most of his time was spent on laparoscopes.

Speaking of which, this was also a common state for Dan Quan’s generation of doctors in the field of general surgery. Some doctors who were lucky in the hospital rushed to perform open abdominal surgeries, and when they were still young, they got to perform major surgeries and develop their skills in the area of open abdominal surgeries. Meanwhile, those doctors who were unlucky would not be able to become chief surgeons for major surgeries even when they got older, and they could only depend on laparoscopes to support their lives...
Few people could predict that the laparoscope would develop to what it was today.

The surgeries done by the General Surgery Department were almost completely performed through laparoscopes. For those who were skilled in using laparoscopes, there were only surgeries they could not perform well, never surgeries that they could not do.

Unfortunately, Dan Quan was also an extremity in the field of laparoscopy. His best single-site laparoscopy was not good enough for him to deal with every situation, and since he was still a little young and worked in the prestigious Yun Hua Hospital, most of the triple-site laparoscopies were done by his seniors.

Dan Quan knew about his situation. When he saw that Ling Ran did not take an interest in his open abdominal surgery, he let out a sigh of relief and said with a smile, “With a handsome guy in front of you, all of you can’t even say something witty. Finally, he’s gone.”
“Chief Physician Dan, no one uses the term ‘witty’ anymore. Even if you’re handsome, once you say that, you’ll look really crass.” The nurse who was washing her hand pouted.
Chief Physician Dan laughed. “Oh, then it’s my fault. I should say that we should be cracking dirty jokes. Let me say the first one...”
The circulating nurses sighed as she looked at the door’s direction. “I hope Doctor Ling is just going to wash his hands, and he’s coming back to perform the surgery with us.”
Chief Physician Dan wanted to be unhappy, but when he thought about Ling Ran’s face, the feeling was gone.

Even he felt that Ling Ran brought about a different atmosphere when he entered the operating theater. They might face the same blue wall and green floor, but the people around him felt happier when he was around.

“The Emergency Medical Center can’t even finish its own surgeries. It’s impossible for them to supervise ours all day long,” Chief Physician Dan replied to the circulating nurse. He then turned around and went on with the same topic. “The Emergency Medical Center’s bonus this year should be very high. It’s already amazing that you can successfully complete a hepatectomy. Now, they should be performing fifty cases per month.”

“I think they exceeded that number last month. They should have performed sixty or seventy cases.” The assistant was a junior doctor who gave off a weak presence. He held the mirror and quickly gossiped about the doctors.

Chief Physician Dan clicked his tongue a couple of times and was a little envious, “On average, two hepatectomies can be carried in a day. If they really carried it out, they would only be able to reach sixty to seventy cases a month by operating on three to four cases a day.”

He was a chief surgeon himself. He knew the various problems that arose when making arrangements for surgeries, especially in large-scale surgery. A lot of manpower and material resources would need to be accumulated for the preoperative consultation and all matters that required post-operation. If this opportunity was to be given to normal doctors, they would also be able to perform sixty or seventy surgeries a month as well. But under normal circumstances, a normal department could not possibly release such a large number of resources to a normal doctor.

Take Ling Ran’s surgeries as an example. Right now, his treatment group was equivalent to having one associate chief physician, one chief resident, three resident doctors, multiple housemen and interns, along with an unlimited number of anesthetists and nurses waiting on him hand and foot.
Chief Physician Dan did not think it was necessary, and he did not want to bear so much pressure either, he just felt a little envious, that was all.
“Freedom is still the best.” Chief Physician Dan laughed and continued to busy himself with the surgery.

Early in the morning on the next day, Chief Physician Dan drove his Mercedes-Benz. Just like usual, he drove slowly and kept to the car lane while giving way to pedestrians. He only stepped on the accelerator when he was about to reach the hospital.
He arrived at the hospital five minutes earlier than yesterday.
When he entered the elevator, Chief Physician Dan subconsciously took out his phone and looked through it.
He was scheduled for surgery at nine o’clock today, and the time was...

‘It’s okay to be a little late...’ Chief Physician Dan laughed at himself. ‘Those who become chief physicians but failed in becoming a department get to enjoy freedom, isn’t it? Being a little late is nothing...’
Chief Physician Dan might be thinking about that, but once he left the elevator, he still sped up a little.
As usual, he changed into his scrubs and went to the bathroom after a little examination.
Chief Physician Dan looked around. When he saw that there was nothing unusual, he began to wash his hands. He mocked himself. ‘What’s wrong with me today? Why am I being so paranoid?’
After he mocked himself, Chief Physician Dan lowered his head and washed his hands. He was a little unnerved.
He washed his hands, dried them, and entered the operating theater.
Chief Physician Dan looked up and saw Ling Ran.

He stood with his back straight, and his white coat fluttered a little. His body proportion was so balanced that he looked like a statue. As far as visual effects were concerned, if he were dissected, perhaps the shape of his muscles would be incredibly beautiful as well.
Chief Physician Dan suddenly felt relieved.
“Ling Ran, you’re here to watch the surgery?” Chief Physician Dan smiled.
“Yes,” Ling Ran replied. He then turned around, gave Chief Physician Dan a smile, and asked, “May I be your assistant?”
“Oh...” Chief Physician Dan immediately felt a little conflicted. “My assistant just helps me hold the laparoscope.”
“The feeling will still not be the same,” Ling Ran said.
Chief Physician Dan sighed. “Well if you want to help, go ahead. Whatever your name is, you can rest for a while.”
The general surgeon who was supposed to be his assistant obediently stepped back.
He did not dare to compete with Ling Ran for a place.
Ling Ran and Chief Physician Dan stood by each other. When the patient was anesthetized, they immediately got to the surgery.

Chief Physician Dan stood between the patient’s legs and made an incision as he said, “The current contraindications of single-site laparoscopy are basically the same as laparotomy, but the surgical trauma is small, which is still at our advantage...”
Ling Ran listened to Chief Physician Dan, silently remembered what he said, and compared what he said to the information he personally knew.

Splenectomy, which was the current surgery, was something that Ling Ran was very familiar with, but he had never done it through single-site laparoscopy before. Since the patients who received splenectomy from the Emergency Department always required emergency splenectomy, the most common method used was still exploratory laparotomy followed by surgery.

In general, the most common indications were thalassemia and other blood diseases, as well as a splenic cyst, and mild to moderate splenomegaly caused by splenic hemangioma. The safety of this elective surgery was relatively high. With sufficient preparation time before the surgery, Chief Physician Dan could handle the surgery with ease.
Ling Ran held on the laparoscope and acted as the chief surgeon’s eyes. He was also really interested in watching the surgery.
After the surgery, Ling Ran immediately texted Zuo Cidian through WeChat. [Splenectomy.]
Zuo Cidian quickly replied. [Noted, will arrange it immediately.]
At noon, Ling Ran received his first splenectomy patient.

This time, Ling Ran became the chief surgeon. While he did the incision, he said to Ren Qi, who wanted to learn single-site laparoscopy, “The current contraindications of single-site laparoscopy are basically the same as laparotomy...”

chapters.title: Chapter 843: Courteous
paragraphs: Ren Qi learned in earnest.

Every morning, he would follow resident doctors to perform ward rounds, performed some minor tasks that he could and had to do, such as writing admission records and discharge records, attaching examination sheets, perform consultations for other surgery departments as well as the Internal Medicine Department, and supervise Yu Yuan’s thesis...

If there were no emergencies, once Ren Qi persisted to noon after living through his fulfilling life, he could breathe a sigh of relief, eat a small, satisfying lunch and have enough energy for him to last until night. Then, he would follow the schedule that was already set and enter the operating theater according to the sequence set on the schedule to begin a fulfilling afternoon. He would help Chief Surgeon Zhang Anminto hold on a laparoscope, help Chief Surgeon Lu Wenbin hold on a microscope, and help Chief Surgeon Ma Yanlin lift legs up...
Ren Qi would only be able to participate in Ling Ran’s surgeries if luck was on his side. Most of the time, he could only watch him.

The number of assistants for surgery was limited. Even though Ling Ran constantly performed enough surgeries for an entire department, everyone still had to fight for the position as the first or second assistant.

As a surgeon who was over for in-service training, the most convenient place for Ren Qi was a place where he could watch surgeries at a close distance. After blending in and asking questions at the hospital staff, he got to know that Ma Yanlin, Lu Wenbin, and Zhang Anmin were still Ling Ran’s main assistants most of the time.
So, this was a rare opportunity for Ren Qi.

He was already a senior attending physician. Once he returned to his hospital after his training, he would have to work hard and compete to be an associate chief physician. After he became an associate chief physician, there would be a slim chance for him to be where he was now—he would not be able to leave the hospital for a few months and devote himself to improving his skills.
Even if there was a chance, he might not want to get out again.

The competition in county hospitals was crueler than that in hospitals like Yun Hua Hospital. Work was usually just enough for the doctors there. Once Ren Qi managed to snatch up the position of an associate chief physician, he had to compete for the limited spot of getting his own treatment group, and he might even need to fight to take over the department director when he retired...
If he left for a few months during that period of time, he might fall behind his competitors, and this kind of regression cannot be covered by just improving his skills a little.

In the words of many youngsters, doctors like Ren Qi lived lives where they must be able to see the end of the paths they wanted to take. However, very few doctors could reach their goals, and those who could could be considered to be as rare as the blue moon.
Ren Qi knew this very well, so he worked extra hard.

Ren Qi stuck to the schedule of getting up at four in the morning and clock off work at eight or nine in the evening. After all, he was only going back to his dorm to sleep, and thus, he did not want to waste any time at all.
After persisting for four to five days, Ren Qi was used to this routine.

Now, he could unscrupulously wake up patients at four in the morning and draw their blood, and eat pork trotters at six o’clock while he watched Achilles tendon repairs. In the afternoon, he could also help Doctor Yu Yuan pick up foreign bodies in the emergency room in his spare time...
Ren Qi felt that he had adapted to life in Yun Hua’s Emergency Medical Center. Then, he heard new arrangements being made.
“Let’s come to work early tomorrow and do more surgeries.” Ling Ran made a decision when the last surgery was completed.
“Then I’ll inform the Department of Surgery. What time?” Zuo Cidian did not look at other people or ask their opinions, because other people’s opinions did not matter.

Ling Ran thought about it and said, “We can start the surgeries one and a half hours in advance... so that means that we’ll be starting at two o’clock. The doctors involved in the surgery need to come early, and the doctors who did not participate in the surgery can come in different shifts.”
“Will this happen for several days?” Zuo Cidian asked.

“Yup, I’m going to finish the surgeries in the Emergency Medical Center and go to the General Surgery Department.” Ling Ran still watched single-site laparoscopy surgeries done by Chief Physician Dan, who was from the General Surgery Department, every day. Since he was learning skills himself, he cannot possibly master it in one go, as was what he did with the techniques given to him by the system. He had to work hard to learn it every day, but once a long period of time was needed for it, Ling Ran found it a waste of time.

Dan Quan’s surgeries started at nine o’clock and occasionally at ten o’clock. He had about two to three days every week where he used to perform surgeries, and he will do around three surgeries during those days. If it had to be put in words, aside from the two or three hours of surgery in the morning, Dan Quan’s remaining working hours were all coincidentally times where Ling Ran did not perform any surgeries whatsoever.

After listening to Ling Ran’s order, Zuo Cidian immediately understood. “This way, if the surgeries are performed a little earlier every morning, the surgeries in the Emergency Medical Center will not be affected.”
“Yes.” Ling Ran nodded in satisfaction.

“Then I will make arrangements for the surgeries. I’ll arrange it so that we’ll try to do surgeries like hepatectomy in the morning as much as possible, and then at about eight o’clock, I will arrange surgeries such as knee arthroscopies. With this, we can space out the use of the operating theaters.” Zuo Cidian naturally came up with a plan.
Once again, Ling Ran agreed.
Ren Qi was stunned when he heard this. There was only one sentence running in his mind. ‘That’s not morning, it’s dusk! Dusk!’
However, doctors who were here for in-service training had always been insignificant in the grand scheme of things.

From the second day, Ling Ran started spamming Energy Serums and caught up his surgery volume in the Emergency Medical Center. While he watched Dan Quan’s surgeries, other doctors were able to rest for a while. But the diligent and ambitious doctors would not truly take a break.
Chief Physician Dan had gradually become used to Ling Ran’s presence.
This was especially in the morning. Even if he was not late, when he saw Ling Ran, he would feel inexplicably guilty.

“Ling Ran, you’ve really trained yourself to look imposing. It’s better than Old Huo’s.” Dan Quan made some excuses. After all, he was a chief physician from the General Surgery Department. It was fine even if he teased the Emergency Medical Center a little.
Ling Ran only glanced at Dan Quan indifferently. He did not even bother to reply to him.
“Aww, if you behave like this, people will think you’re not good at socializing.” Chief Physician Dan was now more familiar with Ling Ran, so he could speak freely with him now.
Ling Ran’s expression remained indifferent. When he looked at Chief Physician Dan, he said, “I’ve never been good at socializing, anyway.”
“Well, at least you know that.” Chief Physician Dan’s emotions were stirred up, and he was immediately in the mood to chat. “But for me, your passion for learning deserves some praise...”
*Ring*
The phone on the wall in the operating theater suddenly rang, interrupting the outburst of emotions that had accumulated in Chief Physician Dan.
Everyone schooled their expressions.
If the phone in the operating theater rang, then the caller definitely did not make the call for a chat.
“Hello?” A circulating nurse picked it up and answered it. She then brought the phone to Chief Physician Dan. “It’s from the department director.”
“Bring it over here.” Chief Physician Dan shrugged his shoulders, motioned for the nurse to hold the phone to his ear, and asked, “Director, I’m in the middle of a surgery.”
“Okay. Is Ling Ran with you?” The voice of the General Surgery Department director penetrated the air.
Chief Physician Dan hesitated, looked at Ling Ran, and said, “Yes, he’s with me.”
“How did it go? Are you more familiar with Ling Ran already?”
“A little.”

“Okay... after you’re done with the surgery, bring Ling Ran over. I’ll introduce him to a patient.” The department director’s tone was normal, and Dan Quan could not detect his emotions by listening to his voice.
But Chief Physician Dan understood what he meant the moment he heard it. The department director had a request for Ling Ran.
Chief Physician Dan could not help but stare at Ling Ran. He did not say much and made a promise. “No problem, I’ll bring him over.”
“Make sure to be polite,” the director of the General Surgery Department said before hanging up.

Chief Physician Dan hesitated, looked at Ling Ran, and said, “Yes, he’s with me.”
“How did it go?
Are you more familiar with Ling Ran already?”
“A little.”
“Okay... after you’re done with the surgery, bring Ling Ran over.
I’ll introduce him to a patient.” The department director’s tone was normal, and Dan Quan could not detect his emotions by listening to his voice.
But Chief Physician Dan understood what he meant the moment he heard it.
The department director had a request for Ling Ran.
Chief Physician Dan could not help but stare at Ling Ran.
He did not say much and made a promise.
“No problem, I’ll bring him over.”
“Make sure to be polite,” the director of the General Surgery Department said before hanging up.

chapters.title: Chapter 844: Torrent
paragraphs: At the meeting hall in Yun Hua Hospital, a few people sat scattered near the door while they chatted happily. They ignored the long table that was dozens of feet long in the distance, looking almost miserable.
Four pots of centipede tongavine were placed at the center of the long table. They looked a bit more wilted compared to the spider plants hanging on the windowsill.

In fact, the man who sat facing the glass door looked dispirited as well. However, he forced himself to chat with others. The smile on his face was clearly fake, yet no one could find any fault with it.
The few doctors who sat in front of him had their usual expressions. In fact, they looked slightly indifferent, but that indifference allowed people to feel more relaxed.
Only in the hospital would people be so tolerant of fake smiles and forgive other people’s indifference.
“Doctor Ling is here.” A junior administration staff walked in and reported obsequiously to the few leaders in the room.
“Okay,” the director of the General Surgery Department replied. He sat up straight, turned around, and said, “Dean Wu, let us listen to what Doctor Ling has to say first.”

“Okay.” Dean Wu straightened his back and showed a sincere smile that was anything but sincere. He then said, “When Ling Ran entered the university, he left an impression on me. I was quite worried at that time, who knew that he would actually be a top scorer.”

“As expected.” The director of the General Surgery Department chuckled and said, “Yun Hua University is quite good. In just a few years, they managed to produce such a great doctor. He is truly good because he can perform surgeries right after he entered the hospital.”
“He was already quite good when he was on campus, but he wasn’t as good as he is now.” Dean Wu’s smile seemed to be a little skeptical.
“That’s how genii are like.” The director of the General Surgery Department would not give any explanations. If he asked, he would be an idiot, so why should he?
*Knock knock*
The sound of a few people walking could be heard from the other end of the corridor.

This meeting room was used for the medical staff within the hospital. Anyone who sat inside could see what was outside clearly. Even if someone approached the room, the sound of them approaching could be immediately heard. Of course, no one would move as fast as flatterers, so they knew whoever coming was not there to flatter them.
Dan Quan, Ling Ran, Zuo Cidian, Zhang Anmin, and Yu Yuan appeared at the other side of the transparent door.
Dan Quan walked in front like a vanguard, and he walked a little too fast.
Ling Ran was behind him leisurely, and he had an imposing presence about him when he was flanked by Zuo Cidian and Zhang Anmin.
Yu Yuan could not be seen vaguely, and she was at the back of the group.
The director of the General Surgery Department smiled and stood up. Naturally, someone went over to welcome them.

“Doctor Ling is here. Old Dan, come and have a seat.” The director of the General Surgery Department nodded gently and said without beating around the bush, “Ling Ran, this is Dean Wu, and he’s also the dean of Yun Hua University School of Medicine, which is your university.”
“Yes. Hello, Dean Wu.” Ling Ran showed a smile. “He’s still our dean now.”
Everyone in the meeting room was shocked. This sentence was well said and was highly flattering, but it was something that Ling Ran will usually say.

Only Zuo Cidian’s expression remained natural. Yun Hua Hospital had long since become a hospital affiliated to Yun Hua University. If the dean of Yun Hua University School of Medicine was still referred to as a dean by the doctors of Yun Hua Hospital, it was still reasonable. So, Ling Ran was just telling the truth.

While he remained seated across them, Dean Wu’s expression became better, and he said, “As expected of a student who graduated from Yun Hua University. Hmm... Doctor Ling, we came here for an unreasonable demand.”
Ling Ran looked at them with his usual expression. He knew he would not be here without any special request.

Dan Quan looked over with slight envy and curiosity. Since he was now a chief physician, he received many requests from the patients and their family members. But he had never seen such a formal request made in such a high profile. However, that was mainly because his expertise was on single site laparoscopy. The nature of the surgery made it so that the surgeon will never treat any patient with major illnesses. Hence, at the very least, the patient did not need to worry about the surgery not going well, otherwise, they would have opted for multiple site laparoscopy or open abdominal surgery. If they did, the surgeon would have more room for maneuver.

However, the skill mastered by Ling Ran was totally different, especially when it was hepatectomy. As of current, his ranking in the country was very high, and his newly developed hepatectomy with intraoperative inspection was a life saving skill for patients with liver cancer and bad health.

After Ling Ran had been invited to be a freelance surgeon, he spent one third of his time performing surgeries related to the liver. Part of the reason for it was because he patients and family members heard of him, and the other reason was because his peers wanted to learn secretly from him as well as introduce him to others without restraint.
Dean Wu clearly belonged to the group of people who knew about Ling Ran, and he said, “I would like to invite you to perform a liver cancer hepatectomy for my father, but...”
He stopped before he continued in a troubled tone. “My father does not really want to receive surgery. So, can I ask you to perform surgery for my father as a student from Yun Hua Hospital?”

“The old dean has liver cancer?” When Ling Ran first entered university, he had listened to Dean Wu Senior’s lecture. As one of the co-founders of Yun Hua Hospital, Dean Wu Senior had lived a rich life worth being depicted as legendary. In Ling Ran’s impression, he should be in the status of enjoying a retired life...

Dean Wu Junior, who was not actually very junior himself, nodded gently. “My father is eighty years old now. Theoretically, such a surgery is too risky for him. However, when he received the report stating he had liver cancer, we found that it’s still in the early stage. If he doesn’t receive surgery, I’ll feel ill at ease.”
Ling Ran remained silent for a few seconds before he said slowly, “I can perform the surgery, provided if the patient agreed to do so.”

“As long as you tell my father that you graduated from Yun Hua Hospital, he would be willing to receive it.” Dean Wu Junior smiled wanly. “He actually knows about you as well. Yun Hua University has produced many doctors, but there are few who managed to rise to fame at such a young age recently.”
Zuo Cidian could not help but to interrupt the conversation, and he said, “If you need someone who graduated from Yun Hua Hospital, there should still be other candidates right?”

“My father is more willing to give young people a chance. If he chooses doctors who have been famous for a long time, he worries that he may give them too much pressure.” When Dean Wu Junior said this, his tone changed slightly, “I kept persuading my father to take care of his body and stop thinking about anything other than the surgery. He told me that while it is best if the doctors and patients do not think about anything other than surgery, since we are part of administration, we need to think more...”
Everyone remained silent in the meeting hall.
After some time, the director of the General Surgery Department lowered his voice and said, “Dean Wu Senior worries too much.”
A few people sighed non stop by the side.
“Has he taken his MRI scan?” Ling Ran did not beat around the bush. The patient’s thoughts and his condition were two totally different matters.

For an old man at eighty years old, if he was not in a good condition for surgery, there was no need to insist on the removal of the tumor. Not only will it lower his quality of life, his lifespan will also not be extended either, or rather, even if Ling Ran managed to extend his lifespan to a certain degree, if his quality of life was lowered too much, the loss will definitely outweigh the loss.
Dean Wu immediately took out the prepared MRI scans. For the time being, he was just as anxious as any other patient.
Zuo Cidian, who was at the side, looked at the information and serial number encoded at the right left corner, opened the laptop he brought over, and transferred the raw scans over.
Ling Ran first looked at the processed scans before he read the raw scans. His expression did not change at all.
After he finished, Ling Ran stood up directly and said, “Let’s go and check on the patient.”
Dean Wu and the others immediately stood up. Since their rhythm had been interrupted, all of them were slightly dumbfounded.
Ling Ran was the first to go out, followed by Zuo Cidian.
The other doctors queued up accordingly and followed Ling Ran in a group consisting of two people in a row.
Everyone wore a white coat, and from the distance, they looked like a white torrent.

chapters.title: Chapter 845: Dean Wu Senior
paragraphs: At the ward of the General Surgery Department, Dean Wu Senior lay on his bed, his eyes shut tight.
With his status, he could stay at the inpatient ward for senior cadres or the special ward, but Dean Wu Senior was very stubborn and insisted on staying in a normal room.

But the results were mostly the same. The General Surgery Department arranged a double room for him. After the patient on the other bed was discharged, no other patients were sent into the room. The family members could even sleep inside to accompany the patient, and it was just as convenient, it only lacked a small parlor, a fridge, and a microwave.

Dean Wu Senior could hardly calm down his emotions. He already mentioned to the people who knew him not to bother him twice, but his family members and other people just kept coming and going, and where there was someone else in the room, he could not rest. But since it was useless for him to persuade them, he could only let it slide and quietly think about his own troubles.

His liver cancer was in the early stage, and he did not feel anything. As he was eighty years old now, the frequent examinations and subsequent admission into the hospital over the past few days as well as the visitations by the guests were enough to exhaust him.
Even Dean Wu Senior’s granddaughter was a bit tired.

She was resting on the chair beside the bed while holding on her grandfather’s thin and dry hand with one of her hands. Then, she heard the sounds of leather shoes against the floor from the corridor.

“Someone’s coming.” His eldest granddaughter sighed and stood up. She worked at Yun Hua Junior High School and was now the Dean of Academic Studies. However, when it came to dealing with guests, she found this much more tiring than criticizing students.
Dean Wu Senior opened his eyes gently. His heart was already not that good, waking him abruptly from a deep sleep would be rough.
*Knock, knock, knock*
The ward door was knocked gently thrice, and the nurse on duty came in.
“Madam Wu, Dean Wu Junior and the other specialists are here,” the nurse mumbled, but she could still be understood.
Madam Wu immediately stood up, because she still had hope that her grandfather’s disease can be cured.

After a few seconds, Dean Wu Junior entered, nodded at his daughter, looked at the condition in the room, turned around, and said, “Dad, I invited a specialist who specializes in handling early stage liver cancer among old people. You’ll never guess who that person is.”

“No matter who it was, I won’t let them check on me.” Dean Wu Senior sounded very harsh. He was someone who focused on effectiveness. He did not believe in supernatural beings or reincarnation. He lived a frugal life, and he wanted to invest all resources into producing something and learning if he could. Yet he did not want to have someone treat his disease.

Dean Wu Senior looked at his son in determination and said, “You don’t have to convince me and even lie to me. I know more medical experts in the country than you. Who else can you invite over? You don’t have to do so as well. My body is already in this stage, and how can I die in peace knowing I made someone carry the weight of failing to save a senior doctor? It’ll also be awkward for you to see him again in the future, right?”
Dean Wu Senior had said these words before, but it was not as serious as this moment. Dean Wu Junior’s nose burned, and his tears almost flowed out.
“Grandfather, you should stop overthinking.” Madam Wu was almost in her forties, and she could no longer retain her calm expression as well.
Dean Wu Senior shook his head gently. “When one becomes older, his flesh will deteriorate. Only the mind remains functioning...”
“Father.” Dean Wu Junior did not let his father continue and pretended to be cheerful. He said, “The specialist I invited today is quite different. I think you will like him.”
He coughed, and Ling Ran came in after Zuo Cidian.
Both Dean Wu Senior and his granddaughter instantly looked excited.

“Ling Ran, it’s you.” Dean Wu Senior managed to call out Ling Ran’s name in an instant. Although he had left the frontlines of Yun Hua University, he treated the campus as his home. Each year, he would attend all kinds of activities and give lectures once or twice. Therefore, he was still quite familiar with those legendary students at Yun Hua University.
This was especially so for students like Ling Ran, who was handsome and a top scorer. He was definitely someone that Dean Wu Senior would remember.
However, Dean Wu Senior never thought that today’s specialist was Ling Ran.
“Ling Ran is now the number one hepatectomy specialist at Yun Hua Hospital.” Dean Wu Junior chuckled and made introductions to his father.
Dean Wu Senior first frowned and said, “Don’t boast about him too much! Ling Ran is still young, why should he fight for number one?”

“He did not have to fight for it.” Dean Wu Junior knew that he might be able to convince his father when he heard his words. He smiled sincerely and said to Ling Ran and the others, “My father is not as energetic as he used to, and he is now putting less attention to the affairs in the hospital.”
Ling Ran’s reputation only circulated within the medical field, and for old staff like Dean Wu Senior, who had retired even from the second string, this information had not reached him yet.

Dean Wu Junior was in a good mood. He immediately made the bed recline when he saw that his father wanted to sit up, and he said, “Father, I’m not lying. Doctor Ling’s skills in hepatectomy is now top in the country. If Changxi Province wants to hire a hepatectomy specialist, their first option will definitely be Doctor Ling.”
“That’s because he is young.” Dean Wu Senior refused to believe that.
Dean Wu Junior smiled and said, “Let me put this in another way, I won’t admit it after I leave this door. But now, I know that Ling Ran is charging 10,000 RMB for every freelance surgery, right?”

Freelance surgeons were still considered as an act in the gray area. The junior doctors could say everything about it fearlessly during their chat because they were not qualified for freelance surgeries yet. But when the senior doctors talked about this, they will need to be wary.
Yes, regardless of whether they admitted to it or not, freelance surgeons were now the reality, and the price among freelance surgeons was the greater embodiment of reality.

A doctor who charged 3,000 RMB per surgery was at a totally different level from a doctor who charged 5,000 RMB, and there was an even larger difference between doctors who charged for 6,000 RMB and 10,000 RMB per surgery.
Dean Wu Senior may have left the frontlines, but he still understood what was going on.

In places like Changxi Province, 10,000 RMB per surgery meant that the surgeon was among the top surgeons. Maybe there were some doctors who charged an extra 2,000 to 3,000 RMB, and surgeries that cost around 15,000 RMB to 20,000 RMB will only happen once in a while.

The relationship between money and life was a topic that the entire medical system did not want to talk about. However, the power contained within money was undeniable, because it was necessary in procuring services that kept a person alive.
Dean Wu Senior looked at Ling Ran with great effort, smiled, and asked, “Ling Ran, you just graduated two to three years ago, right? It’s not easy to perform surgeries in other hospitals, huh?”

“The surgery environment of other hospitals is truly not comparable with Yun Hua Hospital. But when most of the doctors cooperate with me, they can still reach the standard.” Ling Ran gave his comments calmly, yet what he said was not the same as mentioned by Dean Wu Senior.
Dean Wu Senior had met Ling Ran not just once, and he could not help but smile and said, “I didn’t expect this... Okay, then Doctor Ling, please take a look at my disease.”

Just like what the Dean Wu Junior planned, as a young doctor who graduated from Yun Hua University, Ling Ran’s appearance gave Dean Wu Senior too many reasons to persist on his treatment and not just give up on treatment.
“Then, I will do a physical examination for you first.” Ling Ran did not say much and went straight to work.

Dean Wu Senior struggled to look at the way he handled matters, and he kept nodding. “Good. Well done. During our time, we didn’t have as many devices and instruments, we needed to depend on physical examination...”
“Please stop talking.” Ling Ran looked at Dean Wu Senior with a serious expression.
Dean Wu Senior was interrupted. He was stunned, and he immediately laughed out loudly in the next moment.
“No laughing as well.” Ling Ran pressed on Dean Wu Senior’s stomach and gave an order.
Dean Wu Senior laughed even more loudly.

A doctor who charged 3,000 RMB per surgery was at a totally different level from a doctor who charged 5,000 RMB, and there was an even larger difference between doctors who charged for 6,000 RMB and 10,000 RMB per surgery.
Dean Wu Senior may have left the frontlines, but he still understood what was going on.
In places like Changxi Province, 10,000 RMB per surgery meant that the surgeon was among the top surgeons.
Maybe there were some doctors who charged an extra 2,000 to 3,000 RMB, and surgeries that cost around 15,000 RMB to 20,000 RMB will only happen once in a while.
The relationship between money and life was a topic that the entire medical system did not want to talk about.
However, the power contained within money was undeniable, because it was necessary in procuring services that kept a person alive.
Dean Wu Senior looked at Ling Ran with great effort, smiled, and asked, “Ling Ran, you just graduated two to three years ago, right?
It’s not easy to perform surgeries in other hospitals, huh?”
“The surgery environment of other hospitals is truly not comparable with Yun Hua Hospital.
But when most of the doctors cooperate with me, they can still reach the standard.” Ling Ran gave his comments calmly, yet what he said was not the same as mentioned by Dean Wu Senior.
Dean Wu Senior had met Ling Ran not just once, and he could not help but smile and said, “I didn’t expect this...
Okay, then Doctor Ling, please take a look at my disease.”

Just like what the Dean Wu Junior planned, as a young doctor who graduated from Yun Hua University, Ling Ran’s appearance gave Dean Wu Senior too many reasons to persist on his treatment and not just give up on treatment.
“Then, I will do a physical examination for you first.” Ling Ran did not say much and went straight to work.
Dean Wu Senior struggled to look at the way he handled matters, and he kept nodding.
“Good.
Well done.
During our time, we didn’t have as many devices and instruments, we needed to depend on physical examination...”
“Please stop talking.” Ling Ran looked at Dean Wu Senior with a serious expression.
Dean Wu Senior was interrupted.
He was stunned, and he immediately laughed out loudly in the next moment.
“No laughing as well.” Ling Ran pressed on Dean Wu Senior’s stomach and gave an order.
Dean Wu Senior laughed even more loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 846: Please Come
paragraphs: For Ling Ran, performing physical examinations for elderly patients was not something new.

Since he got in Beijing, he had performed hundreds of liver cancer cases where he had to perform intraoperative inspection during the surgery. His patients were mostly elderly patients. Each time, he had to perform multiple physical examinations before the surgery. With Ling Ran’s careful personality, performing physical examinations for eldery patients which seemed to be rather difficult cases was easy to him.
As an experienced clinician, Dean Wu Senior could feel Ling Ran’s confidence and confirmed the accuracy within Ling Ran’s physical examination.
Meanwhile, Ling Ran’s fingers were strong, his movements were clean and smooth, and he had smooth skin, causing Dean Wu Senior to sense his confidence—he did not feel any discomfort.
Dean Wu Senior closed his eyes and listened to Ling Ran’s orders and answered the questions. His expression became softer with each passing moment.
When Ling Ran finished the physical examination, Dean Wu Senior had already fallen asleep.
Ling Ran was stunned. He looked at the monitor at the side. After ensuring that there was no problem, he nodded slowly and left the room.
The other doctors left in a flurry. Some doctors even wanted to perform physical examination on the patient, but they refrained from doing so when Zuo Cidian glared at them fiercely by the bed.

The meaning behind Zuo Cidian’s actions was very clear. The patients received by Ling Ran would be considered as patients of the Emergency Medical Center. It would be embarrassing for them if the patients from the Emergency Medical Center were casually checked by doctors from other departments. The Emergency Medical Center was not a place like the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
“Doctor Ling, how was it?” Dean Wu Junior hid his anxiety and asked gently.

Ling Ran nodded lightly and said, “Based on the medical images and examination report, he basically fulfills the surgical indication. If you really want him to receive surgery, we’ll schedule it for tomorrow morning. Today, we will just do some preoperative preparations first.”

“Tomorrow... Okay.” Dean Wu Junior’s hesitation was born of his subconscious. He knew that it would be better to perform the surgery as soon as possible, particularly in such conditions where preparations in all areas were already sufficient.
After he thought for some time, Dean Wu Junior added. “Let me talk to my father first.”
The underlying meaning behind it was that if he failed negotiating with his father, he still needed Ling Ran’s help.
Ling Ran did not understand it. He only nodded and said, “Then I’ll go for my ward round first.”

Then, the director of the General Surgery Department and a group of doctors from the General Surgery Department could only watch as Ling Ran counted the rooms in the General Surgery Department and went into a room with a group of people.
“What’s happening?” The director of the General Surgery Department looked around alertly.

The one who stood behind the director of the General Surgery Department was Chief Physician Dan Quan. He was initially pursing his lips and smiled dumbly while he watched the chaos, but right then, he made some calculations. The room that Ling Ran entered belonged to Dan Quan’s treatment group, if he was not mistaken.
This was...
Dan Quan’s back instantly broke out in sweat.
He saw the hairs on his and the director’s neck standing.
‘How should I explain the situation?’
Dan Quan’s mind was full of this question. When he knew that the director would not wait for too long for the answer, Dan Quan was as nervous as a baby who wanted to poop while shopping.
Should he solve the problem with no regard to his own pride, or should he take the risk and wait for a safe moment?
Dan Quan’s judgmental ability started to function crazily like an old printer which required a lot of power but produced only a few copies of paper.

“Ling Ran had recently learnt single site laparoscopy from me. He observed some of the surgeries and became my assistant during other times.” Dan Quan kept analyzing the situation before he decided to solve the problem on the spot.

After all, it was no secret that Ling Ran learnt single site laparoscopy from Dan Quan. Yun Hua Hospital encouraged doctors to learn from each other as well. In fact, Dan Quan had even publicized this fact intentionally and unintentionally before.
Afterall, for Chief Physician Dan Quan, this was something that will inflate his ego by a whole degree.
Right now, Dan Quan could not help but feel a little guilty.
Very guilty...
He was so guilty that he wanted to cry.
The few doctors around him put on looks of realization.
The director of the General Surgery Department stared deeply at Dan Quan.
Dan Quan tried his best to force a smile. Although he was the leader in his treatment group, he dared not oppose his director.

The General Surgery Department in Yun Hua Hospital was one of the largest and best departments. Before the director retired, it would be unlikely for the people who worked under him to rebel against him.

“Ling Ran sure loves to learn.” The director of the General Surgery Department chuckled and said to Dan Quan, “Old Dan, let’s go and have a look too. It’s your patient after all. You should be more familiar with the patient.”
“Oh... Okay!” Dan Quan understood what he meant immediately and quickly ordered his subordinates to follow Ling Ran into the ward.

Dean Wu Junior was observing at the side. Without needing anyone to explain to him, he could tell just what was Ling Ran’s current status and situation in the hospital by observing everyone’s expression and attitude.
After all, everyone was very experienced in the field, they would be able to tell what was going on when everything was presented to them so clearly.
All the doctors left reluctantly because they still wanted to watch the show.

Dean Wu Junior sent away the last person in the room and went in front of the hospital bed. He saw that Dean Wu Senior had stopped napping and was pressing the remote control for the television excitedly.
“Dad.” Dean Wu Junior greeted and sat by the side. He sounded a little stiff.
“Ling Ran agreed to operate on me?” Dean Wu Senior was twenty years older than his son. Without needing his son to explain in detail, he went straight for the crucial question.
Dean Wu Junior immediately nodded. “Doctor Ling agreed to it. He is now working out the surgery plan.”

“Okay. If they allow you to participate in the preoperative consultation, go on ahead. If they won’t, don’t say a single thing about it,” Dean Wu Senior said seriously, “Don’t you dare to interrupt the professionals with your current administrative position. This is my disease. You have no place in it. If not, you wouldn’t have had to keep on inviting specialists here, would you?”
“Yes...” Dean Wu Junior was still quite dumbfounded by the scolding. Then, he smiled, “Father, you agreed to go through the surgery?”
“I’ll go if Ling Ran is the chief surgeon.” Dean Wu Senior nodded slowly.
“Okay... That’s great.” Dean Wu Junior became very excited. “Your cancer is still in the early stage, and there is a high chance to eliminate it completely...”
Dean Wu Senior snorted and said, “You know quite a lot, huh? Since you know that much, why don’t you continue to work as a clinician?”
All this while, Dean Wu Senior hoped his son would become a clinician. It was Dean Wu Junior’s personal decision to work as an administrative personnel.

During his internship, Dean Wu Junior gained proof that he had a brighter future if he got an administrative post. He could also use his family resources wisely, it was just that he did not fulfill Dean Wu Senior’s expectations.
But in this kind of situation, Dean Wu Junior would not argue with his old father.

He grinned honestly and said, “I think, after Ling Ran finishes treating you. We can invite him to the school again and give the students some lectures or lessons. Cases like him appear far too rarely.”
Dean Wu Senior nodded, just as Dean Wu Junior expected, but said, “Whether I get treated and whether the surgery is successful or not will be my fate.

“The way you think is fine, since Yun Hua Hospital was always affiliated under Yun Hua University, and there are so many doctors from there who are also assistant lecturers in the university. Ling Ran also graduated from Yun Hua University, so it would be very suitable to invite him over.”

chapters.title: Chapter 847: Fire Dragon
paragraphs: *Thud*
Qi Zao walked into her bedroom before she fell face flat on the bed. All she felt was a sense of comfort as if her entire body had been disassembled before being put together again.

“If I still work as a campus reporter, I’ll be cursed to date Back-Up 3, marry Back-Up Number 8, and marry again Back-Up Number 12!” Qi Zao swore to herself. Her neck was so sore that she did not want to move at all.
Her dormmate chuckled. “Qi Zao, wake up. You don’t have a boyfriend! And you don’t even have a back-up!”

“Ouch... I don’t even have a back-up? Life is such a pain. I can hardly breathe now...” Qi Zao casually replied, before she turned her body and kicked off her shoes. Then, she saw that her dormmates were dressed nicely. They seemed to be ready to leave.
“Where are you going, and what are you doing?” Qi Zao’s reporter-instinct started functioning again.
“Going to queue up,” her best friend answered.
“Library?” Qi Zao was slightly surprised.
Her best friend smiled without saying anything before she lowered her head and operated on her phone for a few seconds before she said, “Just forwarded it to you.”
*Buzz*
Qi Zao’s phone buzzed at the same time.
She swiped up and saw an official message from the school; it was forwarded by her best friend.
[Breaking news! Ling Ran returns!]
Qi Zao was surprised and raised her head. “Is Senior Ling back? What is he back for?”
“He’s coming to give a talk at nine in the morning tomorrow!”
“So, you’re all going to queue up for the talk? And you’re queuing up until nine in the morning tomorrow?” Qi Zao looked at the girls in disbelief.

“We’ll put a stool there first. Then, we are ready to take turns to queue up, just like how foreigners do when they buy iPhones.” Her best friend lifted the small folding stool on her hand as she spoke.
Qi Zao was totally speechless. “Are you serious?”
“I am serious if Senior Ling is real!”
“Do you really need to be like this?”
“People queue up for day and night for a concert, so it isn’t something big to queue up for a day for Senior Ling.” When her best friend said this, she asked, “Are you in?”
“I’m a little tired...” Qi Zao hesitated.
“Sisters, let’s go.” Her best friend brought the others and left when Qi Zao did not take up her offer.
Qi Zao covered her head with a pillow, and she was too lazy to even move her body. In a short while, she fell asleep deeply.
When she woke up later, she heard some sounds in the room.
‘Is there a thief?’ When Qi Zao heard the sound, she felt a stab of fear, and she immediately conjured all sorts of news for this.
“Young Zao, are you awake?” But she heard her best friend’s voice.
Qi Zao got up from her bed, then she saw her best friend crawling into her own bed in a disheveled state.
“You came back?” Qi Zao asked, then she lowered her head and looked at her phone. “It’s only 4 o’clock.”
“Yea,” her best friend answered before she went straight ahead and asked, “Do you want to go?”
“Go... go and watch Senior Ling’s lecture?”

“Yea, we’ve put a stool for you. If you want to go, just go and guard the place for a few hours. Forget it if you’re not, though.” When her best friend finished speaking, she laid on her flowery bed sheet and slept soundly while snoring.
Qi Zao stared at the pretty girl who was snoring, but she could not sleep anymore. Therefore, she decided to wake up, cleaned herself up a little, and left the house.
The night was quiet.
There were yellow, red, and white lights shining at the horizon far away.

Yun Hua University was the most famous university in Changxi Province, and the School of Medicine itself already had 0.2 square miles in terms of surface area. Together with a few girls from the same dorm, Qi Zao held the torchlight she bought from the retail shop while walking quickly toward the hall.

When they reached the entrance, they saw two bright roads extending toward them from a higher spot ahead of them. One of them was short, and the people queueing there were people heading to the library. The long one was the queue made of people going to the hall.
“There are still people queuing up for the library at this hour?” Qi Zao cast a glance at the place, and she felt slightly surprised.
“There are still guys who look ugly yet are still feel envious of Senior Ling’s talent,” a girl next to her said in disdain.
Qi Zao laughed when she heard this.” They might also love learning and might be working to take the Unified National Graduate Entrance Examination.”
“I’m talking about those people,” the girl answered without any hesitation.
Qi Zao became speechless.
Those few hours passed by just like that as the girls sat through it in the queue quietly.
When daylight came, a motorcade of black cars drove over. The long queue of people became restless again. They took out their phones and informed the owners of the small folding stools.
When the door of the hall opened, the students instantly rushed in like the tide.
The staff at the door initially wanted to limit the number of participants, but they failed to do so. In a while, the hall was crowded like the subway.
At nine o’clock in the morning, Ling Ran and his group appeared on the rostrum on time.
Dean Wu Junior was the first person who got on the stage. He said with great emotion, “Fellow students...”
The students tried to express their emotions by taking advantage of the fact that they were in the crowd.

Dean Wu Junior did not change his smile. He changed the topic of conversation. “Next, please welcome our alumni, Ling Ran, who has become a famous hepatectomy expert in the country in just three years.”

Dean Wu Junior gave away his place as he spoke. He had been in a good mood over the past few days. Aside from the fact that his father, Dean Wu Senior’s surgery was extremely successful, the early stage lesion excision was done cleanly, and the damage to the liver was not big. Being able to be discharged from the ICU two days after the surgery and getting down the bed after five days was considered a very good prognosis.

Although he was still far away from reaching the standards where he could be discharged, based on the standards of an old man at eighty years old, regardless of what surgery they received, reaching this level after a week was already something that was worthy of anyone to thank their lucky stars.
While he was under the stage, Ling Ran shook his suit a little before he stood on the rostrum.
The students who were making a fuss during the chaos stopped in their daze in an instant, like their throats were stuffed with something.

Ling Ran’s suit was custom made by Zegna, and the cloth was something his mother bought from Zegna as well. Its specialty would probably be that it gave the person wearing it a confident and handsome appearance.

For the university students who just stepped into the society and were curious and hopeful about their careers, a suit like this, Ling Ran, and the hall of Yun Hua University were all things they aspired to have, to be, and to remain.
*Gulp*
Some students gulped, but since there were a lot of them, the sound was loud when all of it overlapped with each other.
Some students laughed out loud.
However, there were a whole lot more people who stared at the stage dumbly or took out their phones to capture Ling Ran’s image as he stood tall on the rostrum.
Ling Ran stood on the rostrum, but he did not immediately speak. He eyed his surroundings, just like the others.
For him, being able to come back to Yun Hua University to give a talk because of his medical skills was also one of his dreams.

Naturally, Ling Ran had gotten on the rostrum multiple times. When he was still in school, he did not have the talent to study, which was why he could only score among the top three, sometimes the top five. However, universities were not barbaric places where the winner seizes all opportunities. That was why the people who were ranked only at the third or fourth place could also have the chance to get on the rostrum.

Other than getting on the rostrum for academic purposes, Ling Ran was also offered to join events where he could get on stage by relying on his face, body figure, and votes, and he obtained even more chances to get on stage for those events compared to the ones for academic purposes. But he rarely participated in those. However, when he calculated all the times he had to go up the rostrum because he was forced to, then the number of times he had to go on the rostrum was not few.
The hall did not change much compared to the time when Ling Ran was still in university.

No difference could be seen from the walls, tables, and chairs. The floor and rostrum also looked no different, and even the girls sitting at the front row were still showing their long and fair legs.

“Hello, everyone.” Ling Ran’s height was much taller than Dean Wu Junior. He took over the microphone and said, “The class today is mainly for the subsequent lectures. So, I will focus mainly on medically specialized knowledge in my lecture today—”
“Senior, you’re going to give us lectures?”
“Am I going mad? We can’t be this lucky, can we?”
“Pick the class!” A shout made everyone take out their phones.

Ling Rang calmly looked at the bottom of the stage, and he handled the situation with great familiarity by saying, “The course registration system has not added my lectures into the system yet. According to university rules, I need to have three trial classes first. Considering the fact that the course registration system is imperfect because it implemented the ‘first-come-first-serve’ method, after my discussion with Dean Wu Junior, we decided to decide on the name list of the students who will officially join this lecture judging by your performance and after you take a test once I give three lectures. Those who didn’t get in will have to enter other courses in the elective class.”
People under the stage raised their hands, and they were all students who decided to perform well.
Dean Wu Junior happily looked at the situation under the stage, then he sighed to the teacher next to him. “How good would it be if the students behave so proactively like this in all subjects?”
The old professor by his side chuckled. “The students must be thinking the same thing too.”
“Huh?”
“It would be so good if the teachers in all subjects look like Ling Ran.” The old professor touched his non-existing beard while he praised his cleverness and his handsomeness.
